description: Popular cross-platform mind mapping and brainstorming app with AI-assisted idea generation and a wide variety of diagram styles.

name: Zebra Medical Vision
description: AI radiology platform that reads medical imaging data to automatically detect a broad range of conditions and pathologies.

name: 10Web
description: 10Web is an AI-powered website builder and managed WordPress hosting platform. It lets you generate a complete website from a brief description, then fine-tune every section with a visual editor — no coding needed. Ideal for agencies and freelancers who need polished sites launched fast.

name: 15Five
description: 15Five is a performance management platform with AI-powered manager effectiveness tools, OKR tracking, and employee engagement surveys. Its Best-Self Review uses AI to help employees write self-reviews and gives managers real-time coaching suggestions. Over 3,000 companies use it to build high-performance cultures.

name: 6sense
description: 6sense is an AI-powered B2B revenue platform that uses intent data, predictive analytics, and account identification to reveal which accounts are actively researching your solution. Its AI prioritises target accounts by buying stage, enabling sales and marketing teams to engage the right accounts at the right time with personalised outreach.

name: Abridge
description: Abridge is an AI platform that records clinical conversations and automatically generates structured medical summaries and after-visit notes. Integrated with Epic, it allows physicians at major health systems including UPMC and Kaiser Permanente to capture comprehensive notes without typing, improving accuracy and reducing burnout.

name: ActiveCampaign AI
description: ActiveCampaign is a marketing automation and CRM platform with AI features including predictive sending, win probability scoring, and a generative AI assistant for email content. It automates complex marketing workflows based on customer behaviour across email, SMS, and landing pages.

name: Acuity Scheduling
description: Acuity Scheduling is an online appointment scheduling tool that lets clients book time with you 24/7. It syncs with your calendar, sends automatic reminders, collects intake forms, and processes payments — eliminating back-and-forth emails. Widely used by coaches, therapists, photographers, and other service businesses.

name: Ada
description: Ada is an AI-powered customer service automation platform that helps businesses deflect support tickets at scale. Its no-code chatbot builder lets teams create intelligent conversational flows without engineering resources. Ada integrates with major CRMs and helpdesks, resolving a large majority of enquiries automatically.

name: Ada Health
description: Ada Health is an AI-powered symptom assessment app that helps users understand potential causes of their symptoms. By asking a series of guided questions, it generates a personalised health report and recommends appropriate next steps. Used by millions globally and trusted by healthcare providers for triage support.

name: Adalo
description: Adalo is a no-code platform for building native iOS and Android apps visually. You drag components onto a canvas, connect them to a database, and publish directly to app stores — no programming required. It's popular with entrepreneurs and small teams who need functional mobile apps without a development budget.

name: AdCreative.ai
description: AdCreative.ai uses generative AI to produce high-converting ad creatives — banners, social ads, and display assets — in seconds. It analyses performance data to learn which visual styles and copy angles drive clicks for your audience. Marketers connect their ad accounts and get a steady stream of on-brand creatives ready to launch.

name: Adobe After Effects
description: Adobe After Effects is the industry-standard motion graphics and visual effects application, used for everything from title sequences to full compositing work. Recent AI features — including Content-Aware Fill for video and Rotobrush — dramatically reduce the manual work behind complex shots. It's a core tool for video editors, motion designers, and VFX artists.

name: Adobe Enhance Speech
description: Adobe Enhance Speech is a free online tool that uses AI to make voice recordings sound as if they were recorded in a professional studio. It removes background noise, room reverb, and equalises speech frequencies automatically. Podcasters, educators, and remote workers use it to rescue poor-quality recordings.

name: Adobe Firefly
description: Adobe Firefly is Adobe's family of generative AI models built directly into Creative Cloud apps like Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro. It lets creators generate images from text, extend photos with Generative Fill, recolour vector artwork, and produce video effects, all trained on licensed content for commercial safety. Firefly is designed for professional creatives who need AI that fits inside their existing workflow.

name: Adobe Lightroom AI
description: Adobe Lightroom's AI features have fundamentally changed photo editing workflows. AI Masking automatically selects subjects, skies, backgrounds, and people with one click. Denoise reconstructs detail in high-ISO shots. Enhanced Super Resolution doubles image resolution using AI. Generative Remove and Generative Expand (powered by Firefly) let photographers remove distractions and extend canvas. These tools have made Lightroom faster and more accessible for professional photographers while preserving the non-destructive RAW editing workflow it is known for.

name: Adobe Podcast
description: Adobe Podcast (now Adobe Enhance Speech) is a web-based AI audio tool that removes background noise and enhances voice recordings to studio quality. Podcasters and remote workers upload any audio clip and the AI scrubs hiss, echo, and ambient sound in seconds. It also offers a full AI-powered podcast recording and editing environment.

name: Adobe Premiere Pro AI
description: Adobe Premiere Pro's AI features — collectively called AI tools in Premiere — have transformed professional video editing. Speech to Text automatically generates searchable transcripts and captions. Auto Reframe intelligently crops footage for different aspect ratios. Enhance Speech removes noise and improves audio quality with one click. Generative Extend fills gaps between clips with AI-synthesised frames. These features, powered by Adobe Sensei and Firefly, are built into the industry-standard editor that most professional video editors already use daily.

name: Adobe Sensei
description: Adobe Sensei is the AI and machine learning platform embedded across Adobe's entire product suite — Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Lightroom, InDesign, and more. It powers features like Generative Fill, Neural Filters, Auto Reframe, Speech to Text, and Content-Aware Fill that have become standard tools in creative workflows. With Sensei, Adobe has integrated generative AI into the tools professionals already use rather than building a separate product, making it the AI platform with the most working creative professionals as daily users.

name: ADP
description: ADP is one of the world's largest human capital management platforms, covering payroll, benefits, talent, and time-tracking for businesses of every size. Its AI layer surfaces workforce insights, flags compliance risks, and automates routine HR tasks. ADP serves over 900,000 companies across 140 countries.

name: Agent GPT
description: AgentGPT is an open-source platform that lets you deploy autonomous AI agents directly in your browser without any setup. You give the agent a goal, and it breaks the task into sub-tasks, executes them with web access and code tools, and reports back. It's a beginner-friendly way to explore what autonomous AI agents can accomplish.

name: Agno
description: Agno is an open-source, high-performance Python framework for building production-grade AI agents and agent teams. It supports memory, knowledge bases, tools, and structured outputs with a clean API. Agno agents are 10,000x faster to instantiate than LangGraph agents, making it popular for latency-sensitive production applications.

name: Ahrefs
description: Ahrefs is a comprehensive SEO toolset covering backlink analysis, keyword research, site auditing, rank tracking, and content gap analysis. Its crawler indexes the web continuously, giving SEOs near-real-time data on competitor link profiles and organic rankings. It's widely regarded as the most extensive backlink database in the industry.

name: AI Dungeon
description: AI Dungeon is an AI-driven text adventure where GPT-4 creates and responds to any story direction the player chooses. Unlike traditional games with scripted outcomes, AI Dungeon generates entirely new narratives based on player input, enabling genuinely unlimited storytelling across any genre or setting.

name: AI For Developer
description: AI For Developer is a curated directory of AI tools specifically selected for software developers, covering code assistants, API platforms, dev-focused LLMs, and productivity tools. It helps engineers quickly discover and evaluate the right AI utilities for their stack. The site includes integration guides and use-case breakdowns.

name: AI-Writer
description: AI-Writer generates full-length blog articles from a headline with cited sources, SEO analysis, and a verifiable AI text indicator. Unlike many AI writers that hallucinate, AI-Writer grounds its content in real web sources and provides footnotes for every claim, making it suitable for factual content production.

name: AI21 Labs
description: AI21 Labs is an Israeli AI company known for its Jamba series of models — hybrid architectures combining Mamba state-space layers with transformers for exceptional speed and long-context performance. Its enterprise platform offers document intelligence, text analysis, and custom fine-tuning, with a strong focus on factual accuracy and reduced hallucination. AI21's Wordtune product (the writing assistant) is its most consumer-facing offering, while its API and enterprise deployments serve industries where reliability and grounded outputs are paramount.

name: AIDir.wiki
description: AIDir.wiki is a community-maintained wiki-style directory cataloguing hundreds of AI tools, models, and services. Each entry covers pricing, key features, use cases, and user ratings. It serves as a living reference for anyone navigating the rapidly expanding AI landscape.

name: Aidoc
description: Aidoc is an AI medical imaging company that provides radiologists with real-time AI triage for critical findings across the body. Its FDA-cleared algorithms detect pulmonary embolism, intracranial haemorrhage, aortic dissection, and other time-sensitive conditions, ensuring the most urgent cases are reviewed first.

name: Airbyte
description: Airbyte is an open-source data integration platform with 300+ pre-built connectors for syncing data from any source to any destination. Its AI assistant helps users build custom connectors from documentation and debug sync failures with natural language explanations.

name: Airtable
description: Airtable is a flexible no-code database and spreadsheet hybrid that powers everything from content calendars to product roadmaps. Its AI features can generate field formulas, summarise records, and classify data automatically. Teams appreciate how quickly a non-engineer can build a relational app without writing SQL.

name: AIVA
description: AIVA (Artificial Intelligence Virtual Artist) is an AI music composition platform trained on classical works to generate original soundtracks for films, video games, and commercials. Users can specify the mood, instrumentation, key, and tempo, then download royalty-free tracks. It is officially recognised as a composer by SACEM.

name: AIVE
description: AIVE is an AI video enhancement platform focused on upscaling and improving the visual quality of existing footage. It uses deep-learning super-resolution models to sharpen detail, reduce noise, and increase resolution up to 4K. Post-production teams and video creators use it to rescue archival or low-quality footage.

name: Ajelix
description: Ajelix is an AI assistant for spreadsheet power users that explains existing formulas in plain English and generates new ones from a text description. It supports both Excel and Google Sheets and can also spot errors, suggest optimisations, and write complex VBA or Apps Script macros. A big time-saver for analysts who spend hours writing or debugging formulas.

name: AlphaFold
description: AlphaFold by DeepMind solved one of biology's grand challenges — predicting the 3D structure of proteins from their amino acid sequence with atomic accuracy. Its database of over 200 million protein structures is freely available and has accelerated research into disease mechanisms, drug targets, and enzyme engineering across thousands of labs.

name: AlphaSense
description: AlphaSense is an AI-powered market intelligence platform used by finance professionals to search across earnings calls, SEC filings, broker research, and news in seconds. Its semantic search understands financial language and surfaces insights that keyword search would miss. Hedge funds, investment banks, and corporate strategy teams use it to compress research time.

name: Altered AI
description: Altered AI is a professional voice transformation platform that changes a speaker's voice to any of its AI voice styles in real time or post-production. Voice actors, game studios, and audiobook producers use it to quickly produce content in multiple character voices without additional recording sessions.

name: Altern
description: Altern is an AI tools discovery platform that curates and ranks AI products by category, use case, and user ratings. It covers thousands of tools from niche utilities to flagship models, helping users cut through the noise. The site refreshes daily and includes filters for pricing tier, platform, and task type.

name: Amazon Bedrock
description: Amazon Bedrock is AWS's fully managed service for accessing foundation models from Anthropic (Claude), Meta (Llama), Mistral, Stability AI, and Amazon's own Titan models through a single API. It handles infrastructure, security, and compliance, making it the default choice for enterprises already in the AWS ecosystem that want to build AI applications without managing model servers. Features include fine-tuning, knowledge bases for RAG, AI Agents for workflow automation, and Guardrails for responsible AI deployment.

name: Amazon CodeWhisperer
description: Amazon CodeWhisperer is an AI coding assistant from AWS that provides real-time code suggestions tailored to the developer's context. It integrates with VS Code, JetBrains, and AWS Cloud9, and has built-in security scanning to flag vulnerabilities. Its AWS-aware suggestions make it especially useful for serverless, Lambda, and CDK workloads.

name: Amplenote
description: Amplenote merges note-taking, task management, and calendar into a single tool with an AI writing assistant built in. Its unique 'task score' algorithm surfaces the most important tasks based on urgency, importance, and time investment. Writers and researchers use it for idea capture and daily planning.

name: Amplitude AI
description: Amplitude is a product analytics platform that uses AI to help teams understand user behaviour, identify growth opportunities, and predict churn. Its Ask Amplitude feature lets product managers query data in plain English and receive chart responses instantly. Over 3,500 companies use it to build better digital products.

name: Andi
description: Andi is an ad-free, conversational AI search engine that answers questions directly instead of returning a list of links. It combines a generative AI model with live web search to provide summarised, cited answers. It also includes tools to summarise web pages and explain concepts.

name: Anima
description: Anima converts Figma and Sketch designs into clean, responsive React, Vue, or HTML code. It also generates prototypes directly from design files for user testing. Development teams use it to accelerate design-to-code handoff and keep developers focused on logic rather than layout.

name: Animaker
description: Animaker is a browser-based animated video creation platform with a vast library of characters, backgrounds, and props. Its AI features include an AI-powered voiceover generator with 200+ voices in 50 languages, auto lip-sync, and an AI video script assistant. HR and marketing teams use it for onboarding and explainer videos.

name: AnythingLLM
description: AnythingLLM is an open-source, all-in-one desktop application and self-hostable server for building private AI workspaces. It connects to any LLM — local via Ollama or cloud via OpenAI, Anthropic, or others — and lets users chat with their own documents (PDFs, Word files, websites, YouTube videos) using RAG. Workspaces keep conversations and document contexts separate, making it suitable for managing multiple projects or clients. AnythingLLM requires no technical setup and runs entirely on the user's own hardware.

name: Anytype
description: Anytype is a local-first knowledge management and productivity tool that stores data encrypted on your device rather than in the cloud. It combines notes, tasks, databases, and wikis in a flexible block editor with AI features including AI writing assistance and semantic search. Designed as a privacy-respecting alternative to Notion.

name: Anyword
description: Anyword is an AI copywriting platform built around performance prediction — it scores every headline, ad, and email subject line before you publish. The AI generates multiple copy variations and ranks them by predicted conversion rate based on training data from billions of ad impressions. Marketers and performance teams use it to ship copy that's already optimised.

name: Apollo
description: Apollo.io is an all-in-one B2B sales intelligence and engagement platform with a database of over 275 million contacts. It combines prospecting, email sequencing, calling, and CRM enrichment so sales reps can build pipeline without switching tools. AI features suggest the best-fit prospects, personalise outreach, and surface timing signals like job changes and funding rounds.

name: Apple Maps
description: Apple Maps is the native mapping and navigation app on all Apple devices, offering turn-by-turn directions, real-time traffic, transit info, and local business search. Its AI-powered features include immersive city experiences, accurate street-level detail, and privacy-respecting location intelligence. It's the default map experience for over a billion iPhone and Mac users.

name: AppSheet
description: AppSheet is Google's no-code platform for building mobile and web applications directly from spreadsheet and database data. Its AI-powered app creation assistant generates a functional app from a description, and automation rules can trigger actions based on data changes. Enterprises use it to replace manual processes with mobile workflows.

name: Arc Browser
description: Arc is a browser by The Browser Company that rethinks how people interact with the web, built with AI as a first-class feature. Arc Search on iOS uses AI to synthesise multiple search results into a single browseable summary rather than a list of links. On desktop, Arc Max features include Ask on Page (ask questions about the page you are reading), 5-second previews, and AI-generated tab titles and folder names. Arc has become the browser of choice for many tech workers and developers looking for a more intelligent daily browsing experience.

name: Artbreeder
description: Artbreeder lets users create and evolve images by blending existing ones using generative models. It supports portraits, landscapes, anime characters, and abstract art. Its 'genes' system lets anyone adjust style, colour, and composition sliders and share creations with a large collaborative community.

name: Article Forge
description: Article Forge generates unique, full-length articles from a keyword using AI trained on billions of web pages. It understands topics deeply enough to research, write, and structure articles automatically, including relevant headings, images, and videos. SEO agencies use it for bulk content production across niche sites.

name: Asana
description: Asana is a leading work management platform that helps teams plan projects, assign tasks, set deadlines, and track progress in one place. Its AI assistant can draft project plans, summarise status updates, and surface at-risk tasks before they derail timelines. Asana is used by over 130,000 paying organisations, from startups to Fortune 500 companies.

name: Attention Insight
description: Attention Insight uses AI to predict where users will focus their attention on any design or webpage within seconds, without needing live users. It generates attention heatmaps based on models trained on thousands of eye-tracking studies, helping designers optimise layouts before launching.

name: Attentive
description: Attentive is an AI-powered conversational marketing platform focused on personalised SMS and email for e-commerce and retail. Its AI sends the right message to the right subscriber at the optimal time based on purchase history and engagement patterns. Over 8,000 brands use it to drive significant revenue from text message marketing.

name: Auphonic
description: Auphonic is an AI-powered audio post-processing service that automatically normalises loudness, removes noise, balances multiple speakers, and adds chapter markers to audio files. Podcasters, radio producers, and video creators use it to deliver broadcast-quality audio without manual mixing.

name: AutoGen
description: AutoGen is Microsoft's open-source framework for building multi-agent AI systems where multiple specialised AI agents collaborate to solve complex tasks. Agents can write code, execute it, review results, and iterate autonomously. It is widely used in research and enterprise automation for tasks requiring multiple expert perspectives.

name: AutoGPT
description: AutoGPT is an open-source experiment that gives GPT-4 long-term memory and internet access so it can pursue multi-step goals autonomously. You specify an objective, and the agent continuously plans, searches, writes code, and evaluates its own output until the goal is reached. It sparked the modern autonomous AI agent movement and remains a widely forked reference implementation.

name: Avoma
description: Avoma is an AI meeting lifecycle platform that records, transcribes, and analyses customer-facing meetings for sales and customer success teams. Beyond transcription, it identifies talk ratios, monologue lengths, question rates, and topic patterns to give managers data-driven coaching insights. It integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, and other CRMs to auto-populate call notes, and its revenue intelligence features surface deals at risk before they churn. Teams use it to reduce manual CRM data entry and improve rep performance through objective conversation analysis.

name: AWS GovCloud
description: AWS GovCloud is Amazon's isolated cloud region designed to host sensitive US government workloads with FedRAMP High, DoD IL2–IL5, and ITAR compliance. Agencies use it to run AI/ML pipelines, analytics, and mission-critical apps on the same infrastructure as commercial AWS — but within a security boundary that meets federal requirements.

name: Azure OpenAI Service
description: Azure OpenAI Service provides enterprise access to GPT-4, DALL-E, Whisper, and other OpenAI models through Microsoft Azure's infrastructure, with the compliance, security, and SLA guarantees that regulated industries require. Data processed through Azure OpenAI is not used to train OpenAI models, making it the choice for healthcare, finance, and government organisations with strict data handling requirements. It integrates natively with other Azure services, Azure Active Directory for identity management, and supports private endpoints for fully isolated deployments.

name: Babbel
description: Babbel is an AI-enhanced language learning app that teaches real conversational skills through short, structured lessons created by language experts. Its speech-recognition engine evaluates your pronunciation in real time and adapts lesson difficulty to your pace. Over 10 million active subscribers use Babbel to prepare for travel, business, or daily life in a new language.

name: Babylon Health
description: Babylon Health is a digital healthcare platform that combines an AI symptom checker with GP appointments, mental health support, and health monitoring. The AI triage engine assesses symptoms and routes patients to the right level of care — from self-care advice to urgent in-person referral. It has provided consultations to millions of patients across the UK, US, and sub-Saharan Africa.

name: Balto
description: Balto provides real-time AI guidance to call centre agents during live calls, prompting them with the best next response, compliance alerts, and objection-handling scripts. Unlike post-call analytics tools, Balto intervenes in the moment to improve outcomes, reducing average handle time and increasing conversion rates.

name: BambooHR
description: BambooHR is a cloud-based HR software platform for small and mid-sized companies, covering employee records, onboarding, performance management, and time tracking. Its AI features automate routine people ops tasks, surface turnover risk signals, and benchmark compensation. HR teams value how quickly employees can be onboarded and how little admin the platform requires.

name: Beatoven.ai
description: Beatoven.ai generates unique, royalty-free background music customised to the mood and pace of your video or podcast. Users select a genre, mood, and duration, and the AI composes original tracks that adapt dynamically to content sections. YouTubers, filmmakers, and game developers use it to avoid copyright issues.

name: Beautiful.ai
description: Beautiful.ai is an AI-powered presentation tool that auto-formats slides as you add content, keeping designs consistently polished without manual tweaking. Smart slide templates adapt to your data: charts resize, images recrop, and layouts adjust automatically. It's popular with business teams who need professional-looking decks without a design background.

name: BeFunky
description: BeFunky is an online photo editor and graphic design platform with AI-powered tools including AI photo enhancer, background remover, face retouching, and cartoonizer. It also includes a collage maker and hundreds of design templates, making it popular for quick social media graphics.

name: BenevolentAI
description: BenevolentAI uses biomedical knowledge graphs and machine learning to identify novel drug targets and predict how molecules will interact with biological systems. It focuses on diseases with high unmet medical need and has active collaborations with AstraZeneca for atopic dermatitis and heart failure.

name: Betterworks
description: Betterworks is an enterprise performance enablement platform that uses AI to align OKRs, streamline performance reviews, and generate coaching insights. Its AI writing assistant helps managers and employees write effective goals and feedback, while analytics identify which performance signals predict employee success and retention.

name: BigCommerce
description: BigCommerce is an enterprise ecommerce platform powering thousands of online stores, offering built-in SEO tools, multi-channel selling, and headless commerce capabilities. Its AI features assist with product descriptions, personalised recommendations, and conversion optimisation. It's a strong choice for high-growth brands that have outgrown Shopify and need more native flexibility.

name: BILL AI
description: BILL (formerly Bill.com) is a financial operations platform for small and medium businesses that uses AI to automate accounts payable and receivable. Its AI extracts invoice data, matches purchase orders, and categorises expenses automatically. Over 450,000 SMBs use BILL to digitise their financial back-office.

name: Microsoft Copilot
description: Microsoft Copilot is the AI assistant integrated throughout Microsoft's ecosystem — available in Windows, Edge, Bing, and as a standalone app powered by GPT-4o and Bing's real-time web index. It answers complex questions with cited sources, generates images via DALL-E 3, drafts content, and assists with code entirely for free. For Microsoft 365 subscribers, Copilot extends into Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Outlook as a deeply embedded productivity layer.

name: Biteable
description: Biteable is an online video maker designed for business teams to create professional-looking videos quickly. Its AI tools include automated scene suggestions for scripts, smart resizing for different platforms, and a library of 1.8 million clips and animations. HR, marketing, and sales teams use it for internal and external communications.

name: Bito AI
description: Bito is an AI coding assistant that integrates GPT-4 directly into VS Code, JetBrains, and the CLI. Beyond code completion, Bito excels at explaining complex code, writing tests, checking for security vulnerabilities, and generating docstrings. It lets teams create AI personas trained on their own codebases and coding standards.

name: Blackbox AI
description: Blackbox AI is a code-focused AI assistant available as a VS Code extension, web editor, and standalone app. It provides real-time code completion, a chat interface for asking coding questions, and the ability to extract code from images and videos — useful when reading tutorials or Stack Overflow screenshots. With a large free tier and support for 20+ programming languages, it has attracted millions of users as an accessible entry point to AI-assisted development.

name: Blue Yonder
description: Blue Yonder (now part of Panasonic) is an AI-driven supply chain platform that covers demand forecasting, inventory optimisation, transportation management, and warehouse automation. Its machine-learning models analyse thousands of variables to help retailers and manufacturers reduce stock-outs, cut carrying costs, and improve on-time delivery. Customers include major global retailers and CPG companies.

name: Boomerang
description: Boomerang for Gmail is an email productivity extension that adds AI-powered features like Respondable — which scores your email's likelihood of getting a reply before you send. It also lets you schedule messages for optimal delivery times, set follow-up reminders, and pause your inbox. Used by over 5 million professionals to bring inbox zero within reach.

name: Boomy
description: Boomy lets anyone create original AI-generated songs in seconds across genres including lo-fi, EDM, pop, and cinematic. Users can then submit their tracks to streaming platforms like Spotify and earn royalties. With over 20 million songs created, Boomy is one of the largest AI music creation communities.

name: Botkeeper
description: Botkeeper uses AI and machine learning to automate bookkeeping tasks for accounting firms, including transaction categorisation, bank reconciliation, and month-end close. It integrates with QuickBooks, Xero, and major banking systems, allowing accounting firms to scale their bookkeeping capacity without hiring.

name: Brandmark
description: Brandmark is an AI logo maker that generates unique logo options from your brand name, industry, and style preferences. It produces vector-format files alongside a full brand kit — colour palette, typography, business card layouts, and social media assets. Startups and freelancers use it to get a professional identity without hiring a designer.

name: Brandwatch
description: Brandwatch is an enterprise social intelligence platform that uses AI to monitor billions of online conversations for brand mentions, sentiment trends, and emerging topics. Its analytics suite lets marketers compare brand health against competitors and detect crises early. PR teams, CMOs, and consumer insights analysts rely on it for real-time audience understanding.

name: Brave Leo
description: Leo is the AI assistant built directly into the Brave browser, available on desktop and mobile. It can summarise web pages, answer questions about the content you're reading, translate text, write code, and hold general conversations — all without your queries being sent to a third-party AI service in identifiable form. Leo uses a mix of models including Claude, Llama, and Mixtral, and its privacy-preserving architecture has made it a favourite among privacy-focused users who want AI assistance without data collection.

name: Brevo AI
description: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) is an all-in-one marketing platform with AI-driven email campaign generation, send-time optimisation, and a generative AI writing assistant. It offers email, SMS, WhatsApp marketing, and a built-in CRM, making it popular with SMBs managing marketing across multiple channels.

name: Brilliant
description: Brilliant is an interactive learning platform specialising in maths, data science, and computer science through guided problem-solving rather than passive video lectures. Its AI adapts the difficulty curve to each learner's pace and highlights knowledge gaps. Professionals and students use Brilliant to build genuine quantitative intuition in 15-minute daily sessions.

name: Bubble
description: Bubble is a no-code visual programming platform that lets non-developers build fully functional web applications with custom logic, databases, and user authentication. Its AI assistant can generate page layouts and data structures from a natural-language description. Bubble hosts tens of thousands of production apps, from SaaS MVPs to marketplace platforms.

name: Buffer
description: Buffer is a social media management tool that lets you schedule posts across Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and TikTok from one dashboard. Its AI assistant helps draft captions, suggests optimal posting times, and analyses which content formats drive the most engagement. Ideal for small businesses and solo creators who want consistent social presence without daily effort.

name: Buoy Health
description: Buoy Health is an AI-powered symptom checker and health navigation tool that guides users to the most appropriate level of care based on their symptoms. The conversational AI asks follow-up questions to narrow down possible conditions and recommends whether to self-treat, see a telehealth provider, or visit an ER. It's embedded in several health system websites to reduce unnecessary emergency visits.

name: Busuu
description: Busuu is a language learning app that combines AI-driven lessons with real corrections from native speakers around the world. Its adaptive curriculum covers speaking, writing, grammar, and vocabulary, with a certification programme recognised by McGill University. The community feedback loop makes it one of the few apps where you practise with humans, not just bots.

name: Buzzsprout
description: Buzzsprout is a podcast hosting platform designed to make publishing, distributing, and growing a podcast as simple as possible. It automatically optimises audio quality on upload, submits your feed to all major directories, and provides chapter markers and transcripts. Podcasters appreciate its clean analytics dashboard that shows downloads, listener locations, and episode performance.

name: Calendly
description: Calendly is the most widely used scheduling automation tool, letting recipients book meetings directly into your calendar based on your real availability. It eliminates the back-and-forth of finding a time by sharing a booking link, and AI-powered features now suggest meeting slots and draft follow-up emails. Integrated with Zoom, Google Meet, Salesforce, and dozens of other tools.

name: Canva
description: Canva is a browser-based design platform used by over 170 million people to create social media graphics, presentations, videos, and marketing materials. Its AI suite — Magic Write, Magic Edit, and Magic Design — lets you generate and edit visuals from text prompts inside the familiar drag-and-drop editor. No design experience is needed to produce polished, professional-grade output.

name: Capacity
description: Capacity is an AI-powered support automation platform that connects to your entire tech stack and uses AI to answer employee and customer questions automatically. It handles IT helpdesk tickets, HR inquiries, customer support queries, and internal knowledge base searches through a single conversational interface.

name: Captions AI
description: Captions is an AI-powered video creation app that automatically generates subtitles, removes filler words, and edits eye contact in real time. Content creators use it to produce polished talking-head videos for social media without manual editing. Its AI avatar feature also lets users create videos without appearing on camera.

name: Carbon Trust
description: The Carbon Trust helps organisations measure, reduce, and report their carbon footprint, offering advisory services, standards certification, and data analytics tools. Its AI-powered platform accelerates Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions calculations by ingesting operational data and benchmarking against industry peers. Governments and multinational corporations use Carbon Trust to build credible net-zero strategies.

name: Carnegie Learning
description: Carnegie Learning develops AI-powered maths curricula grounded in cognitive science research. Its MATHia software provides one-on-one intelligent tutoring that models each student's knowledge, identifies misconceptions, and delivers targeted instruction. Used in thousands of schools across the US, it has been shown to significantly improve maths outcomes.

name: Cartesia
description: Cartesia builds state-space-model-based voice AI optimised for real-time, ultra-low-latency speech synthesis — producing natural voices in under 90ms end-to-end. Its Sonic model is designed for voice agents, phone bots, and interactive applications where a 500ms delay would break the conversational feel. Cartesia's API supports voice cloning, emotion control, and multilingual synthesis, and it's become a preferred TTS provider for companies building real-time voice AI products where ElevenLabs' latency is too high.

name: Casetext
description: Casetext is a legal AI company founded in 2013, backed by Y Combinator and Union Square Ventures. It started as a community platform where attorneys could annotate and share case law, then spent a decade gradually moving toward automated legal workflows. CoCounsel, its GPT-4-powered assistant launched in March 2023, is where that decade of work landed. CoCounsel drafts legal research memos, reviews and summarizes documents, builds deposition prep packages from discovery files, and analyzes contracts for missing clauses and risk terms. It covers both litigation and transactional work, which is less common than it sounds; most legal AI tools pick a lane. The deposition prep feature in particular is the kind of thing that previously took a junior associate a full day. Before launch, Casetext's Trust Team put CoCounsel through more than 30,000 legal questions, logging close to 4,000 hours of fine-tuning. The company had received early access to GPT-4 from OpenAI, and that head start showed. The product launched already shaped around real legal tasks rather than retrofitted from general chat. Thomson Reuters acquired Casetext in August 2023 for $650 million cash. The company had over 10,000 law firm and corporate legal department customers at the time. CoCounsel is now part of the Thomson Reuters product line, sitting alongside Westlaw and Practical Law.

name: Causal
description: Causal is a financial modelling and planning tool that replaces complex spreadsheets with an intuitive visual interface. Its AI features let finance teams build models from natural language descriptions, auto-generate scenario analyses, and create interactive dashboards for board presentations.

name: CB Insights
description: CB Insights is a market intelligence platform that uses AI to analyse millions of data points across startups, investors, corporates, and technologies. Its AI surfaces emerging trends, maps competitive landscapes, and identifies potential acquisition targets, used by strategy teams at Fortune 500 companies.

name: Cerebras
description: Cerebras builds the world's largest AI chips — wafer-scale processors the size of a dinner plate — and uses them to deliver inference speeds up to 2,000+ tokens per second, making it the fastest publicly available AI inference platform. Its cloud service runs Llama and other open models at speeds that enable real-time applications previously impossible with GPU-based systems. Enterprises with ultra-low-latency requirements for voice AI, trading, and real-time analysis are its primary customers, and its inference API is available to developers.

name: Charisma.ai
description: Charisma.ai is an AI platform for creating interactive narrative experiences with characters that hold genuine, branching conversations. Game developers and experience designers use it to give NPCs dynamic dialogue that responds to player choices rather than following scripted trees. It integrates with Unity, Unreal Engine, and web platforms.

name: CharlieHR
description: CharlieHR is HR software designed for small companies that simplifies leave management, onboarding, document storage, and performance reviews. Its AI HR advisor answers HR policy questions and helps managers write job descriptions, review templates, and difficult conversation scripts with confidence.

name: Chatbase
description: Chatbase lets anyone build a custom AI chatbot trained on their own documents, website, PDFs, or Notion pages — no code required. The resulting chatbot can be embedded on a website, connected to Slack or WhatsApp, or accessed via API. Businesses use it for customer support, lead capture, and internal knowledge bases, replacing FAQ pages with a conversational interface powered by their own content. Chatbase became one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS products of 2023, reaching $1M ARR within months of launch.

name: ChatGPT
description: ChatGPT is OpenAI's flagship conversational AI, capable of answering questions, drafting documents, writing and explaining code, analysing data, and generating images. Powered by GPT-4o, it remembers context across a conversation and can read files, browse the web, and run code inside a sandbox. With over 200 million weekly active users, it's the most widely used AI assistant in the world.

name: ChatGPT Canvas
description: Canvas is a collaborative workspace inside ChatGPT that opens a side-by-side editor for writing and coding projects. Instead of getting a code block in the chat, Canvas gives you a full editor where ChatGPT can make targeted edits, add comments, suggest rewrites for specific sections, and adjust length or reading level — all without regenerating the entire document. For code, it adds inline debugging, unit test generation, and language translation. Canvas represents a shift from ChatGPT as a chatbot to ChatGPT as a collaborative working environment.

name: Chegg AI
description: Chegg is a student-focused learning platform now heavily powered by AI. Its CheggMate AI assistant (built on GPT-4) provides step-by-step homework help, concept explanations, and essay assistance. Combined with textbook solutions and expert tutors, Chegg serves millions of college students navigating difficult coursework.

name: Chibi AI
description: Chibi AI is a creative writing assistant focused on long-form content including blog posts, essays, and fiction. It offers a minimalist writing environment with AI that can continue your text, rewrite sections, or generate content from a brief. Writers appreciate its focus on creative output over SEO templates.

name: Chorus.ai
description: Chorus.ai by ZoomInfo is a conversation intelligence platform that records, transcribes, and analyses sales calls and meetings. Its AI surfaces deal risks, competitor mentions, and coaching opportunities. Sales managers use it to identify winning behaviours and replicate them across their team.

name: Civitai
description: Civitai is the largest community platform for sharing and discovering Stable Diffusion models, LoRAs, embeddings, and AI-generated art. Users upload fine-tuned models trained on specific styles, characters, or subjects, and the community rates and reviews them. With millions of models and tens of millions of generated images, it has become the primary destination for anyone looking to customise their local image generation setup. Civitai also runs a cloud generation service for those who prefer not to run models locally.

name: Claap
description: Claap lets teams record short async video messages and meeting recordings, then uses AI to generate transcripts, summaries, and searchable indexes. It acts as a video knowledge base where teams can find decisions and discussions from past recordings using natural language search.

name: Clari
description: Clari is an AI-powered revenue operations platform that analyses CRM data, activity signals, and conversation intelligence to provide accurate sales forecasts. Its AI identifies at-risk deals, prioritises accounts, and automates pipeline inspection. Enterprise sales organisations use it to reduce forecasting variance and increase win rates.

name: Claude
description: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant, known for being thoughtful, nuanced, and safe for sensitive tasks. It excels at long-form writing, detailed analysis, coding assistance, and reasoning through complex problems, with a famously large context window that can process entire books or codebases. Claude is available on the web, via API, and through enterprise integrations for teams.

name: Claude Code
description: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding CLI that runs in your terminal and operates directly on your codebase. Unlike IDE plugins that assist with individual lines, Claude Code reads entire repositories, plans multi-step implementations, writes and edits files, runs tests, and fixes failures iteratively, all from a conversation in the terminal. It can complete tasks that span dozens of files and hundreds of lines with a single instruction. Claude Code has become a favourite among experienced developers for complex refactors, debugging deep bugs, and implementing features end-to-end.

name: Claude 4
description: Claude 4 is Anthropic's latest generation of large language models, with Opus 4.7 as the most capable, Sonnet 4.6 as the balanced workhorse, and Haiku 4.5 as the fastest and most affordable. All models feature a 200k-token context window, strong coding and reasoning ability, and Constitutional AI safety training. Developers access the family via the Anthropic API to build everything from document-analysis pipelines to fully autonomous coding agents.

name: Cleanfeed
description: Cleanfeed is a browser-based remote recording platform used by radio producers, podcasters, and audio engineers to capture studio-quality audio from guests anywhere in the world. Its AI noise gate and audio processing chain ensures clean, consistent recordings across different microphones and room acoustics.

name: Cleanup.pictures
description: Cleanup.pictures uses AI inpainting to remove unwanted objects, people, text, and watermarks from photos with a simple brush tool. The AI fills the removed area with realistic background content. Photographers, real estate agents, and product marketers use it to clean up images without manual Photoshop work.

name: Cleanvoice
description: Cleanvoice is an AI audio editing tool that automatically removes filler words (um, uh, like), mouth sounds, stutters, and dead silence from podcast and video recordings. Editors upload a file and Cleanvoice returns a cleaned version in minutes, eliminating hours of manual editing. It handles multiple languages and accents, and offers a timeline view for reviewing and approving each edit before export. Podcasters and video creators use it to cut post-production time dramatically without the cost of a professional audio editor.

name: Clickup
description: ClickUp is an all-in-one productivity platform that combines tasks, docs, whiteboards, goals, and time tracking in a single app. Its AI assistant, ClickUp Brain, can write project briefs, summarise threads, generate action items from meetings, and answer questions about your workspace data. Hundreds of thousands of teams use ClickUp as a replacement for multiple fragmented tools.

name: Clideo
description: Clideo is a suite of browser-based video tools including an editor, compressor, converter, merger, and subtitler. Its AI-powered auto subtitle feature transcribes video in 30+ languages and adds styled captions. No download required, making it the go-to for quick video tasks without installing software.

name: ClimaCell
description: Tomorrow.io (formerly ClimaCell) is an AI-driven weather intelligence platform that provides hyper-localised, minute-by-minute forecasts and weather impact analytics for businesses. Airlines, logistics companies, and outdoor event operators use Tomorrow.io APIs to automatically adjust operations based on precise weather predictions. Its proprietary sensing technology supplements radar and satellite data with cellular network signals for superior hyperlocal accuracy.

name: Climate FieldView
description: Climate FieldView by Bayer is a precision agriculture platform that collects, stores, and visualises field data from planting through harvest. AI-powered analytics help farmers identify yield-limiting factors, optimise input applications, and benchmark performance across fields. It integrates with most major farm equipment brands to pull data automatically from machinery sensors.

name: Climate TRACE
description: Climate TRACE is a non-profit coalition that uses satellite imagery, remote sensing, and AI to independently track greenhouse gas emissions from every major source on Earth. Its open dataset covers over 352 million individual emission sources — power plants, shipping lanes, oil fields — updated annually without relying on self-reported government figures. Researchers, journalists, and policymakers use it to hold emitters accountable.

name: Clockwise
description: Clockwise is an AI calendar assistant that automatically optimises meeting schedules to create blocks of uninterrupted Focus Time. It reschedules flexible meetings across teams to minimise context-switching, balances workloads, and can schedule meetings via natural language with its Prism AI assistant.

name: Coda AI
description: Coda is an all-in-one document platform that blends the power of documents, spreadsheets, and mini-apps. Its AI assistant can summarise docs, draft content, run table formulas in plain English, and automate workflows. Teams use Coda to build internal tools, OKR trackers, and product specs without code.

name: Codeium
description: Codeium is a free AI-powered code completion and chat tool that works inside VS Code, JetBrains, Neovim, and 40+ other editors. It offers real-time autocomplete, natural-language code search, and an in-editor chat assistant powered by its own foundation models. Unlike many rivals it has a generous free tier with no token limits.

name: CodeRabbit
description: CodeRabbit provides AI-powered code reviews on every pull request, suggesting improvements to code quality, identifying bugs, flagging security issues, and checking for adherence to best practices. It integrates with GitHub and GitLab and learns from feedback over time to align with team preferences.

name: Codiga
description: Codiga provides real-time code analysis for security, code quality, and coding standards directly in the IDE. Its AI coding assistant suggests code snippets from public and private libraries and flags violations as you type. Teams use it to enforce consistent coding patterns and catch security issues before code review.

name: Colossyan
description: Colossyan is an AI video creation platform that generates professional-looking training and corporate videos using realistic AI avatars. It supports 70+ languages, script-to-video generation, and screen recording with AI presenter overlays. L&D teams use it to localise training content across global markets without reshooting.

name: ComfyUI
description: ComfyUI is an open-source, node-based graphical interface for building advanced Stable Diffusion pipelines. Users wire together nodes — for models, samplers, LoRAs, ControlNets, upscalers, and more — to create reusable workflows that go far beyond what any prompt box can do. The community has built thousands of shared workflows and custom nodes covering video generation, face swapping, 3D, and more. It has become the power-user standard for anyone doing serious local image generation.

name: Compass
description: Compass is a technology-driven real estate brokerage that equips agents with AI tools for pricing, marketing, and deal management. Its platform surfaces comparable sales, generates personalised listing recommendations, and automates the paperwork-heavy parts of a transaction. Buyers and sellers benefit from agents who have better data and fewer manual bottlenecks.

name: Compose AI
description: Compose AI is a Chrome extension that adds AI autocomplete to any text field on the web — email, Notion, Google Docs, LinkedIn, and more. It learns your writing style over time and offers inline completions, rephrase suggestions, and email reply drafts without switching apps.

name: Composio
description: Composio is a platform that provides 250+ pre-built tool integrations — GitHub, Slack, Notion, HubSpot, and more — for AI agents and LLM applications. Instead of building each integration from scratch, developers connect their AI agents to Composio's managed toolset and handle authentication, reliability, and maintenance automatically.

name: Consensus
description: Consensus is an AI-powered academic search engine that extracts key findings directly from peer-reviewed papers. Instead of returning a list of links, it synthesises what the science actually says on a question and cites the specific studies. Researchers, students, and evidence-curious professionals use it to get reliable answers grounded in published literature.

name: Content at Scale
description: Content at Scale generates long-form, research-backed blog posts from a keyword, URL, or YouTube video that are designed to pass AI detection tools. It synthesises information from multiple web sources, structures articles with proper headings, and delivers SEO-optimised drafts. Agencies use it to produce hundreds of articles per month.

name: ContentStudio
description: ContentStudio is an all-in-one content marketing platform that discovers trending content, helps plan and create posts with AI, and schedules across social media and blogs. Its AI writer generates captions, hashtags, and blog posts. Agencies use it to manage multiple client accounts efficiently.

name: Conversica
description: Conversica provides AI Revenue Digital Assistants that autonomously engage leads via email and SMS with human-like two-way conversations. The AI follows up persistently until prospects are ready to talk to a human, qualifying them and booking meetings. Marketing and sales teams use it to ensure no lead is left uncontacted.

name: Copy.ai
description: Copy.ai is an AI writing tool that generates marketing copy, email sequences, social captions, product descriptions, and sales scripts from short prompts. Its library of 90+ templates covers virtually every marketing content type, and a built-in workflow engine lets teams automate repetitive copy production. It's one of the fastest tools for going from brief to first draft.

name: Copyleaks
description: Copyleaks is a plagiarism detection and AI content identification platform that scans text for both traditional plagiarism and AI-generated content. It supports 100+ languages and integrates with Moodle, Canvas, and major LMS platforms. Educational institutions use it to maintain academic integrity in the age of generative AI.

name: CoreWeave
description: CoreWeave is a specialized GPU cloud provider focused exclusively on AI, machine learning, and visual compute workloads. It offers NVIDIA H100, A100, and L40S GPUs with bare-metal performance and Kubernetes orchestration. AI companies, model providers, and research labs use CoreWeave for large-scale training and inference that requires predictable GPU capacity.

name: Coursera
description: Coursera is an online learning platform that partners with top universities and companies — Stanford, Google, IBM — to offer courses, professional certificates, and full degrees. Its AI features personalise the learning path, suggest next skills based on career goals, and provide AI-powered grading on open-ended assignments. Over 148 million registered learners have used Coursera to upskill or change careers.

name: Coze
description: Coze is ByteDance's no-code AI bot building platform, letting anyone create custom chatbots powered by GPT-4, Claude, or other models and publish them to multiple channels — Telegram, Discord, Slack, websites, or the Coze bot store. Bots can be equipped with plugins (web search, image generation, code execution), long-term memory, and scheduled tasks. It's particularly popular for building specialised assistants and has attracted millions of bot creators since launching globally in 2024.

name: Craft Docs
description: Craft is a premium document editor for Mac, iPad, and iPhone with a polished design and powerful AI features. Its AI assistant can write, rewrite, summarise, and translate content directly within documents. Craft supports deep linking between notes, backlinks, and offline-first storage.

name: Craiyon
description: Craiyon (formerly DALL-E mini) is a free, browser-based AI image generator that turns text prompts into images instantly with no sign-up required. While output quality is lower than premium tools, its zero-friction access makes it the go-to for quick idea generation and meme creation.

name: CrewAI
description: CrewAI is an open-source Python framework for orchestrating multiple AI agents that collaborate to complete complex tasks. Developers define agents with specific roles, give them tools like web search or code execution, and CrewAI manages how they communicate and hand off work. It's become a go-to framework for building multi-agent pipelines that tackle research, writing, and analysis workflows end-to-end.

name: Crimson Hexagon
description: Crimson Hexagon (now Brandwatch Consumer Research) is an AI-powered consumer intelligence platform that analyses social media, news, and review data at massive scale. Its natural-language processing identifies themes, sentiment shifts, and demographic patterns in unstructured text. Brand teams and market researchers use it to understand consumer perception and track campaign impact in real time.

name: Crunchbase
description: Crunchbase is the leading platform for discovering business information and investment activity, with AI powering its recommendation engine and predictive intelligence alerts. Its AI notifies investors and BD teams when companies in their target market raise funding, make hires, or hit growth signals.

name: Culture Amp
description: Culture Amp is an employee experience platform with advanced AI analytics for engagement surveys, performance reviews, and DEI measurement. Its AI provides actionable recommendations for managers, predicts flight risk, and benchmarks teams against industry data from 6,500+ organisations.

name: Cursor
description: Cursor is an AI-first code editor (a fork of VS Code) that puts GPT-4 and Claude directly into the editing experience. It can rewrite entire functions from a description, explain unfamiliar codebases, generate tests, and apply multi-file edits with a single instruction. Developers describe it as the closest thing to having a senior engineer pair-programming with you full time.

name: D-ID
description: D-ID is an AI video platform that animates still photos into talking, expressive video presenters. You upload a portrait and provide a script or audio track, and D-ID generates a realistic talking-head video in minutes. It's used for e-learning content, corporate communications, social media, and multilingual training videos at a fraction of traditional video production costs.

name: Dark Sky
description: Dark Sky (acquired by Apple) pioneered hyperlocal, minute-by-minute precipitation forecasting using radar analysis and machine learning. Its trademark feature was the ability to tell you exactly when rain would start at your specific location, down to the minute. The technology now powers weather features in iOS.

name: DataRobot
description: DataRobot is an automated machine learning platform that allows data teams to build, deploy, and monitor predictive models without deep ML expertise. It automates the most time-consuming steps — feature engineering, model selection, and hyperparameter tuning — while giving data scientists full control over every decision. Enterprises use DataRobot to operationalise AI across risk, marketing, operations, and supply chain.

name: dbt Cloud
description: dbt Cloud is the managed platform for dbt (data build tool), which enables analytics engineers to transform raw data in their warehouse using SQL and Python. Its AI Copilot generates dbt models, writes documentation, and helps debug pipelines, making data transformation more accessible.

name: Decktopus
description: Decktopus is an AI-powered presentation tool that generates complete slide decks from a topic in seconds, including content, visuals, and speaker notes. Its AI tailors presentations to the specific audience and purpose, and includes a form builder for collecting audience feedback directly within slides.

name: DeepL
description: DeepL is widely regarded as the most accurate AI translation service available, producing natural-sounding translations that preserve tone and nuance better than competitors. It supports 33 languages and offers a document translation feature that maintains the original formatting. DeepL Pro is popular with businesses and translators who need consistent quality for sensitive or technical content.

name: Demandbase
description: Demandbase is an AI-powered ABM platform that combines account intelligence, advertising, and sales intelligence. Its AI identifies ideal customer profiles from first and third-party data, serves targeted ads to buying committees, and alerts sales reps when accounts show high purchase intent.

name: Descript
description: Descript is an audio and video editor that turns recordings into editable text documents — you edit the media by editing the words. Its AI features include Overdub (voice cloning for corrections), Studio Sound (one-click noise removal), and automatic filler-word removal. Podcasters, YouTubers, and online course creators use it to slash post-production time.

name: Descript Studio Sound
description: Descript Studio Sound is an AI audio enhancement feature within Descript that transforms voice recordings made in noisy environments into clean, studio-quality audio in one click. It removes echo, background noise, and mic quality inconsistencies, making it essential for podcast editors and video creators.

name: Devv.ai
description: Devv.ai is a search engine purpose-built for software developers that understands code context and returns accurate, source-linked answers from documentation, GitHub repositories, and Stack Overflow. It eliminates time wasted sifting through irrelevant results, providing targeted technical answers with code examples.

name: Dify
description: Dify is an open-source LLM application development platform that lets teams build AI workflows, RAG pipelines, agents, and chatbots through a visual interface — without writing infrastructure code. It supports every major model provider, has a built-in vector database, and can be self-hosted for full data control. Product teams use it to ship AI features quickly, while developers use its API to integrate Dify workflows into existing applications. It has become one of the most popular AI app builders in the open-source community.

name: Dimensions
description: Dimensions is a research intelligence platform that links publications, citations, grants, patents, clinical trials, and policy documents in one database. Its AI analytics surface research trends, collaboration networks, and translation from research to policy impact. Universities and funding agencies use it to assess research portfolios.

name: DocuSign AI
description: DocuSign is the world's leading e-signature platform, now enhanced with IAM (Intelligent Agreement Management) AI capabilities. Its AI extracts and analyses data from agreements, flags unusual clauses, and automates obligation tracking. Over 1 million customers across 180 countries use DocuSign to manage their agreement processes.

name: Dolby.io
description: Dolby.io provides cloud APIs for audio and video enhancement powered by AI. Its Media APIs offer noise reduction, loudness correction, dialogue enhancement, and dynamic range processing. Developers integrate it into conferencing apps, podcast platforms, and streaming services to deliver Dolby-quality audio at scale.

name: Domo AI
description: Domo is a cloud-based business intelligence and data platform that embeds AI throughout its product. Its AI features include predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and an AI assistant that answers business questions in plain language. Domo connects to 1,000+ data sources and visualises real-time data in executive dashboards.

name: DoNotPay
description: DoNotPay is an AI-powered consumer advocacy app — sometimes called 'the world's first robot lawyer' — that helps individuals fight bureaucratic hurdles without hiring a lawyer. It can cancel subscriptions, contest parking tickets, write demand letters, claim refunds, and identify hidden class-action settlements. Millions of users have used it to recover money and assert consumer rights.

name: Dovetail
description: Dovetail is a customer insights platform that uses AI to organise and synthesise qualitative research — interviews, survey responses, support tickets, and reviews. Its AI Magic features automatically transcribe, tag, and cluster data into themes, reducing hours of manual analysis to minutes.

name: Dream by WOMBO
description: Dream by WOMBO is a consumer AI art app that generates colourful, stylised images from text prompts. It offers dozens of art styles ranging from oil painting to neon to anime, with new styles added regularly. Its simplicity and mobile-first design have made it one of the most downloaded AI art apps.

name: DreamBox Learning
description: DreamBox Learning is an intelligent adaptive learning platform for elementary and middle school maths that uses game mechanics to keep students engaged. Its AI makes over 48,000 micro-adjustments per hour per student, adapting the learning path in real time. Research shows students using DreamBox outperform peers on standardised tests.

name: Duolingo
description: Duolingo is the world's most popular language learning app, teaching 40+ languages through short, gamified lessons that make daily practice habit-forming. Its AI personalises the lesson difficulty and review schedule based on what you're forgetting, and Duolingo Max introduces AI conversation practice and explanation features powered by GPT-4. Over 500 million people have used it to learn a new language.

name: Durable
description: Durable is an AI website builder that creates a complete, designed website for a small business in under 30 seconds from a short description. It generates copy, selects images, and structures pages tailored to the business type, then lets you edit everything with a chat interface. Freelancers and local businesses use it to have a professional online presence without any design or coding skills.

name: Dynamic Yield
description: Dynamic Yield by Mastercard is an AI personalisation platform that optimises digital customer experiences across web, apps, email, and kiosks. Its machine learning algorithms test and personalise product recommendations, content, layouts, and offers for every individual visitor, used by brands like McDonald's, Urban Outfitters, and Sephora.

name: E2B
description: E2B (Everyone to Build) provides secure, sandboxed cloud environments for AI agents to execute code safely. AI coding assistants and autonomous agents use E2B to run untrusted code in isolated containers with millisecond startup times. It is the infrastructure layer that enables AI agents to safely interact with real computing environments.

name: Elai.io
description: Elai.io is an AI video generation platform that turns text scripts into polished presenter videos using realistic AI avatars. You choose from dozens of avatars, write or paste your script, and get a professional-quality video in minutes — without cameras, studios, or recording. It's widely used for corporate training, onboarding, and multilingual marketing content.

name: ElevenLabs
description: ElevenLabs is the leading AI voice synthesis platform, capable of generating ultra-realistic speech in 29 languages with precise control over tone, pacing, and emotion. Its voice cloning feature can replicate a person's voice from a few minutes of audio. Audiobook publishers, game studios, content creators, and accessibility app developers use ElevenLabs as the gold standard for AI-generated voice.

name: ElevenLabs Sound Effects
description: ElevenLabs Sound Effects is a dedicated tool for generating custom audio effects from text descriptions — "gravel footsteps on a rainy night", "futuristic laser blast with echo", "cheerful cartoon bounce". The AI synthesises unique, royalty-free audio suited for games, films, podcasts, and app development. Unlike stock libraries, every sound is unique and generated on demand to match the creator's exact specification. It is part of ElevenLabs' broader push beyond voice synthesis into a full AI audio platform.

name: Elicit
description: Elicit is an AI research assistant that automates the most tedious parts of literature review — finding relevant papers, extracting key data points, and summarising findings across hundreds of studies. Researchers upload their research question and Elicit returns a structured table of evidence from the scientific literature. It's particularly valued in medicine, policy research, and systematic review workflows.

name: Eraser
description: Eraser is a diagramming and documentation tool purpose-built for software engineers. It generates architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams, entity-relationship diagrams, and flowcharts from code or text descriptions using AI. Engineering teams use it to create and maintain technical documentation alongside code.

name: Exa AI
description: Exa (formerly Metaphor) is a semantic search engine built for AI applications. Unlike keyword search, Exa understands meaning and intent, returning highly relevant web pages, papers, and documents. Developers use its API to add web retrieval to AI agents, research tools, and RAG pipelines.

name: Expensify
description: Expensify automates expense reporting with its SmartScan AI that extracts data from receipts and submits expense reports automatically. It integrates with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage. Its Expensify Card enables real-time reconciliation where every transaction is matched to a receipt automatically.

name: Explainpaper
description: Explainpaper lets users upload academic papers and highlight confusing sections to get plain-language explanations powered by AI. It makes dense scientific literature accessible to students, professionals, and curious learners who lack deep domain expertise. It is particularly popular for machine learning and medical research papers.

name: Factorial
description: Factorial is an all-in-one HR platform for small and medium businesses covering time tracking, payroll, documents, performance reviews, and recruitment. Its AI features include automated payroll processing, AI-powered offer letter generation, and employee sentiment analysis from pulse surveys.

name: FarmLogs
description: FarmLogs (now Bushel Farm) is a farm management and record-keeping platform that centralises field activities, input usage, and yield data in one place. Its AI-powered crop monitoring tracks crop health from satellite imagery and alerts farmers to stress areas before they're visible from the tractor. Small and mid-sized row crop farmers use it to make faster, better-informed agronomic decisions.

name: Fashwell
description: Fashwell is a Swiss computer vision company, founded in 2014, that builds image recognition tools for fashion and home and living retail. The core product is a visual search engine: a shopper uploads any photo, a screenshot, a street style shot, a picture from a magazine, and gets matched to shoppable products in the retailer's catalogue. About 30% of text-based fashion searches return nothing useful, because people often know what they want visually but can't put it into words. Visual search sidesteps that entirely. The API covers more ground than search alone. It handles similar product recommendations, outfit completion (feed it a model image and it identifies every item she is wearing, ready to add to the page for purchase), and automatic catalogue tagging for colour, style, occasion, and garment type. There is also aesthetic profiling, which classifies a shopper's broader taste, "bohemian," "heritage," and so on, to personalise what they see across sessions. Clients include Zalando, Nelly.com, and Bonprix. Fashwell puts its recommendation engine's engagement lift at up to 250% and conversion improvement at 35%. Visual search, according to the company, runs 8x faster than keyword-based alternatives. Retailers don't send customers to a separate Fashwell interface; everything integrates into their own apps and storefronts via the API.

name: Fathom
description: Fathom is an AI meeting assistant for Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams that records, transcribes, and instantly generates a shareable summary with action items. It highlights the most important moments of each call and syncs key takeaways to your CRM automatically. Sales teams and managers use it to capture every commitment without having to take notes during a conversation.

name: Fellow
description: Fellow is an AI meeting assistant and team management platform that helps managers run effective meetings. It provides AI-generated meeting agendas, real-time transcription, automated action items, and a performance feedback system. Over 3,000 companies including Shopify and HubSpot use it to make meetings more productive.

name: Figma
description: Figma is the dominant collaborative design tool used by product teams worldwide for UI/UX design, prototyping, and design system management. Its AI features, including First Draft (layout generation), Auto Layout, and plugin-based AI tools, accelerate the path from idea to interactive prototype. Designers, product managers, and engineers all work inside Figma, making it the single source of design truth.

name: Filmora AI
description: Wondershare Filmora is a consumer video editor packed with AI tools including smart cutout, AI portrait, motion tracking, noise removal, and an AI text-based editor that edits video by editing its transcript. It targets YouTubers, vloggers, and social-media creators who want professional results without steep learning curves.

name: Fireflies.ai
description: Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting intelligence platform that joins your calls as a silent participant, records and transcribes everything, and delivers searchable, summarised notes. Its AI surfaces key topics, questions, and sentiment, and integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, and 50+ other tools to automatically log meeting outcomes. Remote and hybrid teams use it to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

name: Fireworks AI
description: Fireworks AI is a cloud inference platform that delivers some of the fastest and most cost-effective API access to open-source models including Llama, Mixtral, Qwen, and Stable Diffusion. Its FireFunction models are fine-tuned specifically for reliable JSON output and tool-calling, making them popular for structured extraction and agentic tasks where output format matters. Fireworks uses custom CUDA kernels and batching optimisations to achieve throughput that significantly undercuts larger cloud providers on both speed and cost.

name: Fivetran
description: Fivetran is an automated data movement platform that syncs data from 500+ sources — SaaS apps, databases, files — into data warehouses like Snowflake and BigQuery. Its AI features include smart schema migration, anomaly detection in data pipelines, and AI-generated connector mapping.

name: FlexClip
description: FlexClip is an online video editor with AI features including text-to-video, AI video script writer, auto-subtitle generator, and background remover for video. It provides thousands of templates for social media, marketing, and presentations, making it ideal for non-designers who need polished video quickly.

name: Flick AI
description: Flick is an AI social media marketing tool that helps creators and brands plan content, generate captions, find relevant hashtags, and analyse performance. Its AI assistant brainstorms post ideas based on your niche and past content, then helps write captions in your brand voice.

name: Fliki
description: Fliki converts blog posts, scripts, tweets, and text into engaging videos using AI-generated voiceovers in 75+ languages and 1,300+ voices. It automatically matches relevant stock footage and images to the narration. Content marketers and educators use it to repurpose written content into video format with minimal effort.

name: Flowise
description: Flowise is an open-source, low-code tool for visually building LangChain and LlamaIndex-based AI applications. Users drag and drop nodes — for models, vector stores, memory, tools, and APIs — to construct chatbots, RAG pipelines, and AI agents without writing backend code. Self-hostable and highly extensible, it is popular with developers who want the power of LangChain without the complexity of building every integration from scratch. The Flowise marketplace provides pre-built templates for common use cases.

name: FlutterFlow
description: FlutterFlow is a visual app builder on top of Google's Flutter framework, letting teams design and ship production-grade iOS, Android, and web apps without writing most of the code. Its AI assistant can generate full pages from a text description and suggests components as you build. It's popular with agencies and startups that need native-quality apps but don't have a mobile dev on staff.

name: Fly.io
description: Fly.io is a platform for running full-stack applications and databases close to users at the edge in 30+ regions worldwide. It is particularly popular for deploying AI inference workloads, LLM applications, and latency-sensitive apps. Its simple deployment model (flyctl deploy) appeals to developers who want Heroku simplicity with global scale.

name: Forethought AI
description: Forethought is a generative AI platform for customer support that automates ticket triage, provides AI-powered response suggestions, and resolves common queries end-to-end.
