Its SupportGPT model is trained on support conversations, making it more accurate for customer service than general-purpose LLMs.

name: Formula Bot
description: Formula Bot is an AI tool that generates Excel and Google Sheets formulas from a plain-English description of what you want to calculate. You type something like 'sum all cells in column B where column A says Approved' and Formula Bot produces the correct formula instantly. It also explains existing formulas in plain language, making it invaluable for non-technical spreadsheet users.

name: Foursquare
description: Foursquare is a location intelligence company whose data powers local search, place recommendations, and foot-traffic analytics for millions of apps and businesses. Its AI platform helps retailers understand where customers come from, what competitors they visit, and which locations perform best. Developers access Foursquare's Places API to add local search and venue data to their own products.

name: Framer
description: Framer is a website builder aimed at designers who want pixel-perfect results without engineering support. Its AI site generator creates a full design from a prompt, and the visual editor gives designers fine control over animations, responsive breakpoints, and interactions. Agencies and design-led startups use Framer for marketing sites that genuinely stand out.

name: Frase
description: Frase is an AI SEO platform that helps content teams research, brief, and optimise articles to rank in Google. It analyses the top-ranking pages for any target keyword and generates a detailed content brief showing the topics, headers, and questions you need to cover. Writers and SEO managers use it to cut research time and build content that's structurally aligned with what Google rewards.

name: Freepik AI
description: Freepik has integrated powerful AI image generation directly into its platform, which already serves over 50 million designers and creatives monthly. Its AI Image Generator (powered by Mystic and Flux models), AI Photo Editor, and Pikaso real-time sketch-to-image tool let users generate and edit images without leaving the Freepik workflow. Because it's embedded in a platform where users already source stock imagery, AI generation has seen rapid adoption — over 100 million AI images generated in its first year.

name: Freshdesk
description: Freshdesk is a cloud-based customer support platform that centralises tickets from email, chat, phone, and social media into one shared inbox. Its Freddy AI capabilities automate ticket classification and routing, suggest responses from your knowledge base, and flag customers who are at risk of churning. Thousands of support teams use Freshdesk to handle higher ticket volumes without proportionally growing headcount.

name: Gamma
description: Gamma is an AI-native presentation and document tool that generates a complete, designed deck from a topic or outline in seconds. Rather than starting from a blank slide, you describe what you need and Gamma produces structured content you can refine, including text, images, charts, and embeds. It's become a favourite for people who need compelling presentations quickly but don't enjoy building them in PowerPoint.

name: Gemini Advanced
description: Gemini Advanced is Google's premium AI assistant tier, powered by the Gemini Ultra model — Google's most capable AI for complex reasoning, coding, and multimodal analysis. Available as part of the Google One AI Premium plan, it integrates deeply with Gmail, Docs, Drive, and other Google Workspace apps through Gemini in Workspace. Subscribers get priority access to new features, 2TB of storage, and the ability to create custom Gems (personalised AI assistants). It is Google's primary offering to compete with ChatGPT Plus and Claude Pro.

name: Gemini in Workspace
description: Gemini in Workspace embeds Google's AI directly into Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Meet for over 3 billion users. In Gmail it drafts and summarises emails. In Docs it writes, rewrites, and proofreads. In Sheets it generates formulas and analyses data. In Meet it provides real-time AI captions, summaries, and action items. Available as part of Google Workspace Business and Enterprise plans, it represents one of the largest-scale AI deployments in the world, bringing AI assistance to the tools billions of people use for work daily.

name: Gemini 2.0
description: Gemini 2.0 is Google DeepMind's frontier AI model family, with Gemini 2.5 Pro offering a 1 million-token context window and native support for text, images, audio, video, and code in a single model. Its Deep Research feature autonomously browses the web and synthesises multi-source reports, and its thinking mode enables transparent step-by-step reasoning. Available through Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, and embedded across Google's product suite.

name: Gemma
description: Gemma is Google DeepMind's family of open-weight language models, designed to be lightweight enough to run on laptops and edge devices while delivering strong performance on reasoning, coding, and conversation. The Gemma 2 and Gemma 3 releases — available in 2B, 9B, and 27B variants — have become popular choices for developers who want Google-quality AI without the API costs. Gemma models are freely downloadable from Hugging Face and run natively in Ollama and LM Studio.

name: Runway Gen-3 Alpha
description: Runway Gen-3 Alpha is Runway's most advanced video generation model, producing highly consistent, cinematic video clips up to 10 seconds long with superior motion quality and photorealism compared to its predecessors. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video generation and integrates directly into Runway's full creative suite. Professional filmmakers and VFX studios use it for pre-visualisation, b-roll generation, and experimental visual storytelling.

name: Generated Photos
description: Generated Photos provides AI-generated human face images for use in design, research, and UI mockups where real people's photos cannot be used. All faces are 100% AI-generated and come with control over age, gender, ethnicity, and expression. Designers use them for user personas, app mockups, and training datasets.

name: GetIMG.ai
description: GetIMG.ai is an all-in-one AI image platform offering text-to-image generation, inpainting, outpainting, and an AI canvas. It supports Stable Diffusion, SDXL, and fine-tuned custom models so users can create consistent characters and brand imagery. The platform also includes a face enhancer and background removal tool.

name: GitHub Copilot
description: GitHub Copilot is an AI pair programmer developed by GitHub and OpenAI that suggests code completions, entire functions, and boilerplate inline as you type. It understands the context of your file and project, making suggestions that fit your coding style. With over 1.8 million paid subscribers, it's the most widely adopted AI coding assistant across all major languages and editors.

name: GitHub Copilot Workspace
description: GitHub Copilot Workspace is an AI-native development environment that takes a GitHub Issue and autonomously turns it into a specification, implementation plan, and set of code changes, all before the developer writes a line. The developer reviews the plan, edits the steps, then lets Copilot generate the code across multiple files. It runs in the browser with a built-in terminal for tests, making it possible to go from bug report to reviewed PR entirely in the browser. It represents GitHub's vision of AI as a full development collaborator, not just an autocomplete tool.

name: GitLens AI
description: GitLens is the most popular VS Code extension for Git, and its AI features include AI-generated commit messages, AI-powered explanations of code changes, and natural language repository search. GitLens Explain lets developers ask questions about any commit, diff, or code block and receive plain-English explanations.

name: Gladly
description: Gladly is a customer service platform that treats each customer as a person with a lifetime conversation history across every channel — phone, email, chat, SMS, and social media. Its AI features include Sidekick (an AI agent for self-service) and AI-suggested responses with full customer context displayed to human agents.

name: Glassdoor
description: Glassdoor is a job search and company review platform where current and former employees post candid ratings on salary, culture, management, and interview experiences. Its AI surfaces personalised job recommendations based on your profile, and the salary data lets candidates negotiate from a position of knowledge. Job seekers use it to see through the polished surface of company career pages.

name: Glean
description: Glean is an enterprise AI platform that connects to all the tools a company uses — Slack, Confluence, Jira, Google Drive, Salesforce, GitHub, and 100+ others — and provides a unified AI search and assistant that understands company-specific knowledge. Employees can ask questions like 'what did the design team decide about the checkout flow?' and Glean retrieves the relevant Slack threads, Figma files, and documents with full context. Its AI assistant can then synthesise answers from across all sources, making it one of the most widely deployed enterprise AI tools.

name: Glide
description: Glide is a no-code app builder that transforms Google Sheets, Excel, or Airtable data into a polished mobile or web app in minutes. Its AI assistant can generate app structures from a description of your workflow, and apps update in real time as the underlying spreadsheet changes. Operations teams and field workers use Glide to build internal tools without waiting for engineering resources.

name: Gong
description: Gong is an AI revenue intelligence platform that records and analyses every customer call, email, and demo to surface patterns that separate winning deals from lost ones. Its machine-learning models highlight moments where reps go off-script, flag at-risk deals based on conversation signals, and coach individuals with clip-based feedback. Sales leaders at growth-stage and enterprise companies use Gong to systematise what their best reps do.

name: Google AI Studio
description: Google AI Studio is the free, browser-based IDE for experimenting with and building on Gemini models. Developers can test prompts across Gemini Pro, Gemini Flash, and experimental models; build multi-turn chatbots; and generate API keys for use in applications — all without a credit card. It supports multimodal inputs including images, video, audio, and documents, and its million-token context window can be tested interactively. AI Studio is typically the first place developers try Gemini, and it provides a direct export to Vertex AI for production deployments.

name: Google Assistant
description: Google Assistant is Google's AI voice assistant, available on Android phones, smart speakers, smart displays, and Nest devices. It understands natural-language commands for setting reminders, answering questions, controlling smart home devices, and managing your Google calendar. It's gradually being superseded by Gemini on newer Android devices as Google migrates its AI experiences.

name: Google Jules
description: Jules is Google's AI coding agent that works asynchronously on your GitHub repository. You assign Jules a task — fix this bug, implement this feature, add tests — and it independently reads the codebase, writes a plan, makes changes across multiple files, and opens a pull request. Unlike interactive coding assistants, Jules operates in the background while you continue other work, returning with a completed PR to review. Powered by Gemini 2.0, it is Google's direct answer to GitHub Copilot Workspace and Devin.

name: Google Maps
description: Google Maps is the world's most widely used navigation and local discovery platform, trusted by over 1 billion monthly users. Its AI continuously updates routing based on real-time traffic data, surfaces personalised business recommendations, and powers Street View's visual search. For businesses, a Google Maps listing is often the first place a local customer encounters your brand.

name: Google Translate
description: Google Translate is a free AI translation service supporting 133 languages, available on the web, as a mobile app, and as an API. It offers instant camera translation of signs and menus, conversation mode for real-time spoken translation, and a document translation feature that preserves formatting. Despite newer competitors, it remains the go-to for quick, accessible translation worldwide.

name: Gorgias
description: Gorgias is a customer support platform built specifically for e-commerce, integrating deeply with Shopify, Magento, and BigCommerce to give support agents instant access to order data, subscriptions, and customer history. Its AI features auto-respond to common questions like 'where is my order?', suggest replies based on past conversations, and route tickets by intent and urgency. Over 14,000 DTC brands use Gorgias to manage customer support across email, chat, social media, and SMS from a single unified inbox.

name: GPT Engineer
description: GPT Engineer (now Lovable's predecessor, continuing as gptengineer.app) was one of the first tools to demonstrate AI generating a complete, runnable codebase from a single natural language specification. The user describes what they want to build, the AI asks clarifying questions, then generates all the files and code needed. Its open-source roots spawned a large community and influenced a generation of AI coding tools. The project continues as a web app and CLI tool for developers who prefer a more raw, configuration-driven approach to AI-generated projects.

name: GPT-4o
description: GPT-4o is OpenAI's flagship model, an omni model that natively understands and generates text, images, audio, and code in a single unified architecture. It's faster and cheaper than GPT-4 Turbo while matching or exceeding its performance, and it powers the free tier of ChatGPT. Alongside GPT-4o, OpenAI offers o3 and o1 reasoning models for tasks requiring deep multi-step thinking, making the OpenAI API family the most widely deployed in the industry.

name: GPTZero
description: GPTZero is an AI detection tool that classifies whether text was written by a human or generated by AI models including ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude, and Gemini. Designed for educators, publishers, and hiring managers, it provides sentence-level highlighting to show exactly which portions appear AI-generated.

name: Grain
description: Grain is an AI meeting recorder and conversation intelligence tool for sales teams. It automatically clips the most important moments from recorded calls, adds AI-generated summaries, and pushes key data to your CRM with a single click. Deal coaches use Grain's highlight reels to train reps on what good discovery and objection handling look like.

name: Grammarly
description: Grammarly is the most widely used AI writing assistant, checking grammar, spelling, punctuation, clarity, and tone across emails, documents, and web browsers. Its premium tier offers full-sentence rewrites, plagiarism detection, and a generative AI assistant that can draft text from scratch. Over 40 million people and 50,000 teams use Grammarly to write with more confidence and fewer errors.

name: Granular
description: Granular is an enterprise farm management platform that helps large agricultural operations plan, execute, and analyse every aspect of their business — from field-level agronomics to financial reporting. Its AI tools forecast input costs, track crop performance against benchmarks, and identify the most profitable fields and practices. It's built for the complexity of farms running hundreds or thousands of acres.

name: Greenhouse
description: Greenhouse is a structured hiring platform used by high-growth companies to run consistent, data-driven recruiting processes. Its AI tools assist with job description writing, candidate scoring, interview scheduling automation, and diversity analytics. Companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, and Squarespace use Greenhouse to reduce bias and improve the quality and speed of every hire.

name: Groq
description: Groq delivers the fastest publicly available LLM inference on the market, running Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, and other open models at speeds exceeding 500 tokens per second, typically 10-20x faster than GPU-based cloud providers. This is achieved through Groq's custom Language Processing Unit (LPU) chips, designed specifically for sequential token generation. Developers use Groq's API as a drop-in OpenAI replacement wherever response latency matters most, from real-time voice applications to low-latency agentic pipelines.

name: GrowthBar
description: GrowthBar is an AI SEO tool that combines keyword research, competitive intelligence, and AI content generation. Users can see competitor rankings, generate AI-written blog outlines, and track keyword positions. Its Chrome extension surfaces SEO data directly on Google search results pages.

name: H2O.ai
description: H2O.ai is an open-source machine learning platform that makes it fast to build and deploy predictive models at scale. Its AutoML capabilities automatically explore dozens of algorithms and select the best performer for your dataset — no ML expertise required. Data science teams in banking, insurance, and healthcare use H2O.ai to put production-grade models into operation quickly.

name: Happy Scribe
description: Happy Scribe is an AI transcription and subtitle platform that converts audio and video into accurate text in 60+ languages. It offers both automated transcription and a human proofreading service for higher-stakes content, along with a subtitle editor and direct export to SRT, VTT, and other formats. Journalists, researchers, and video teams use it to make their content searchable and accessible.

name: Harvey
description: Harvey is an AI platform built specifically for law firms and legal departments, combining large language models with deep domain expertise in law. It can draft contracts, perform due diligence review, research case law, and analyse regulatory documents — all within a secure, confidential environment. Global law firms including Allen & Overy and PwC Legal have deployed Harvey at scale.

name: Hatchful
description: Hatchful is Shopify's free logo maker. No subscription, no watermarks, no paid upgrade to unlock the good stuff. Anyone can use it, download the files, and walk away without entering a credit card. The whole thing takes under five minutes. You pick where the logo will be used (online store, social media, print), choose an industry, select a handful of style directions like bold, minimalistic, or hipster, type in your business name and an optional slogan, and then browse generated options. Hatchful has over 13,000 design combinations across 17 style categories. Once you land on something close, a basic editor lets you tweak fonts, colours, and layout before downloading. What you get in the zip: a standard logo, a transparent background version, a favicon, and pre-sized files for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Twitter, and YouTube. All PNGs. That last part matters, because Hatchful does not export SVG or any vector format. If you later need the logo on a banner, a sign, or embroidered on a jacket, you will have to either recreate it in a vector tool or pay someone to trace it. That limitation tells you who this is actually for. A sole trader testing a business idea, or a Shopify store owner who needs something on the page before launch day, will get through fine. Someone building a brand they plan to use at scale, across print and merchandise and packaging, will eventually hit the wall.

name: Height
description: Height is an AI-first project management tool where the AI assistant actively participates in your workflow — automatically triaging tickets, writing subtasks, updating statuses, and generating summaries of where a project stands. Unlike traditional PM tools that bolt AI on as a feature, Height's AI is designed to run in the background handling routine management work autonomously.

name: Helpshift
description: Helpshift is a digital customer service platform built for mobile apps and games, with AI chatbots, in-app messaging, and smart intent detection. Its AI classifies incoming issues and routes them to the right team or resolves them automatically. Top game studios and mobile-first brands use it for 24/7 automated support.

name: Heptabase
description: Heptabase is a visual note-taking tool that lets users arrange cards (notes) on infinite whiteboards for spatial thinking. Its AI features include semantic search across all notes, AI-generated connections between related cards, and an AI assistant that synthesises your personal knowledge base to answer questions.

name: HeyGen
description: HeyGen is an AI video creation platform that lets you produce professional presenter videos with AI avatars that speak any script in 40+ languages. You can clone your own voice and likeness or choose from over 100 pre-built avatars, making HeyGen popular for corporate training, product demos, and multilingual content at scale. Its lip-sync quality is considered among the best in the industry.

name: HiBob
description: HiBob (Bob) is a modern HRIS designed for mid-size companies with AI features including compensation benchmarking, workforce planning analytics, and an AI HR assistant. It supports flexible working patterns, performance management, and benefits administration with a consumer-grade interface.

name: Homestyler
description: Homestyler is a free AI-powered interior design and 3D home planning tool used by millions of homeowners and designers. You scan a room with your phone or draw it from scratch, then drag and drop real furniture from brand catalogues to visualise a redesign before spending any money. Its community of over 50 million projects makes it one of the world's largest interior design platforms.

name: Hootsuite
description: Hootsuite is a social media management platform that lets teams schedule content, monitor brand mentions, and analyse performance across all major social networks from one dashboard. Its AI-powered OwlyWriter generates captions and post ideas on demand, and bulk scheduling lets teams plan an entire month of content in an hour. It's the choice of enterprise brands managing multiple accounts and markets.

name: Hotjar AI
description: Hotjar reveals user behaviour through heatmaps, session recordings, and feedback surveys. Its AI features include automatic insight summaries from session recordings and survey responses, helping product and UX teams quickly understand why users behave the way they do without manual analysis.

name: Houzz
description: Houzz is an online platform for home renovation and design, combining a product marketplace, a directory of professionals, and a photo ideabook with over 21 million curated images. Its AI-powered Shop the Look feature identifies furniture and decor in inspiration photos and links them to buyable products. Homeowners use it to plan every aspect of a renovation and find vetted contractors.

name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot is a leading CRM platform that unifies marketing, sales, and customer service with AI running through every product. Its AI features include content generation, lead scoring, email subject line optimisation, chatbots, and a conversational intelligence layer across calls and deals. Over 205,000 companies use HubSpot as their core go-to-market system, from funded startups to enterprise brands.

name: HubSpot CRM
description: HubSpot CRM is HubSpot's free customer relationship management system that tracks contacts, deals, and communications across the entire customer lifecycle. Its AI-powered features score leads, predict deal close probability, and suggest follow-up actions for every open opportunity. It integrates seamlessly with Gmail, Outlook, and the full HubSpot marketing and sales suite.

name: Hugging Face
description: Hugging Face is the central hub of the open-source AI ecosystem, hosting over 900,000 models, 200,000 datasets, and 300,000 interactive demo Spaces. It provides the Transformers library, the Inference API, and a social platform where researchers share new models the day they drop. From BERT and Stable Diffusion to Llama and Mistral, virtually every major open model ships to Hugging Face first, making it the essential destination for anyone working with or exploring AI.

name: Hume AI
description: Hume AI builds AI that can understand and express emotion. Its Empathic Voice Interface (EVI) is a voice AI that reads vocal cues — tone, pace, inflection — to gauge how the user is feeling and adapt its responses accordingly, producing the most naturalistic AI voice conversations available. EVI 2 adds expressive emotional output, laughing, sighing, and varying its energy to match the conversation. Hume's APIs are used in mental health applications, educational tools, and consumer apps where emotional intelligence matters.

name: Hunter
description: Hunter is an email outreach tool that finds professional email addresses associated with any company domain. It searches the web for publicly available contact information and verifies deliverability so your outreach doesn't bounce. Marketing teams, recruiters, and business development professionals use Hunter to build prospect lists and verify emails before campaigns launch.

name: Hypotenuse AI
description: Hypotenuse AI specialises in large-scale content generation for e-commerce, producing product descriptions, blog posts, and ad copy in bulk. Users can import a CSV of product data and generate hundreds of descriptions simultaneously with brand voice consistency. It is widely used by Shopify stores and marketing agencies.

name: IBM Watson Government
description: IBM Watson Government is a suite of AI services tailored to the security, compliance, and interoperability requirements of federal and state agencies. It covers natural language processing, computer vision, data analytics, and decision automation — all deployable on IBM Cloud, AWS GovCloud, or on-premises. Agencies use it for citizen services, fraud detection, procurement optimisation, and intelligence analysis.

name: Imgflip
description: Imgflip is one of the web's most popular meme creation sites, offering thousands of templates and an AI meme generator that writes captions automatically. You search a template, enter a topic or mood, and the AI generates punchy meme text in seconds. With over 200 million monthly visitors, Imgflip has become a primary destination for internet culture and meme discovery.

name: Inciteful
description: Inciteful maps the citation network around any research paper to find the most important related works. Its AI-powered algorithms identify seminal papers, most similar papers, and researchers working on related problems. Scientists use it for literature reviews and to discover papers that keyword search alone would miss.

name: Indeed
description: Indeed is the world's largest job site, aggregating listings from thousands of sources alongside jobs posted directly on the platform. Its AI matching engine surfaces relevant openings based on your resume, search history, and stated preferences, and sends proactive job alerts. Employers use Indeed Sponsored Jobs and AI-assisted screening to get qualified candidates in front of hiring managers faster.

name: Infermedica
description: Infermedica provides an AI-powered symptom checking and patient triage API used by insurers, telehealth platforms, and hospital systems. Its medical knowledge graph covers 1,600+ conditions and 1,500+ symptoms. Patients describe their symptoms and the AI conducts a differential diagnosis interview, recommending the appropriate level of care.

name: Infogram
description: Infogram is a data visualisation and infographic tool designed for communicators who need clear, visual storytelling from complex data. Its AI suggests chart types based on your data structure and a smart layout engine keeps visuals consistent and professional. Journalists, marketers, and educators use it to turn spreadsheets into shareable, interactive graphics.

name: INK Editor
description: INK Editor combines AI writing assistance with real-time SEO optimisation. As users write, the AI scores content against top-ranking pages and suggests keywords, structure, and length improvements. It also includes an AI co-writer for generating paragraphs, headlines, and meta descriptions.

name: Insilico Medicine
description: Insilico Medicine uses generative AI and reinforcement learning to accelerate drug discovery. Its Chemistry42 platform designs novel drug molecules with desired properties in days rather than years. The company made history by advancing the first AI-designed drug candidate into Phase II clinical trials for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

name: Intercom
description: Intercom is a customer communications platform that combines live chat, AI-powered bots, email campaigns, and a help centre in one system. Its Fin AI agent handles a large proportion of support questions autonomously, escalating only complex cases to human agents. Product-led growth companies use Intercom to convert trial users, onboard customers, and reduce churn through proactive in-app messaging.

name: InVideo
description: InVideo is an AI-powered video creation platform that turns text, scripts, or blog posts into professional videos using stock footage, AI voiceover, and automated editing. Its library of 5,000+ templates covers ads, explainers, social content, and news formats. Marketers and content teams use InVideo to produce video content at scale without needing video editing skills.

name: InVision
description: InVision is a digital product design platform for creating interactive prototypes, design systems, and user testing flows. Its Freehand collaborative whiteboard includes AI tools for brainstorming and design critique. Used by design teams at Airbnb, Amazon, and HBO, InVision facilitates the entire design review process.

name: Inworld AI
description: Inworld AI is a platform for creating intelligent, emotionally expressive NPCs (non-player characters) for games and virtual worlds. Its character engine gives each NPC a unique personality, memory, and conversational ability so players have genuinely dynamic interactions rather than scripted dialogue trees. Game studios integrate Inworld via Unity and Unreal Engine SDK to add AI depth to their worlds.

name: Ironclad
description: Ironclad is a digital contracting platform used by over 1,000 companies to automate the entire contract lifecycle from creation and negotiation to execution and renewal. Its AI features include AI-assisted contract review, clause suggestions, and a conversational AI that answers questions about contract data.

name: IXL
description: IXL is an adaptive learning platform for K-12 students covering maths, language arts, science, and social studies. Its AI diagnoses each student's skill level and adapts questions in real time to work at the ideal challenge level. Teachers receive diagnostic reports showing exactly where each student needs support.

name: iZotope RX
description: iZotope RX is the industry-standard audio restoration and repair suite used by film studios, broadcasters, and musicians. Its AI modules remove noise, hum, clicks, reverb, and breath sounds with remarkable precision. RX's Dialogue Isolation AI separates speech from background noise in settings where re-recording is impossible.

name: Jan
description: Jan is an open-source, privacy-first desktop application for running AI models entirely on your own machine. It supports GGUF models from Hugging Face, provides a clean ChatGPT-style interface, and exposes a local API server compatible with the OpenAI format. All conversations and data stay on your device — nothing is sent to the cloud. Jan is particularly popular with privacy-conscious users and developers who want a polished alternative to the command line for running local LLMs.

name: Jasper
description: Jasper is an enterprise AI writing platform designed for marketing teams, covering everything from blog posts and landing pages to ads and email sequences. Its Brand Voice feature trains the AI on your company's tone and style guidelines, ensuring consistent output across the team. Over 100,000 marketing teams use Jasper to increase content output without scaling headcount.

name: Jenni AI
description: Jenni AI is an AI writing assistant designed for academic writing. It helps researchers draft papers, write literature reviews, cite sources in APA/MLA/Chicago formats, and paraphrase existing text. Its in-text citation feature directly inserts references from a growing database of academic sources, reducing the risk of plagiarism.

name: John Deere Operations Center
description: John Deere Operations Center is the digital hub for precision agriculture on John Deere equipment, aggregating machine data, agronomic inputs, and field maps in one place. AI-powered prescriptions recommend variable-rate planting and application strategies field by field. It's the cornerstone of John Deere's connected agriculture ecosystem, linking the office to the cab in real time.

name: Juro
description: Juro is an AI-native contract platform where legal and commercial teams create, negotiate, execute, and manage contracts in one place. Its AI features include AI contract drafting from a plain-English brief, one-click contract review, and a legal AI assistant that answers questions about any contract.

name: K Health
description: K Health is a digital primary care service that uses AI to analyse your symptoms and medical history against a database of millions of patient cases to suggest possible conditions. From that assessment, you can connect with a licensed clinician via text in minutes for diagnosis, prescriptions, and referrals. It makes affordable, evidence-based primary care accessible 24/7 without waiting for an appointment.

name: Kaedim
description: Kaedim is an AI tool that converts 2D concept art and reference images into production-ready 3D models. Game studios, virtual production teams, and product designers upload an image and receive a fully textured 3D mesh they can immediately import into their pipeline. It cuts the manual 3D modelling time from days to minutes for early-stage asset creation.

name: Kagi
description: Kagi is a paid, ad-free search engine that puts user experience above advertiser interests — results are never influenced by SEO manipulation or sponsored placement. Its AI features include Fast Answer (instant AI summaries at the top of results), Summarize (one-click summaries of any web page), and the Kagi Assistant, which combines search with GPT-4 and Claude for conversational research. Users who switch report significantly cleaner, more relevant results than Google, and the privacy-first business model has built a loyal subscriber base.

name: Kapwing
description: Kapwing is a browser-based video editing platform with a strong suite of AI tools — including auto-subtitles, background removal, text-to-video, and an AI script generator. Its collaborative editing features make it easy for teams to review and iterate without exporting files. Social media managers and educators use Kapwing to produce polished video content entirely in the browser.

name: Kensho
description: Kensho (acquired by S&P Global) is an AI analytics platform purpose-built for financial markets and macroeconomic research. Its NLP models extract structured data from earnings transcripts, SEC filings, and news feeds, and its event-study tools quantify how markets historically react to specific macro triggers. Quantitative analysts and investment researchers use Kensho to find signals that traditional data providers miss.

name: Khan Academy
description: Khan Academy is a free, non-profit learning platform covering maths, science, computing, and humanities from primary school through university level. Its Khanmigo AI tutor — powered by GPT-4 — guides students through problems with Socratic questioning rather than just giving answers. Over 150 million people have used Khan Academy to learn at their own pace, anywhere in the world.

name: Khanmigo
description: Khanmigo is Khan Academy's AI-powered tutor built on GPT-4. Rather than giving answers directly, it uses the Socratic method to guide students through problems with questions and hints. It also serves as a teacher assistant, helping educators generate lesson plans, assignment rubrics, and progress reports.

name: Kickresume
description: Kickresume is an AI resume and cover letter builder that uses GPT-4 to generate complete application documents from your work history. Its library of 35+ ATS-friendly templates is designed to pass automated screening systems, and a built-in resume checker highlights weaknesses before you submit. Job seekers at all career stages use it to cut application time while improving quality.

name: Kimi
description: Kimi is an AI assistant from Chinese startup Moonshot AI, notable for having one of the largest context windows available — up to 1 million tokens — allowing it to read entire books, massive codebases, or years of documents in a single prompt. Its reasoning model Kimi k1.5 has achieved top scores on international benchmarks including AIME and MATH, competing directly with OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek R1. Kimi is available in both Chinese and English and has attracted tens of millions of users.

name: Kira Systems
description: Kira Systems is an AI contract analysis tool used by major law firms and corporate legal teams for due diligence and contract review. It identifies and extracts provisions from contracts using machine learning, reducing the time required for large-volume contract review by up to 60%.

name: Klaviyo AI
description: Klaviyo is the leading email and SMS marketing platform for e-commerce brands, now with extensive AI capabilities including predictive analytics, product recommendations, send-time optimisation, and an AI subject line generator. It integrates natively with Shopify, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce.

name: Koala AI
description: Koala AI produces SEO-optimised articles with one click by combining GPT-4o with real-time SERP data. It analyses what's currently ranking for a keyword and generates structured articles with proper headings, FAQs, and internal linking suggestions. It also includes a chat interface for content brainstorming.

name: Krisp
description: Krisp uses AI to remove background noise and echo in real time during calls and recordings, regardless of which conferencing app you use. It works as a virtual audio device that sits between your microphone and any calling software — Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Discord — and strips out keyboard clicks, barking dogs, construction noise, and room echo. Used by remote workers, podcasters, and customer support teams, Krisp also offers AI meeting transcription and meeting notes.

name: Kustomer AI
description: Kustomer is a CRM-powered customer service platform with AI capabilities including KIQ AI agent, which handles tier-1 support automatically, and AI-suggested responses for agents. It unifies customer data across all channels into a single timeline, helping agents resolve complex issues faster.

name: Lambda Labs
description: Lambda Labs provides GPU cloud instances and deep learning workstations for AI researchers and teams. Its on-demand and reserved A100/H100 instances offer competitive pricing for training large models. Lambda also manufactures GPU workstations used by top research labs and AI startups for on-premise training.

name: LANDR
description: LANDR provides AI-powered instant music mastering that analyses your track and applies professional-grade processing to prepare it for streaming platforms. Beyond mastering, it offers sample packs, plugin subscriptions, and direct distribution to Spotify, Apple Music, and 150+ platforms. Trusted by over 3 million musicians.

name: LangChain
description: LangChain is the most widely adopted open-source framework for building applications powered by large language models. It provides modular components for chaining prompts, connecting LLMs to external data sources, memory systems, and tool-use APIs. Developers use LangChain as the scaffolding for AI assistants, autonomous agents, document Q&A systems, and complex multi-step pipelines.

name: Langflow
description: Langflow is a visual, open-source platform for building LangChain applications through a drag-and-drop canvas. Each LangChain component — LLMs, prompts, agents, tools, vector stores, document loaders — is a node that can be wired together and tested in real time. It makes complex RAG systems, multi-agent workflows, and chatbots accessible to developers without deep LangChain expertise. Langflow can be self-hosted or run in the cloud via DataStax Astra, and it exports deployable Python code from any workflow.

name: LanguageTool
description: LanguageTool is an open-source grammar, style, and spell checker that supports over 30 languages — far more than its competitors. Its browser extension and desktop app check writing in real time across any website or application, catching grammar errors, awkward phrasing, redundancies, and register mismatches. Unlike Grammarly, it can be self-hosted for privacy-sensitive environments, making it popular in European enterprises with strict data governance requirements. Its premium tier adds an AI-powered rephrasing assistant for clearer, more concise writing.

name: Later
description: Later is a social media scheduling and analytics platform focused on visual content for Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and other image-forward channels. Its AI caption writer and hashtag suggester streamline post creation, and a visual content calendar lets teams plan their feed aesthetics a month in advance. Creators and brand teams use Later to keep a consistent posting cadence without daily manual effort.

name: Lattice AI
description: Lattice is a people management platform that helps HR teams manage performance reviews, OKRs, and employee engagement. Its AI features include automated performance review writing assistance, engagement survey analysis, and an AI HR assistant for answering policy questions. Over 5,000 companies use it to build high-performing cultures.

name: LawGeex
description: LawGeex is an AI contract review platform that analyses contracts against a company's pre-approved legal playbook and flags deviations in minutes. It handles non-disclosure agreements, vendor contracts, and other standard documents — tasks that typically consume hours of paralegal and lawyer time. Legal and procurement teams use it to increase review throughput while maintaining consistent standards.

name: Le Chat
description: Le Chat is Mistral AI's consumer-facing chat assistant, providing free access to Mistral's latest models including Mistral Large, Pixtral, and the Mistral reasoning models. Its web search feature retrieves live information, and its canvas mode lets users collaborate on documents and code in a side panel. Le Chat is particularly fast — Mistral's custom inference infrastructure delivers responses significantly quicker than ChatGPT — and its generous free tier has attracted users looking for a capable, uncensored European AI alternative to OpenAI.

name: Leapsome
description: Leapsome is a people enablement platform combining performance reviews, OKRs, employee engagement surveys, learning, and compensation management. Its AI features include AI-generated review summaries, sentiment analysis of open-text feedback, and skills gap analysis that recommends learning content to employees.

name: Lens.org
description: Lens.org is a free open-access platform covering 330 million patents and 240 million scholarly works with AI-powered search and analytics. Researchers and IP professionals use it to explore the intersection of academic research and patent activity, identify prior art, and analyse innovation landscapes.

name: Lensa AI
description: Lensa AI is a photo editing app by Prisma Labs that went viral for its Magic Avatars feature, which generates artistic AI portraits from selfies. Beyond avatars, it offers real-time face retouching, background blur, and a suite of AI photo enhancement filters. Available on iOS and Android.

name: Lex
description: Lex is a minimalist AI writing tool designed around the experience of thinking and writing together. When you get stuck, pressing a button summons GPT-powered suggestions directly in your document. It also supports AI feedback, document sharing, and comment threads, making it popular among essayists and newsletter writers.

name: Lexion
description: Lexion is an AI-powered contract management platform that extracts key data from contracts, tracks obligations, and surfaces renewal dates and risks automatically. Legal teams use it to get instant answers about contract terms and build a searchable repository of all their agreements.

name: Linear
description: Linear is a fast, opinionated project and issue tracking tool built for software teams that want minimal friction between an idea and a shipped feature. Its AI features write issue descriptions from context, auto-triage incoming bugs, and generate weekly project summaries. Engineering teams at high-growth startups and scale-ups prefer Linear's speed and keyboard-first design over heavier tools like Jira.

name: Liner
description: Liner is a web and app highlighting tool with AI features including a AI search engine that surfaces the most relevant parts of highlighted content, AI summaries of web pages and PDFs, and an AI chat assistant for documents. Students and researchers use it to build a personal knowledge base from web content.

name: LinkedIn
description: LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, used by over 1 billion members for job searching, hiring, business development, and professional content. Its AI features write InMail drafts, optimise profiles for recruiter search, and personalise the job feed to your career trajectory. Virtually every business professional maintains a LinkedIn presence, making it the default B2B social platform.

name: LinkedIn Sales Navigator
description: LinkedIn Sales Navigator is the premium B2B prospecting tool that sits on top of LinkedIn's 950+ million member network. AI-powered lead recommendations surface contacts that match your ideal customer profile, and InMail credits let you reach anyone outside your network. Enterprise sales teams use it as their primary source of account intelligence and warm outreach.

name: Llama 4
description: Llama 4 is Meta's latest generation of open-weight large language models, featuring a Mixture-of-Experts architecture that achieves frontier-level capability while remaining freely downloadable under Meta's community licence. The family spans Scout (17B active parameters, 10M-token context), Maverick (17B active, multimodal), and Behemoth (288B active, teacher model) variants. Its open nature makes it the most widely self-hosted and fine-tuned LLM family, deployed in production across research labs, enterprises, and consumer applications worldwide.

name: Llamasoft
description: Llamasoft (acquired by Coupa) is an AI platform for strategic supply chain design and network optimisation. Its simulation and analytics tools help companies model 'what-if' scenarios — new distribution centres, supplier changes, demand shocks — and find the cost-optimal configuration. Global manufacturers and retailers use Llamasoft to stress-test their supply chains before committing capital.

name: LM Studio
description: LM Studio is a desktop application for Mac, Windows, and Linux that lets anyone browse, download, and run open-source language models locally without touching the command line. Its built-in chat interface works out of the box, and it also serves a local OpenAI-compatible API so existing tools like Continue, Cursor, or custom scripts can use local models. It supports the full range of GGUF-quantised models from Hugging Face, making state-of-the-art AI accessible on consumer laptops.

name: Locofy.ai
description: Locofy.ai turns Figma, Adobe XD, and Sketch designs into production-ready frontend code in React, Next.js, Vue, HTML/CSS, and more. Developers annotate design components and the AI generates component-based, responsive code that follows engineering best practices, drastically reducing design-to-code handoff time.

name: LogoAI
description: LogoAI is an AI logo maker that generates unique, vector-based logos from your company name, industry, and style preferences. Unlike template-based tools, its generator tries to produce original marks rather than remixing existing icons. The output includes SVG files, brand colour palettes, and mockups on business cards and social profiles.

name: Lokalise AI
description: Lokalise is a translation management platform with integrated AI translation, glossary management, and quality assurance tools. Development teams use it to localise apps, websites, and digital products into 100+ languages. Its AI translation engine combines machine translation with brand-specific terminology for consistent localisation.

name: LongShot AI
description: LongShot AI focuses on generating accurate, SEO-friendly long-form blog content with built-in fact-checking powered by web search. It can produce a complete blog post from a keyword, including outline, introduction, and conclusion, with citations. Its FactGPT feature grounds outputs in real-time search results.

name: Looka
description: Looka is an AI-powered logo maker and brand identity platform that lets anyone create a professional logo in minutes. After generating dozens of options from your name and style inputs, it packages everything into a Brand Kit — logo files in every format, a matching colour palette, fonts, and social media assets. It's a go-to for founders who need a complete brand identity before their launch.

name: Loom
description: Loom is an async video messaging tool that lets you record your screen, camera, and microphone simultaneously and share a link instantly. Its AI automatically generates a transcript, title, and summary for every recording, and a chaptering feature lets viewers jump to the section they need. Teams use Loom to replace meetings, explain complex code changes, and give feedback on designs without scheduling a call.

name: Lottie
description: LottieFiles is an ecosystem for Lottie animations — lightweight, JSON-based vector animations that play at any resolution without file bloat. Designers create animations in After Effects and export them via the Bodymovin plugin, then share or embed them with a single link. Product teams and web developers use LottieFiles to add smooth, performant micro-animations to apps and websites.

name: Loudly
description: Loudly is an AI music generation platform with a library of over 170,000 AI-generated tracks across 50 genres. Its AI music generator lets creators customise tempo, mood, and instrumentation to produce unique royalty-free music. Brands, advertisers, and social media creators use it for consistent audio branding.

name: Lovo AI
description: Lovo (also known as Genny) is an AI voice generation platform offering over 500 voices across 100 languages, covering a wide range of styles, ages, and emotions. Its Genny editor combines text-to-speech with a video editor, letting content creators produce narrated videos without recording their own voice. Broadcasters, e-learning creators, and marketers use Lovo for voiceovers, audiobooks, and podcast intros. Its voice cloning feature can replicate a custom voice from a short audio sample.

name: Lucidchart AI
description: Lucidchart is a diagramming tool used to create flowcharts, org charts, network diagrams, and UML diagrams. Its AI features include AI-generated diagrams from text descriptions, automatic layout optimisation, and an AI assistant that answers questions about diagram content. Teams use it to document processes and systems visually.

name: Ludo.ai
description: Ludo.ai is an AI platform for game developers that helps with concept ideation, market research, and visual prototype generation. It analyses millions of games to identify trending mechanics, successful feature combinations, and underserved market niches, helping studios make more informed game design decisions.

name: Luma AI
description: Luma AI is a platform for capturing and generating photorealistic 3D content using neural radiance fields (NeRF) and Gaussian splatting. You scan an object or space with your iPhone and Luma processes it into an interactive, photorealistic 3D scene you can embed on the web or use in production pipelines. It's used by VFX studios, product photographers, and AR developers who need real-world 3D capture at low cost.

name: Luminance
description: Luminance is an AI platform for the legal profession that uses patented AI to read and understand legal documents. It provides contract review and negotiation assistance, anomaly detection in due diligence, and an AI contract drafter. Over 700 law firms and corporate legal departments use it globally.

name: Lunit
description: Lunit is a medical AI company developing AI solutions for cancer detection and treatment. Its Insight CXR analyses chest X-rays for 10 abnormalities with radiologist-level accuracy, while Insight MMG screens mammograms for breast cancer. Lunit's pathology AI analyses tumour microenvironments to predict immunotherapy response.

name: Mage.space
description: Mage.space provides fast Stable Diffusion image generation with minimal restrictions. It supports multiple model checkpoints, ControlNet, image-to-image, and inpainting. Its straightforward interface and quick generation speeds make it popular with digital artists who need rapid iteration without complex setup.

name: Magento
description: Magento (now Adobe Commerce) is an open-source ecommerce platform used by large retailers and B2B companies for highly customised online stores. Its AI-powered features — product recommendations, predictive search, and customer segment analysis — are built into the Adobe Sensei engine. Merchants with complex catalogue management needs and deep customisation requirements choose Magento over more constrained SaaS alternatives.

name: Make
description: Make (formerly Integromat) is a visual automation platform that connects apps and services through flowchart-style diagrams, handling everything from simple data transfers to multi-step workflows with conditional logic. Its extensive library of 1,700+ integrations includes AI tools like OpenAI and Google Gemini as native modules. Non-technical users build sophisticated automations that eliminate repetitive manual tasks between business tools.

name: Manus
description: Manus is a general-purpose AI agent from the Chinese startup Monica that autonomously executes multi-step tasks — web research, data analysis, code writing, file management — without requiring the user to break them down. It operates in a sandboxed cloud environment with access to a browser, code interpreter, and file system, allowing it to independently plan and complete tasks that would take humans hours. Its launch in early 2025 generated significant attention as one of the first widely available autonomous agents capable of real-world task completion.

name: MarketMuse
description: MarketMuse is an AI content strategy platform that analyses the topical authority of your website and identifies the content investments most likely to move rankings. It scores each piece against the depth and breadth of coverage on competing pages and generates detailed content briefs showing exactly what to cover. Content directors at media companies and enterprise brands use it to prioritise their editorial calendar.

name: Masterpiece Studio
description: Masterpiece Studio is an AI platform that generates 3D models from text descriptions or images, usable in Unity, Unreal Engine, and Blender. Its no-code approach makes 3D asset creation accessible to game developers, educators, and XR creators who lack traditional 3D modelling skills.

name: Mathway
description: Mathway is an AI-powered maths calculator and solver that handles problems from basic arithmetic through calculus, statistics, and linear algebra. Students photograph or type a maths problem, and the app solves it with step-by-step explanations. With over 100 million problems solved, it is one of the most used maths tools globally.

name: Maze
description: Maze is a continuous product discovery platform that lets teams run moderated and unmoderated user studies, prototype tests, and surveys at speed. Its AI features include automatic insight extraction from open-text responses, task path analysis, and AI interview guides. UX and product teams use it to gather feedback in hours, not weeks.

name: MeetGeek
description: MeetGeek automatically records and transcribes meetings, then uses AI to generate summaries, extract highlights, and track topics across time. It integrates with Slack, Notion, HubSpot, and 2,000+ apps via Zapier. Sales teams, recruiters, and managers use it to keep stakeholders informed without attending every call.

name: Mematic
description: Mematic is a mobile app for creating and sharing memes, with a large library of templates and a clean editor that makes formatting quick on a smartphone. It's one of the most downloaded meme apps and popular with casual creators who want to make shareable content on the go. Its AI suggests relevant templates based on trending formats.

name: Meme Generator
description: Meme Generator (memegenerator.net) is one of the original web-based meme creation tools, offering a database of thousands of popular meme templates with a simple caption editor. Its AI-powered features suggest relevant templates for a given topic and can auto-generate captions. With hundreds of millions of memes created on the platform, it's a cultural institution of internet humour.

name: Meshcapade
description: Meshcapade is an AI platform for realistic 3D human body modelling, providing parameterised body shapes and motion data based on the SMPL research model. It's used in animation pipelines, virtual try-on for fashion, ergonomic analysis, and virtual production to generate accurate, diverse human avatars from measurements or video. The platform bridges academic body-modelling research and real-world production workflows.

name: Meta AI
description: Meta AI is the AI assistant embedded across Meta's family of apps — Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger — giving billions of users access to AI-powered conversations without a separate app. Powered by Meta's Llama models, it can answer questions, generate images, draft messages, and help with everyday tasks directly inside the apps people already use every day. Meta AI is also available as a standalone web experience at meta.ai.

name: Metabase
description: Metabase is an open-source business intelligence tool that lets anyone ask questions about company data without SQL. Its AI assistant helps users build queries and charts using plain English. With over 50,000 organisations using it, Metabase is one of the most popular self-hosted analytics solutions.

name: Metricool
description: Metricool is a social media management and analytics platform that supports all major networks, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and websites. Its AI features include caption generation, best-time-to-post recommendations, and competitor benchmarking. Marketing teams use it to manage all channels from a single dashboard.

name: Microsoft Designer
description: Microsoft Designer is a free AI-powered graphic design tool that generates social media posts, invitations, digital postcards, and other visual content from text prompts. Powered by DALL-E for image generation and integrated with Microsoft 365, it suggests complete designs and allows users to customise colours, fonts, and layouts through natural language instructions. It is available as a standalone app and embedded in Microsoft Edge, Teams, and other Microsoft products, bringing AI design capabilities to the 400+ million Microsoft 365 users.

name: Microsoft Government Cloud
description: Microsoft Azure Government is a physically and logically isolated cloud infrastructure that meets the strictest US federal compliance requirements, including FedRAMP High, DoD IL4/IL5, and CJIS. Government agencies use it to run AI workloads — Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, machine learning — within a boundary that satisfies data residency and security policy requirements.

name: Microsoft Phi
description: Microsoft's Phi series (Phi-2, Phi-3, Phi-4) are small language models that consistently outperform much larger models on reasoning and coding benchmarks, validating Microsoft Research's thesis that data quality matters more than model size. The Phi-3-mini (3.8B) runs on smartphones, while Phi-3-medium and Phi-4 deliver near-GPT-4-class performance at a fraction of the cost. Widely available via Azure, Ollama, and Hugging Face, Phi models are a go-to choice for edge deployment and cost-sensitive applications.

name: Microsoft Power Automate
description: Microsoft Power Automate is a cloud-based workflow automation platform deeply integrated with Microsoft 365 and Azure. AI Builder within Power Automate adds document processing, form recognition, and prediction capabilities so business users can automate complex document workflows without custom development. Teams at organisations already in the Microsoft ecosystem use it to connect Office apps with hundreds of external services.

name: Microsoft Translator
description: Microsoft Translator is a cloud-based translation service supporting 100+ languages, available as a mobile app, browser extension, Office integration, and API. Its real-time conversation mode enables multilingual meetings where participants see translations in their own language simultaneously. Azure Cognitive Services customers use the API to add translation to customer service apps, content management systems, and communication tools.

name: Midjourney
description: Midjourney is an AI image generation tool accessed through Discord that produces strikingly artistic, high-quality images from text prompts. It's known for its distinctive aesthetic quality (painterly, detailed, and imaginative) that sets it apart from other generators. Designers, concept artists, and marketers use Midjourney to rapidly visualise ideas, create mood boards, and generate hero images for campaigns.

name: Mintlify
description: Mintlify is a documentation platform for developer products that uses AI to help write and maintain docs. Its Writer extension auto-generates docstrings from code context in any IDE, while its hosted docs platform supports MDX, API references, and versioning. Fast-growing API companies use it for beautiful, accurate documentation.

name: Miro AI
description: Miro is the world's most popular online collaborative whiteboard, used by over 70 million people. Its AI features include AI text-to-diagram generation, sticky note clustering and summarisation, AI-generated images, and a code visualiser. Product, design, and engineering teams use it for ideation, planning, and retrospectives.

name: Missinglettr
description: Missinglettr automatically converts blog posts into year-long social media drip campaigns. It extracts quotes, images, and key points from articles, then generates and schedules social posts that keep evergreen content circulating for months. Bloggers and content marketers use it to maximise content ROI.

name: Mixmax
description: Mixmax is an email productivity and sales engagement extension for Gmail that adds scheduling, email tracking, sequences, and AI-assisted writing. Its AI draft assistant suggests replies and generates email templates based on context, and one-click polls and scheduling links reduce friction in every conversation. Sales development reps and customer success teams use it to send more personalised outreach at higher volume.

name: Modal
description: Modal is a serverless cloud platform for running Python code — especially AI/ML workloads — at scale with no infrastructure management. Developers define GPU functions in Python and Modal handles scaling, cold starts, and orchestration. It is widely used for running fine-tuning jobs, batch inference, and AI model serving.

name: Monday.com
description: Monday.com is a highly visual work management platform that adapts to virtually any team workflow — from sprint planning to event management — through customisable boards, automations, and dashboards. Its AI assistant can draft project plans, summarise updates, and predict project health based on historical delivery data. Over 225,000 customers rely on Monday.com as their central hub for cross-functional work.

name: Moovly
description: Moovly is an enterprise video creation and automation platform that enables organisations to produce personalised videos at scale. Its API allows dynamic video generation by injecting data into templates — used for personalised customer communications, product videos, and automated reporting videos.

name: Morningstar AI
description: Morningstar provides investment research, data, and portfolio management tools to investors and advisors, now enhanced with AI capabilities including AI-generated investment research summaries, natural language queries against financial databases, and Mo (Morningstar's AI assistant) for quick investment analysis.

name: Mosaic
description: Mosaic is a strategic finance platform that connects to ERPs, CRMs, and data warehouses to provide real-time financial dashboards, rolling forecasts, and scenario modelling. Its AI features include natural language metric querying and automated variance analysis that explains why numbers changed.

name: Motion
description: Motion is an AI calendar and task manager that automatically schedules your tasks around your meetings and deadlines, rebuilding your daily plan in real time as priorities shift. Rather than managing a static to-do list, Motion's AI prioritises work intelligently so the most important items always get time on your calendar. Busy professionals and managers use it to protect deep work time and avoid deadline surprises.

name: Moz Pro
description: Moz Pro is a comprehensive SEO toolkit that combines keyword research, site audits, rank tracking, and backlink analysis with AI-powered recommendations. Its MozBar Chrome extension shows SEO metrics on any page. Moz's Domain Authority metric is one of the most widely referenced SEO benchmarks in the industry.

name: Munch
description: Munch uses AI to extract the most engaging and marketable moments from long-form video content and reformats them for social platforms. Unlike simple clipping tools, Munch analyses speech, topics, and engagement signals to identify clips most likely to perform well on LinkedIn, TikTok, and Instagram.

name: Murf
description: Murf is an AI voice generation studio that produces professional-quality voiceovers in 120+ voices across 20 languages without recording equipment. Presenters choose from a library of realistic voices, adjust pitch and speed, sync the audio to video, and export broadcast-ready audio in minutes. eLearning developers, product teams, and content marketers use Murf to localise and voice content at a fraction of studio rates.

name: Mutable AI
description: Mutable AI provides AI-powered code completion, refactoring, and codebase chat. Its AutoPilot feature lets developers describe a feature in plain language and have the AI implement it across multiple files while following existing code conventions. It also generates unit tests and documentation automatically on commit.

name: n8n
description: n8n is an open-source workflow automation platform that lets developers and technical teams build complex automations with full code access and self-hosting control. Unlike Zapier or Make, n8n runs on your own infrastructure, keeping data inside your environment, which matters for compliance-sensitive workflows. Its 350+ native integrations and AI-native nodes make it a favourite for technically minded teams building serious automation.

name: Narrato
description: Narrato is an AI content creation and workflow platform for content teams. It combines an AI writer with content briefs, SEO tools, plagiarism checks, and a project management workflow. Content marketers and agencies use it to manage the entire content lifecycle from brief to published post.

name: Navina
description: Navina is an AI platform that synthesises fragmented patient records into a clear clinical picture, surfacing suspected diagnoses, gaps in care, and documentation opportunities before each encounter. Primary care physicians and care managers use it to ensure comprehensive, accurate coding and deliver proactive care for complex patients.

name: Netlify
description: Netlify is a web development platform that automates the deployment of modern web apps with features including CI/CD, serverless functions, edge computing, and form handling. Its AI features include AI-assisted local development guidance, intelligent build caching, and integration with the Netlify AI assistant for configuration help.

name: Netomi
description: Netomi is an enterprise AI customer service platform that resolves complex support queries across email, chat, SMS, and social with very high automation rates. Its neural network is trained on historical tickets, enabling it to handle nuanced multi-step requests that simpler rule-based bots cannot. Used by Air Canada, Vimeo, and major retailers.

name: Neural.love
description: Neural.love is an AI toolkit for image upscaling, restoration, enhancement, and generation. It can restore old photos, remove noise, upscale images up to 4x, and generate new artwork from text prompts. It is widely used for enhancing low-resolution photos and animating historical images.

name: NeuralText
description: NeuralText combines AI copywriting with SEO research tools including keyword clustering, SERP analysis, and content briefs. Its AI writer generates SEO-optimised content guided by NLP analysis of top-ranking pages. The keyword clustering tool groups thousands of keywords by intent, simplifying content strategy.

name: Nintex
description: Nintex is an enterprise process automation platform that combines workflow automation, document generation, and process mapping into one suite. Its AI-powered process discovery tool analyses how employees actually work and identifies automation opportunities across the organisation. Large enterprises in financial services, healthcare, and government use Nintex to standardise and accelerate complex, document-heavy processes.

name: Nosto
description: Nosto is an AI-powered commerce experience platform that personalises every touchpoint of the online shopping journey — product recommendations, search results, content, and pop-ups — based on individual shopper behaviour. Over 2,500 retailers use it to increase conversion rates and average order values.

name: NotebookLM Plus
description: NotebookLM Plus is the paid tier of Google's NotebookLM research assistant, offering 5× more usage limits, customisable Audio Overview voices, the ability to share notebooks with collaborators, and access to new experimental features first. While the free tier has attracted millions of users for its ability to turn documents into podcasts and answer questions from uploaded sources, the Plus tier is designed for teams, educators, and professionals who rely on it as a primary research workflow tool.

name: Notion
description: Notion is an all-in-one workspace where teams build wikis, manage projects, write docs, and track databases in a flexible, block-based editor. Notion AI is embedded throughout — it can draft documents, summarise pages, answer questions about your workspace, and auto-fill database properties. Over 30 million users choose Notion as the single system of record for their personal and professional knowledge.

name: Notta
description: Notta is an AI transcription tool that records and transcribes meetings, interviews, podcasts, and audio files in 58 languages with high accuracy. It integrates with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams to auto-join and transcribe live meetings, then generates AI summaries, action items, and searchable transcripts. Its translation feature lets multilingual teams share notes across language barriers, making it popular with international teams and journalists who conduct interviews in multiple languages.

name: Noty.ai
description: Noty.ai automatically transcribes Google Meet and Zoom calls, highlights key discussions, and extracts action items and decisions. It integrates with Notion, Slack, and Jira to push tasks directly into your workflow tools. Remote teams use it to maintain accountability and keep async collaborators informed.

name: Nuance DAX
description: Nuance DAX (Dragon Ambient eXperience) by Microsoft uses ambient AI to capture patient-physician conversations and automatically compose clinical notes. It integrates with major EHR systems and is used by thousands of clinicians across hundreds of health systems to eliminate the documentation burden that contributes to physician burnout.

name: Numerous
description: Numerous is an AI layer for Google Sheets and Excel that adds AI-powered functions directly into spreadsheet cells. You can classify text, extract entities, translate content, or generate new data with a formula — no coding or API setup required. Analysts and operations teams use it to process large datasets with AI logic inside the spreadsheet tools they already use every day.

name: Observe.AI
description: Observe.AI uses AI to analyse 100% of contact centre interactions — calls, chats, and emails — for quality assurance, compliance, and coaching. Its real-time agent assistance feature provides live guidance during calls. Contact centres use it to improve CSAT scores, ensure compliance, and reduce agent onboarding time.

name: Obsidian
description: Obsidian is a local-first note-taking app built around a network of interlinked Markdown files that form a visual knowledge graph. AI plugins powered by GPT-4 and other models add summarisation, semantic search, and knowledge-graph Q&A on top of your private vault. Knowledge workers and researchers favour Obsidian for its longevity guarantee — your notes are plain text files you own forever.

name: Okendo
description: Okendo is a customer marketing platform for Shopify brands that collects and displays product reviews, surveys, and loyalty rewards. Its AI features include review sentiment analysis, AI-generated review response suggestions, and insights on which product attributes drive purchases and returns.

name: Ollama
description: Ollama makes it trivially easy to download and run open-source LLMs — Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, Qwen, and dozens more — entirely on your own hardware with a single command. It exposes a local REST API compatible with the OpenAI format, so any application built for GPT can be pointed at a local model instead. Privacy-conscious developers, researchers without cloud budgets, and anyone wanting offline AI capability have made Ollama one of the fastest-growing tools in the AI ecosystem.

name: ON1 Photo AI
description: ON1 Photo AI is an all-in-one photo editor, RAW processor, and organiser with AI-powered tools including noise reduction, super resolution, background removal, and sky replacement. It works standalone or as a Lightroom and Photoshop plug-in, giving photographers AI enhancements without a subscription.

name: Open WebUI
description: Open WebUI (formerly Ollama WebUI) is an open-source, self-hosted web interface that brings a polished ChatGPT-like experience to local AI models running via Ollama, LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. It supports multiple users, conversation history, document uploads, web search integration, image generation, and a growing plugin ecosystem. IT teams and AI enthusiasts deploy it on their own servers to give their organisation a private, self-hosted AI assistant with no data leaving their infrastructure.

name: OpenAI Operator
description: Operator is OpenAI's AI agent that can browse the web and complete multi-step tasks on your behalf — booking restaurants, filling out forms, shopping, researching, and more. It uses a vision-based approach to interact with websites as a human would, without requiring sites to have a specific API. Launched in early 2025, Operator represents OpenAI's push into the agentic AI space where AI doesn't just answer questions but actively accomplishes goals. It is available to ChatGPT Pro subscribers and being expanded to other tiers.

name: OpenAI Realtime API
description: OpenAI's Realtime API enables direct, low-latency speech-to-speech conversations with GPT-4o, without the latency of a traditional transcription → LLM → TTS pipeline. Applications built on it can respond to voice in under 300ms, support natural interruptions mid-sentence, and detect tone and emotion in the speaker's voice. It enables a new class of voice AI products — AI phone agents, real-time translators, voice-controlled assistants — that feel genuinely conversational rather than like talking to an automated phone menu.

name: Opendoor
description: Opendoor is an AI-powered iBuyer that makes instant cash offers on homes, allowing sellers to bypass the traditional listing process entirely. Its valuation model analyses hundreds of property and market signals to generate an offer in minutes, and sellers can close on their own timeline. For homeowners who want certainty and speed over maximum price, Opendoor eliminates months of showings and negotiations.

name: OpenHands
description: OpenHands (formerly OpenDevin) is an open-source platform for AI software engineers that can autonomously write code, fix bugs, run tests, and interact with the web. It operates inside a sandboxed environment and accepts natural language instructions to complete real engineering tasks end-to-end, rivalling proprietary agents like Devin.

name: OpenRead
description: OpenRead is an AI academic platform where researchers upload papers and interact with them through Q&A, extract key findings, and generate structured summaries. Its Skim it feature summarises any paper into a visual poster in seconds. Researchers use it to process large volumes of literature efficiently.

name: OpenRouter
description: OpenRouter provides a single OpenAI-compatible API endpoint that routes requests to over 300 models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, and dozens of smaller labs. Developers can switch between models with a one-line change, implement automatic fallbacks when a provider has an outage, and compare cost per token across every provider in real time. It's become the standard way to build model-agnostic applications and to access models that aren't otherwise available via direct API.

name: Opus Clip
description: Opus Clip uses AI to analyse long-form videos and automatically extract the most engaging segments, then reformats them into short-form clips for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts. It adds captions, highlights keywords, and scores each clip for virality potential.

name: Oracle SCM
description: Oracle Supply Chain Management (SCM) Cloud is an enterprise suite covering procurement, inventory, logistics, manufacturing, and order management.
