Its AI-driven demand sensing adjusts forecasts weekly using real-time signals — including point-of-sale data, weather, and social trends — to reduce excess inventory and prevent stock-outs. Global enterprises standardise on Oracle SCM to get a single, integrated view of their supply chain.

name: Originality.ai
description: Originality.ai detects AI-generated content from GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, and other models with high accuracy. It is designed for publishers, content agencies, and educators who need to verify that submitted work is human-written. It also includes a plagiarism checker and readability score.

name: Otter.ai
description: Otter.ai is an AI meeting assistant that records and transcribes calls in real time, generating a searchable transcript with speaker labels, a condensed summary, and action items. It integrates natively with Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams, and syncs notes to Slack and Notion automatically. Teams in sales, research, and media use Otter to capture institutional knowledge from every conversation.

name: Outreach
description: Outreach is a leading sales execution platform that orchestrates multi-channel sequences — email, phone, LinkedIn, SMS — and analyses which approaches convert best for each prospect segment. Its AI Kaia assistant surfaces objection-handling playbooks in real time during live calls, and a deal health score highlights the accounts most at risk. Enterprise sales organisations use Outreach to run disciplined, data-driven revenue motions.

name: Paige.AI
description: Paige is an AI company focused on digital pathology and cancer diagnosis. Its FDA-authorised Paige Prostate AI was the first AI-based pathology product to receive FDA authorisation, helping pathologists detect prostate cancer with higher accuracy and consistency. Paige's platform analyses whole-slide images across multiple cancer types.

name: Palantir Gotham
description: Palantir Gotham is a data integration and intelligence analysis platform used by government agencies, defence organisations, and law enforcement worldwide. It ingests data from disparate classified and unclassified sources, surfaces connections human analysts would miss, and supports mission-critical decision-making under time pressure. It's the platform behind some of the world's most sensitive national security operations.

name: PandaDoc AI
description: PandaDoc is a document automation platform with AI capabilities for generating proposals, contracts, and quotes. Its AI assistant helps draft document content from templates and deal data, while its e-signature workflow accelerates the close process. Sales teams use it to reduce the time from verbal agreement to signed contract.

name: Paper Digest
description: Paper Digest uses AI to monitor newly published research papers from ArXiv, PubMed, and major conferences, then sends researchers a personalised daily digest summarising the key points of the most relevant new papers. It significantly reduces the time scientists spend monitoring the literature in their field.

name: Paperspace
description: Paperspace (by DigitalOcean) is a cloud computing platform with GPU-backed instances designed for AI, machine learning, and graphics workloads. Its Gradient product provides managed Jupyter notebooks, model training pipelines, and model deployment. Data scientists and ML engineers use it as a fully managed MLOps platform.

name: Pattern89
description: Pattern89 is an AI creative intelligence platform for digital advertising that predicts creative performance before a campaign goes live. It analyses millions of historical ad results to identify which visual elements, copy styles, and formats will resonate with a specific audience — then scores new creatives before spend is committed. Brands and agencies use it to reduce creative risk and improve ROAS.

name: Pencil
description: Pencil is an AI ad generator built specifically for ecommerce brands that need a constant supply of high-performing video and static ad creatives. It trains on your existing top-performing ads and generates new variations aligned with your brand guidelines and proven formulas. DTC brands and performance marketing agencies use Pencil to reduce creative production time while improving ad efficiency.

name: Penpot
description: Penpot is the first open-source design and prototyping platform targeted at cross-functional teams. As a self-hosted or cloud alternative to Figma, it uses web standards (SVG) and offers AI features including component generation and design annotation. Its open-source nature makes it popular with privacy-conscious organisations.

name: People.ai
description: People.ai automatically captures all sales activities — emails, meetings, calls — and maps them to CRM records, eliminating manual data entry. Its AI analyses activity patterns to identify which behaviours drive deal success and recommends next best actions for each rep. Enterprise teams use it for data-driven sales coaching.

name: Peppertype.ai
description: Peppertype.ai (by Pepper Content) is an AI content platform for marketing teams that generates ad copies, product descriptions, social media captions, emails, and blog posts from brand inputs. It learns brand tone over time and offers a content marketplace connecting brands with human writers for hybrid AI-human content.

name: Perplexity
description: Perplexity is an AI-powered search and research engine that gives direct, cited answers to questions rather than a list of blue links. It searches the web in real time, synthesises findings across sources, and presents answers with inline citations you can verify. Researchers, students, and knowledge workers use it as a starting point for any question that previously required reading multiple web pages.

name: Perplexity Labs
description: Perplexity Labs is the experimental arm of Perplexity AI, where the company ships its most advanced features before broader rollout. It includes Deep Research — an autonomous agent that conducts multi-step web research over several minutes and produces comprehensive reports — as well as Perplexity's own R1-style reasoning models. Pro subscribers get early access to Labs features, making it a destination for power users who want the cutting edge of AI-assisted research before it becomes mainstream.

name: Perplexity Pages
description: Perplexity Pages is a publishing feature that turns any Perplexity research session into a polished, shareable article with cited sources, images, and structured sections. Unlike a raw AI conversation, a Page looks like a real article — complete with an introduction, chapters, and a references list — and can be shared publicly or kept private. Researchers, educators, and content creators use Pages to quickly produce well-sourced reference documents on any topic, with the AI handling research, writing, and citation formatting simultaneously.

name: Perplexity Sonar
description: Perplexity Sonar is the API that gives developers access to Perplexity's real-time, search-augmented AI. Unlike standard LLM APIs that are limited to training data, Sonar retrieves up-to-date information from the web and returns answers with citations. It's used to add live search grounding to AI applications without building a web search pipeline from scratch. The Sonar Pro model handles complex, multi-step research queries, while Sonar and Sonar Turbo target high-volume use cases where speed and cost efficiency matter.

name: Persado
description: Persado is an AI platform that uses machine learning to optimise the specific words, phrases, and emotional triggers in marketing communications — emails, push notifications, ads — to maximise engagement. Its models are trained on billions of consumer responses and can predict which language variant will perform best for a given audience segment. Enterprise brands in retail, banking, and travel use Persado to lift conversion rates on campaigns at scale.

name: Personio
description: Personio is an all-in-one HR software platform designed for small and medium businesses across Europe. Its AI features include automated candidate screening, job description generation, and HR document creation. It covers the full employee lifecycle from recruiting and onboarding to payroll and offboarding.

name: Phidata
description: Phidata is an open-source framework for building AI agents with memory, knowledge bases, and multi-agent collaboration. Unlike simpler agent frameworks, Phidata agents maintain long-term memory using vector databases, access structured knowledge via SQL, and can spawn specialised sub-agents to complete complex tasks.

name: Phind
description: Phind is an AI-powered search engine purpose-built for developers and technical questions. It retrieves relevant code, documentation, and Stack Overflow answers, then synthesises a direct response with working code examples. Engineers use Phind when they want a technical answer faster than they'd get from scrolling through search results or waiting for a ChatGPT response.

name: Phrase
description: Phrase is an enterprise localisation platform that combines AI translation, translation memory, and glossary management in a unified workflow. It integrates with GitHub, Figma, and major CMS platforms, enabling continuous localisation alongside product development. Global companies use it to maintain consistent voice across dozens of languages.

name: Pi
description: Pi is a personal AI assistant developed by Inflection AI, designed to be a thoughtful, emotionally intelligent conversational companion. Unlike task-focused assistants, Pi prioritises understanding your context and goals, and guides conversations with curiosity and empathy. It's available on the web, iOS, and Android for people who want an AI that listens and thinks alongside them.

name: Picsart AI
description: Picsart is a popular mobile and web creative platform with powerful AI features including AI image generation, background removal, object removal, AI avatars, and style transfer. With over 150 million monthly active users it is one of the most widely used AI-powered creative apps in the world.

name: Pictory
description: Pictory is an AI video creation platform that turns blog posts, scripts, or text prompts into polished short videos automatically. It matches relevant stock footage from a library of millions of clips to your words, adds subtitles, background music, and a voiceover, then exports a shareable video. Content marketers and eLearning teams use Pictory to repurpose written content into video without any editing skills.

name: Pieces for Developers
description: Pieces is an AI-enhanced developer productivity tool that acts as a long-term memory layer for your coding workflow. It automatically captures code snippets, terminal commands, screenshots, and files from any app, enriches them with AI-generated context and tags, and makes them instantly searchable and reusable. Its Pieces Copilot connects to your local snippet library, IDE history, and connected repositories to answer questions with direct references to your own past work. Developers use it to stop re-solving problems they have already solved.

name: Pika Labs
description: Pika is an AI video generation platform that creates and edits videos from text prompts, images, or existing video clips. Its Pika 1.5 model supports dynamic camera movements, character consistency, and photorealistic output — pushing the frontier of what AI video generation can produce in seconds. Filmmakers, advertisers, and social media creators use Pika to concept and produce motion content at unprecedented speed.

name: Piktochart
description: Piktochart is a visual communication tool for creating infographics, presentations, reports, and social graphics with a drag-and-drop editor. Its AI Report generator transforms raw data or a topic into a complete, visually structured document in seconds. Communications professionals and educators use it to make complex information accessible and shareable without graphic design training.

name: Pilot
description: Pilot provides AI-powered bookkeeping, tax, and CFO advisory services for startups and growing companies. Its software automatically categorises transactions, reconciles accounts, and generates financial statements, with human expert review for accuracy. Y Combinator, Sequoia-backed, and thousands of startups trust Pilot for their finances.

name: Pinecone
description: Pinecone is the most widely used managed vector database, providing the long-term memory infrastructure for AI applications. When building a RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) system, embeddings are stored in Pinecone and retrieved by semantic similarity at query time, giving LLMs access to private knowledge without fine-tuning. Its serverless tier makes it free to start, while its managed service scales to billions of vectors for enterprise applications. Pinecone is a foundational component in the majority of production AI applications built in 2024-2025.

name: Pipedrive
description: Pipedrive is a sales-focused CRM designed to keep deal pipeline visible and moving forward. Its AI Sales Assistant analyses your deal history and interaction patterns, then surfaces the next best action for each opportunity — whether that's following up, scheduling a demo, or re-engaging a stalled prospect. Sales teams at SMBs and mid-market companies choose Pipedrive for its clarity and low overhead compared to heavier CRMs.

name: Pitch
description: Pitch is a collaborative presentation platform for design-forward teams that want more polish and less friction than Google Slides. Its AI assistant generates complete slide decks from a prompt, and real-time collaboration features mean a whole team can work on the same deck simultaneously with live cursors. Startups and agencies use Pitch to create investor decks and client presentations that stand out.

name: PitchBook
description: PitchBook is the leading data and research platform for the private equity, venture capital, and M&A markets. Its AI features include Morningstar quantitative equity ratings integrated with deal data, predictive fundraising signals, and natural language search across its database of 3 million+ companies.

name: Pixelcut
description: Pixelcut is an AI-powered photo editor built specifically for e-commerce product photography. It removes backgrounds, generates AI product backgrounds, upscales images, and batch-edits product photos to create consistent, professional listings for Shopify, Etsy, and Amazon. Its mobile app makes studio-quality photos possible from a smartphone.

name: Plaid
description: Plaid is the financial data infrastructure that powers thousands of fintech apps — budgeting tools, investment platforms, lending services — by securely connecting to users' bank accounts with their permission. Its AI-powered categorisation engine classifies transactions and enriches data so developers can build financial features without writing their own banking integrations. Over 8,000 applications use Plaid to move money and access financial data.

name: Planet Labs
description: Planet Labs operates the world's largest commercial fleet of Earth-observation satellites, capturing daily imagery of every point on Earth. Its AI analytics platform detects changes — deforestation, crop stress, infrastructure development, disaster damage — automatically from the imagery stream. Governments, NGOs, and businesses use Planet data to monitor climate commitments, manage supply chain risk, and respond to humanitarian crises.

name: Planner 5D
description: Planner 5D is a free AI home design tool that lets anyone create detailed 2D floor plans and switch to a photorealistic 3D walkthrough with one click. Its AI design assistant can generate complete room layouts from a brief description, choosing furniture and decor that fit the space. Homeowners and interior designers use it to visualise renovations and communicate design intent to contractors.

name: PlantNet
description: PlantNet is a collaborative AI platform for plant identification — you photograph a plant leaf, flower, or fruit and the app returns likely species matches drawn from a database of millions of identified specimens. It's used by hikers, foragers, gardeners, and scientists to identify wild plants and contribute sightings to global biodiversity monitoring. The project is run by French research institutions and citizen-science contributors.

name: Plasmic
description: Plasmic is a visual development platform that lets designers and developers build React web apps without writing layout code. Designers work visually while developers integrate the output into their existing codebase. Its AI features include component generation from text descriptions and design-to-code export.

name: Playground AI
description: Playground AI is a web-based image generation platform that combines Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, and its own fine-tuned models in a single canvas editor. Its free tier is among the most generous in the space, offering daily image generations at high quality. The canvas editor lets users mix generated and uploaded images, apply filters, and iterate rapidly — making it popular with designers and creators who want a more interactive experience than a simple prompt box.

name: Plus AI
description: Plus AI is a presentation add-in for Google Slides and PowerPoint that generates complete slide decks from prompts, remixes existing slides, and rewrites content. It is used by consultants and business teams to create first-draft decks from meeting notes, reports, and documents in minutes.

name: Poe
description: Poe, built by Quora, is a platform that puts GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and dozens of other AI models behind a single interface. Users can chat with any model, compare responses side by side, and discover community-created bots specialised for specific tasks. Its subscription unlocks unlimited messages across premium models, making it a popular choice for power users who want flexibility without managing multiple subscriptions.

name: Polycam
description: Polycam is a mobile and web app that captures real-world objects and spaces in 3D using a smartphone camera or LiDAR sensor. Its AI processing converts photos into accurate 3D models exportable to GLTF, OBJ, and CAD formats. Architects, game developers, and e-commerce brands use it to digitise physical objects.

name: PostHog AI
description: PostHog is an open-source product analytics platform combining event tracking, session recording, feature flags, A/B testing, and surveys. Its Max AI assistant answers product questions using your data, generates SQL queries, and summarises user sessions automatically.

name: Power BI
description: Power BI is Microsoft's business intelligence and data visualisation platform, allowing analysts to connect to any data source, build interactive dashboards, and share insights across the organisation. Its AI features — including natural-language Q&A, automated insights, and anomaly detection — surface trends and outliers without requiring the end user to write any queries. It's the BI tool of choice at organisations already standardised on Microsoft products.

name: Powtoon
description: Powtoon is a platform for creating animated presentations, explainer videos, and training content. Its AI features include a text-to-video converter and AI script assistant. With millions of users across 100 countries, it is widely used in corporate training, education, and marketing.

name: Privy
description: Privy is an e-commerce marketing platform for Shopify and WooCommerce stores that combines pop-ups, email, and SMS marketing. Its AI helps create targeted campaigns based on cart abandonment, browsing behaviour, and purchase history, helping small e-commerce brands compete with enterprise marketing tools.

name: Productivity Directory
description: Productivity Directory is a curated listing of the best AI-powered productivity tools, organised by category and use case. It helps professionals discover tools that save time across writing, scheduling, note-taking, and project management. Each listing includes a description, pricing tier, and user ratings to support quick evaluation.

name: Promethean AI
description: Promethean AI is an AI assistant for 3D artists and game developers that automates the tedious, repetitive parts of virtual world-building. It understands natural-language instructions like 'build a forest clearing at dusk' and populates a 3D scene with contextually appropriate assets from your library. Production teams at game studios and virtual production houses use it to assemble environments in hours rather than days.

name: Proposify
description: Proposify is proposal software with AI-assisted content suggestions, interactive pricing tables, and e-signatures. Its AI analyses which proposal sections correlate with wins and surfaces recommendations for improvement. Sales and agency teams use it to create professional proposals faster and track client engagement in real time.

name: ProWritingAid
description: ProWritingAid is a comprehensive writing assistant that goes deeper than grammar checking — it analyses pacing, repeated words, sentence length variation, dialogue tags, readability, and over 25 other writing dimensions to help authors write cleaner, more compelling prose. Integrated with Scrivener, Google Docs, and Word, it's a favourite among fiction writers and self-published authors who want manuscript-level editing without hiring a human editor. Its AI rephrasing suggestions and genre-specific style checks make it particularly strong for long-form writing.

name: Qodo AI
description: Qodo AI (formerly CodiumAI) analyses your code and automatically generates meaningful unit tests, integration tests, and test plans. It understands code behaviour and edge cases, not just code structure. Unlike other AI tools that write tests on demand, Qodo continuously monitors code changes and suggests tests that actually catch bugs.

name: Quizlet AI
description: Quizlet is the world's largest student learning platform with 700 million study sets. Its AI features include Q-Chat (an AI tutor that practises with students), Magic Notes (which auto-generates flashcards from uploaded notes), and personalised study plans that adapt to each student's weak areas.

name: Qwen
description: Qwen (short for Tongyi Qianwen) is Alibaba's family of large language models, available in sizes from 0.5B to 235B parameters and consistently ranking among the top open-weight models on coding, reasoning, and multilingual benchmarks. The Qwen2.5 and QwQ reasoning models have attracted significant attention for outperforming models many times their size. Freely available for download and commercial use, Qwen is widely run through Ollama, LM Studio, and Hugging Face by developers looking for capable open alternatives to proprietary APIs.

name: Qwilr
description: Qwilr turns sales proposals into interactive, web-based pages with embedded pricing calculators, video, and e-signatures. Its AI writing assistant generates proposal content from deal notes and templates, while analytics show exactly which sections prospects viewed and for how long.

name: Railway
description: Railway is a deployment platform designed for simplicity that lets developers deploy any application — from web apps to databases to ML models — without DevOps complexity. Its AI features include a CLI assistant that diagnoses deployment failures and suggests fixes in natural language.

name: Raw Shorts
description: Raw Shorts is an AI video creation tool that transforms scripts and text into animated explainer videos automatically. Its AI matches keywords in the script with relevant animated scenes and characters, producing a first-cut video in seconds. Marketers and educators use it as a rapid starting point for explainer content.

name: Raycast AI
description: Raycast is a Mac productivity launcher that replaces Spotlight, and its AI layer brings ChatGPT-style capabilities into the same keyboard-driven interface. Summon AI from anywhere on the desktop to rewrite emails, translate text, explain code, or answer questions, all without switching apps or opening a browser. Raycast AI supports multiple model providers including OpenAI and Anthropic, and developers can build custom AI commands using its extension SDK. It has become the productivity launcher of choice for many Mac-based developers and designers.

name: Readwise Reader
description: Readwise Reader is a read-later app that captures articles, newsletters, PDFs, and YouTube transcripts and resurfaces your highlights via spaced repetition. Its Ghostreader AI feature lets you chat with any document, generate summaries, define terms, and create flashcards from content you've saved.

name: Real-ESRGAN
description: Real-ESRGAN is an open-source AI model for image and video super-resolution — it upscales low-resolution content up to 4× while sharpening detail and reducing noise using deep convolutional networks. Originally developed for upscaling anime, it handles photographic content equally well. Video creators, archivists, and photographers use it to restore or enhance footage that was captured at insufficient resolution.

name: Recharge
description: Recharge is the leading subscription management platform for e-commerce, used by 20,000+ merchants including Dr. Axe and Bulletproof. Its AI features include churn prediction models, smart dunning management, and personalised subscription offers that reduce cancellations and grow recurring revenue.

name: Redfin
description: Redfin is an AI-powered real estate brokerage that combines accurate automated home valuations with a network of salaried agents (rather than commission-only ones). Its platform surfaces personalised property recommendations based on your search history, budget, and must-haves, and provides real-time alerts when matching homes come to market. Buyers appreciate Redfin's fee structure and the transparency of its data-driven estimates.

name: Remini
description: Remini is a mobile AI app that restores and enhances old, blurry, or low-resolution photos using advanced face restoration AI. It can sharpen facial details in degraded photos and transform selfies into AI-generated portraits in various artistic styles. With over 100 million downloads, it is one of the most popular AI photo apps.

name: RemNote
description: RemNote is an AI note-taking and study system built around spaced repetition — as you write notes, it automatically generates flashcards and schedules reviews to maximise long-term retention. Its AI assistant can summarise content, generate quiz questions, and explain concepts within your note vault. Students and lifelong learners use RemNote to turn passive notes into an active memory-building system.

name: Renderforest
description: Renderforest is an all-in-one branding platform with AI-powered tools for creating animated videos, explainer videos, logos, and websites. Its AI video scene generator converts scripts into animated scenes automatically. Over 20 million users have created content with Renderforest for social media, presentations, and promotions.

name: Replica Studios
description: Replica Studios provides AI voice actors specifically designed for video games, interactive media, and virtual reality. It offers a library of 40+ voice actor styles with emotional range, real-time voice generation via API, and custom voice creation. Its ethical AI voice framework ensures actors are compensated for their contributions.

name: Replika
description: Replika is an AI companion app where users build a personalised relationship with an AI avatar that learns their personality, interests, and communication style over time. It's designed for emotional support, self-reflection, and companionship, and has found a loyal audience among people experiencing loneliness, social anxiety, or grief. Replika adapts its tone and topics to each user through continuous conversation.

name: Replit
description: Replit is a cloud-based IDE and collaborative coding platform that runs code in the browser without any local setup. Its Replit AI assistant powers code completion, debugging, and the ability to describe an app in words and have Replit build and deploy it end-to-end. Students learning to code and professional developers prototyping quickly both use Replit because the friction from idea to running code is near zero.

name: ResearchRabbit
description: ResearchRabbit is an AI-powered literature discovery tool for academic researchers that maps the citation network around any paper. You seed it with one or two key papers and it surfaces related work, follow-up studies, and seminal references — visualised as an interactive graph. Researchers use it to survey a new field far faster than manually tracing citations in Google Scholar.

name: Resemble AI
description: Resemble AI is a voice cloning and speech synthesis platform that creates custom AI voices from a small sample of audio — as little as three minutes of clean recording. Its API delivers ultra-low-latency voice generation for real-time applications like conversational AI and interactive games. Brands, game studios, and voice AI developers use it to build voices that sound indistinguishable from their human counterparts.

name: Resume.io
description: Resume.io is an AI-assisted resume builder with a large collection of templates designed to look professional and pass ATS screening. Its AI writing suggestions improve bullet points, fill gaps in experience descriptions, and adapt the language to specific job titles. Millions of job seekers have used Resume.io to create and iterate on application documents quickly.

name: Retool AI
description: Retool is a low-code platform for building internal business tools, dashboards, and admin panels. Its AI features let developers query databases, call APIs, and chain AI models using natural language. Retool AI agents can take actions inside the app — submitting forms, running queries, or triggering workflows — based on user requests.

name: Rev
description: Rev is a transcription and captioning service that combines AI-powered automated transcription (with fast turnaround and low cost) and human-reviewed transcription (with 99%+ accuracy) for when stakes are highest. It's the default caption provider for many media companies, law firms, and market research agencies. The AI transcription service now handles millions of minutes of audio per month.

name: Reverso
description: Reverso is an AI translation tool that goes beyond word-for-word conversion by showing how words and phrases are used in real-world bilingual sentence pairs from translated books, subtitles, and websites. Its context engine helps learners and translators understand nuance, register, and natural phrasing that dictionary definitions miss. Language learners and professional translators use Reverso as a complement to dictionaries and grammar references.

name: Rezi
description: Rezi is an AI resume builder specifically engineered to score well with applicant tracking systems (ATS) — the software that filters most resumes before a human sees them. Its AI analyses your content against ATS criteria and provides a real-time score with specific suggestions for improvement. Job seekers frustrated by sending applications into the void use Rezi to ensure their resume clears the algorithmic gatekeeper.

name: Rippling
description: Rippling is an all-in-one platform that unifies HR, payroll, IT, and spend management. Its AI features automate onboarding workflows, generate job descriptions, power custom approval chains, and provide workforce analytics. Over 10,000 companies use Rippling to manage their entire employee lifecycle.

name: Rive
description: Rive is a real-time interactive animation platform where designers create animations that respond to game state, user input, and data — not just play back a fixed sequence. Its runtime is lightweight enough to run in a browser, iOS app, or game engine without performance costs. UI engineers and game developers use Rive to add state-machine-driven animations that make interfaces feel genuinely alive.

name: Riverside
description: Riverside.fm is a high-quality remote podcast and video recording studio that captures each participant's audio and video locally — not over a streamed connection — to ensure broadcast-quality recordings regardless of internet conditions. Its AI features include automatic transcription, clip generation, and background removal. Podcasters and video journalists use it when recording quality is non-negotiable.

name: Roam Research
description: Roam Research is a note-taking tool built around bidirectional linking and outliner-style writing, designed to mirror how the mind associatively connects ideas. Every page can reference any other, building a dense knowledge graph that surfaces unexpected connections over time. Knowledge workers and writers use Roam as a 'second brain' for capturing and connecting ideas over years of continuous use.

name: Roboflow
description: Roboflow is a computer vision platform that handles the full workflow from dataset annotation to model training to deployment. Users can label images, augment datasets, fine-tune models like YOLOv8 and SAM, and deploy them to the cloud, edge devices, or web browsers. Its Universe library hosts over 250,000 public datasets and pre-trained models, dramatically reducing the time needed to start a new vision project. Roboflow is used by manufacturers for quality inspection, retailers for shelf analytics, and developers building object detection applications.

name: Rosetta Stone
description: Rosetta Stone is one of the oldest and most recognised language learning brands, now offering a fully digital, AI-driven immersive learning experience in 25 languages. Its TruAccent speech-recognition engine gives instant pronunciation feedback, and lessons are structured to build intuition through context — like how children learn — rather than grammar rules. It's popular with adults and institutions seeking a rigorous, structured approach.

name: RunPod
description: RunPod is a GPU cloud marketplace that offers on-demand and spot GPU instances for AI training, fine-tuning, and inference at competitive prices. Developers and researchers use it to run Stable Diffusion, LLaMA, and other open-source models without the cost of hyperscaler GPU reservations.

name: Runway
description: Runway is a leading AI creative studio that offers an end-to-end suite of tools for video and image generation, editing, and transformation. Its Gen-2 model generates video from text or image prompts, while tools like Inpainting, Green Screen, and Motion Tracking automate complex editing tasks. Professional filmmakers, VFX artists, and creative agencies use Runway as their AI-native post-production environment.

name: Salesforce
description: Salesforce is the world's leading CRM platform, used by over 150,000 companies to manage customer relationships, sales pipelines, service cases, and marketing campaigns. Its Einstein AI is deeply embedded, scoring leads, forecasting revenue, generating content, and suggesting next best actions automatically. The AppExchange ecosystem adds 4,000+ third-party integrations, making Salesforce the central operating system for most enterprise revenue teams.

name: Salesforce Einstein
description: Salesforce Einstein is the AI layer embedded throughout the Salesforce platform, delivering predictive scoring, automated insights, and generative features across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Marketing Cloud. Einstein GPT can generate personalised emails, service replies, and code within the Salesforce environment — all grounded in your CRM data. Enterprises use it to make every Salesforce process smarter without building separate AI systems.

name: SalesLoft
description: Salesloft is a sales engagement platform that helps revenue teams orchestrate multi-channel outreach sequences and analyse what cadences, messaging, and timings produce the most meetings and pipeline. Its Rhythm AI engine surface prioritises the daily actions reps should take based on buyer engagement signals. Enterprise SDR teams and account executives use it to run disciplined, high-volume prospecting without losing personalisation.

name: SaneBox
description: SaneBox is an AI email management service that analyses your email behaviour and automatically sorts incoming messages into folders — SaneLater, SaneBlackHole, SaneNews — so your inbox only contains what needs your attention today. It works with any email client via IMAP and takes less than a minute to set up. Professionals drowning in newsletters and FYI threads use SaneBox to regain inbox focus.

name: SAP Ariba
description: SAP Ariba is the world's largest business commerce network, connecting buyers and suppliers for procurement, invoicing, and supply chain collaboration. Its AI features include smart contract compliance checking, supplier risk scoring, and spend analytics that identify savings opportunities across a company's entire purchasing history. Global enterprises use SAP Ariba to manage billions of dollars of spend more strategically.

name: Sassbook AI
description: Sassbook AI provides AI tools for story writing, text summarisation, headline generation, and paraphrasing. Its AI Story Writer generates narrative content in a chosen style and genre, helping fiction writers overcome writer's block and develop plots. Its summariser condenses long documents into key points.

name: Scale AI
description: Scale AI provides high-quality training data, evaluation, and RLHF (reinforcement learning from human feedback) services that underpin many of the world's most important AI models. Its platform combines human annotation with AI-assisted tooling to label images, text, video, and sensor data at scale. OpenAI, Meta, Microsoft, and the US Department of Defense are among its customers. Scale's Spellbook product lets enterprises fine-tune and evaluate large language models on their proprietary data.

name: Scalenut
description: Scalenut is an AI content platform that combines SEO research with AI writing. It analyses top-ranking pages for any keyword, builds a content brief with NLP-extracted topics, then helps writers produce optimised articles. Its Cruise Mode generates a full 1,500-word blog post from a keyword in under five minutes.

name: Scenario
description: Scenario is an AI game asset generator that lets game developers create consistent, branded 2D and 3D art assets at scale. You train a custom AI model on your existing art style, then generate hundreds of characters, environments, items, and UI elements that match your game's visual identity. Indie developers and mid-sized studios use Scenario to prototype new content and fill gaps in production pipelines.

name: Scholarcy
description: Scholarcy is an AI research tool that reads academic papers, reports, and book chapters and produces a structured, skimmable summary — highlighting key findings, methodology, limitations, and references. It exports summaries to a personal library or integrates with reference managers like Zotero. Researchers and graduate students use it to assess the relevance of a paper in minutes rather than reading the full text.

name: Scinapse
description: Scinapse is a free academic search engine covering 250 million papers across all scientific disciplines, powered by AI relevance ranking. It provides paper summaries, citation networks, author profiles, and journal rankings. Researchers prefer it over Google Scholar for its cleaner interface and AI-curated recommendations.

name: SciSpace
description: SciSpace (formerly Typeset) is an AI platform for reading and understanding research papers. You upload or find a paper and its AI assistant explains difficult concepts, answers questions about methodology, and compares findings across multiple studies. Researchers and students use SciSpace to accelerate comprehension of dense technical literature without needing a domain expert on call.

name: Scribbr
description: Scribbr offers a suite of AI tools for academic writing including a citation generator supporting APA, MLA, Chicago, and Harvard styles, a paraphrasing tool, a grammar checker, and a plagiarism checker. It is trusted by millions of students worldwide for producing publication-quality academic work.

name: SeaArt
description: SeaArt is a web-based AI image generation platform powered by Stable Diffusion with advanced features including ControlNet, LoRA models, and an AI canvas. It hosts thousands of community-shared models and workflows. Its generous free tier and professional tools attract both casual users and serious digital artists.

name: Semantic Scholar
description: Semantic Scholar is a free AI-powered academic search engine from the Allen Institute for AI that covers 200+ million scientific papers. Its AI extracts key concepts, influential citations, and research impact metrics from papers — and a natural-language Q&A feature, powered by Semantic Reader, lets researchers ask questions directly about uploaded papers. Scientists use it to cut through the exponential growth of scientific literature.

name: Sembly AI
description: Sembly AI records, transcribes, and summarises meetings from Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet. It extracts action items, decisions, and risks automatically, then makes meeting insights searchable across your team. Enterprise teams use it to build an institutional memory of decisions made across hundreds of meetings.

name: Semgrep
description: Semgrep is a fast, open-source static analysis tool for finding bugs and security vulnerabilities across 30+ languages. Its AI-assisted rule writing and Semgrep Assistant features automatically triage findings, write custom rules from plain-English descriptions, and explain vulnerabilities with remediation guidance.

name: SEMrush
description: SEMrush is an all-in-one digital marketing toolkit covering SEO, PPC, content marketing, social media, and competitive research. Its AI-powered features include a writing assistant that optimises content for target keywords, automated site health audits, and a traffic analytics tool that estimates competitor performance. Over 10 million marketing professionals use SEMrush to grow organic traffic and outmanoeuvre competition.

name: ServiceNow
description: ServiceNow is an enterprise workflow platform that digitises and automates processes across IT, HR, customer service, finance, and facilities. Its Now Intelligence AI uses natural language processing to classify and route tickets, predict resolution times, and recommend relevant knowledge articles automatically. Large enterprises standardise on ServiceNow as the system of record for all internal service delivery.

name: Sheet+
description: Sheet+ is an AI tool for Google Sheets that generates complex formulas, explains existing ones, and debugs errors from plain-English descriptions. It works as a Chrome extension that sits inside the spreadsheet interface, so you never have to leave your workbook to get help. Finance and operations professionals use it to handle formula complexity that would otherwise require a dedicated spreadsheet specialist.

name: Shopify
description: Shopify is the leading ecommerce platform powering over 2 million online stores, from solo creators to enterprise brands. Its AI suite — Shopify Magic — generates product descriptions, writes email subject lines, and provides AI-powered analytics that surface growth opportunities. The platform's app ecosystem of 8,000+ integrations means any store can be extended without custom development.

name: Shortwave
description: Shortwave is an AI-powered email app for Gmail that uses AI to triage your inbox, group related emails into threads, and surface the most important messages. Its AI assistant can draft replies, summarise long email threads, and answer questions about emails using natural language.

name: SideChef
description: SideChef is an AI-powered cooking app that provides step-by-step guided recipes with smart shopping lists and personalised meal planning. Its AI adapts recipe suggestions to your dietary preferences, pantry contents, and cooking skill level. Over 18 million users use SideChef to cook more at home, reduce food waste, and discover cuisines they wouldn't have tried otherwise.

name: SimilarWeb
description: SimilarWeb is a digital intelligence platform that estimates website and app traffic, audience demographics, and engagement metrics for any domain — including your competitors'. Its AI models analyse traffic sources, keyword rankings, and referral networks to give marketers a clear picture of where a competitor's audience comes from and how to attract them. Analysts at over 4,500 enterprise customers use SimilarWeb for benchmarking and M&A due diligence.

name: simpleshow
description: simpleshow uses AI to transform complex topics into simple, engaging explainer videos. Its Explainer Engine analyses scripts and automatically creates illustrated videos with a distinctive whiteboard animation style. Enterprise companies use it for training, change management, and product explainers across global teams.

name: Siri
description: Siri is Apple's AI voice assistant, built into every iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and HomePod. It handles voice-activated device control, calendar management, messaging, web search, and app interactions entirely on-device for privacy. With iOS 18 and Apple Intelligence, Siri gained deeper app integration and the ability to perform complex, cross-app actions on your behalf.

name: Sisense
description: Sisense is a business intelligence and embedded analytics platform with deep AI capabilities including natural language querying, predictive analytics, and anomaly detection. Its Compose SDK lets developers embed interactive analytics directly into SaaS products, making it popular among ISVs and digital-native companies.

name: Sketch
description: Sketch is a native Mac application for UI and UX design, product design, and prototyping. Its AI features include an AI design assistant for generating content and assets, smart layout suggestions, and an increasingly powerful web companion for viewing and collaborating on designs without a Mac.

name: SketchUp
description: SketchUp is a 3D modelling application widely used by architects, interior designers, and construction professionals for conceptual design and spatial planning. Its AI-assisted extensions can generate layouts, suggest materials, and visualise realistic lighting scenarios. The platform balances ease of entry — most people can build a basic 3D model in an hour — with the depth needed for professional architectural and engineering work.

name: Slidebean
description: Slidebean automatically designs pitch deck slides as users type their content, choosing the optimal layout for each slide type. It includes startup-focused templates for investor pitches and has been used by over 100,000 startups. Its pitch deck service pairs AI design with human designer review.

name: SlidesAI
description: SlidesAI is a Google Workspace add-on that converts any text, document, or topic into a presentation in Google Slides automatically. It selects themes, layouts, and summarises content into concise slide points. Educators and business users use it to transform long documents into presentation-ready decks in seconds.

name: Smartcat
description: Smartcat is a translation and localisation platform that combines AI translation with a marketplace of professional translators. Its AI engine provides instant machine translation, while the built-in editor lets human translators review and refine output. Enterprises use it for large-scale, high-quality multilingual content.

name: Smartly.io
description: Smartly.io is an AI-powered social advertising platform that automates creative production, campaign management, and optimisation across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and Pinterest at scale. Its AI generates creative variations from brand assets and continuously shifts budget toward the combinations and audiences driving the best results. Performance-focused brands managing significant social ad spend use it to run hundreds of ad variants efficiently.

name: Smartsheet AI
description: Smartsheet is a work management platform that blends spreadsheet familiarity with project management power. Its AI capabilities include formula generation from natural language, automated status summaries, risk prediction for projects, and an AI assistant that answers questions about your data.

name: SmolAgents
description: SmolAgents by Hugging Face is a lightweight, minimalist library for building AI agents in just a few lines of code. It focuses on code agents that write and execute Python to complete tasks, supports tool use across the Hugging Face Hub, and integrates with any LLM. Researchers and developers use it to prototype agents rapidly.

name: Snyk AI
description: Snyk is a developer security platform with deep AI capabilities including DeepCode AI, which uses the largest code security dataset to detect vulnerabilities in source code, and Snyk Advisor for evaluating open-source package health. It integrates into CI/CD pipelines and IDEs so security issues are caught before they reach production.

name: SocialBee
description: SocialBee is a social media management tool with an AI post generator, content calendar, and category-based scheduling that ensures a balanced content mix. Its Copilot feature creates a tailored social media strategy from a questionnaire, then generates and schedules posts automatically.

name: Socratic by Google
description: Socratic is Google's AI-powered learning app for students that uses AI and augmented reality to help with homework. Students photograph a question and the app explains the concept step-by-step with visual aids, curated web resources, and video explanations. It covers maths, science, literature, and social studies.

name: Softr
description: Softr lets anyone build web apps, portals, and internal tools from Airtable or Google Sheets data without coding. Its AI app builder generates a working app from a text description in seconds. Businesses use it to build customer portals, directories, job boards, and CRM dashboards.

name: Sonix
description: Sonix is an automated transcription service that converts audio and video files to text in over 40 languages with high accuracy. It includes an in-browser editor for correcting transcripts, automated translation, and subtitle export. Journalists, researchers, and podcasters use it to process hours of audio in minutes.

name: Sora
description: Sora is OpenAI's text-to-video model that generates photorealistic video clips up to a minute long from text descriptions. It understands physical world dynamics (lighting, motion, depth) at a level that made its first public demos widely considered a step change for AI video. Released in late 2024, Sora is available to ChatGPT Plus and Pro subscribers for creating cinematic content from text alone.

name: Sourcegraph Cody
description: Cody is Sourcegraph's AI coding assistant, distinguished by its ability to understand your entire codebase rather than just the file you're editing. It integrates with VS Code, JetBrains, and the web, using Sourcegraph's code intelligence to answer questions like "how does our auth system work?" with real references to the actual code. Cody supports multiple underlying models — Claude, GPT-4, Gemini — and is widely used in large enterprise codebases where whole-repo context is essential.

name: Spark Mail
description: Spark is a smart email client for iOS, macOS, and Android with AI features including Smart Inbox that automatically prioritises important emails, AI reply suggestions, email scheduling, and a collaborative email drafting mode for teams. It connects to Gmail, Outlook, and iCloud accounts.

name: Speechify
description: Speechify is a text-to-speech app that converts any text — web pages, PDFs, emails, books — into natural-sounding audio you can listen to at up to 4.5× normal reading speed. Its AI voice cloning feature lets users create a personal AI voice that reads content in their own voice. Students, professionals with dyslexia, and busy commuters use Speechify to consume written content faster than reading allows.

name: Spline
description: Spline is a browser-based 3D design tool that lets designers create, animate, and publish interactive 3D scenes without knowing 3D modelling software. Its AI feature generates 3D scenes from text prompts and enables real-time collaboration on 3D assets. Web designers and product teams use Spline to embed interactive 3D elements into websites and apps with minimal engineering effort.

name: Spotify for Podcasters
description: Spotify for Podcasters (now part of Spotify's creator tools) provides free podcast hosting, distribution, and analytics alongside AI-powered features like automatic transcripts, clip suggestions, and audience Q&A. Podcasters publish to Spotify's 600-million-user platform directly and monetise through Spotify's subscription and ad programs. It's the largest podcast platform globally and the most straightforward path to a broad audience.

name: Sprout Social
description: Sprout Social is an enterprise social media management platform that combines publishing, engagement, analytics, and listening in a single suite. Its AI features include sentiment analysis, optimal send-time recommendations, and AI-assisted reply suggestions that help community managers respond to high volumes of messages consistently. Enterprise marketing and communications teams use it to manage social presence at scale with data-driven confidence.

name: Stability AI
description: Stability AI is the company that created Stable Diffusion and has been one of the most influential forces in open-source generative AI. Beyond image generation, it has released Stable Video Diffusion, Stable Audio, and Stable LM models, and its API platform gives developers programmatic access to all its models. Its decision to open-source Stable Diffusion fundamentally changed the AI image generation landscape by enabling the entire ecosystem of local tools, LoRAs, ControlNets, and community models that exist today.

name: Stable Video Diffusion
description: Stable Video Diffusion is Stability AI's open-source video generation model that converts images into short, consistent video clips. Released as a research model, it became foundational for developers building video tools on top of an openly available architecture. It can generate 2–4 seconds of smooth, realistic video from a single input image and is actively used in open-source video generation pipelines.

name: Stamped.io
description: Stamped.io is a reviews, ratings, and loyalty platform for e-commerce stores with AI-powered sentiment analysis and review highlights. It automatically generates review requests, analyses feedback themes, and surfaces product improvement insights. Its loyalty module rewards customers with points, discounts, and VIP tiers.

name: Stampli
description: Stampli is an AI-powered accounts payable platform that centralises invoice communication, approvals, and payments on top of existing ERP systems. Its Billy the Bot AI learns each company's unique AP patterns, automatically coding invoices and routing them for approval with over 80% touchless processing rates.

name: StarryAI
description: StarryAI is a mobile AI art generation app that lets users create paintings, illustrations, and digital art from text prompts on iOS and Android. It offers full ownership of generated images, multiple art styles, and daily free credits. Artists use it for quick visual prototyping and social media content.

name: Stepsize
description: Stepsize is a technical debt management tool that lives inside VS Code and JetBrains IDEs. Developers annotate code with issues inline, and Stepsize tracks them in a prioritised backlog synced with Jira and Linear. Its AI suggests which technical debt items to address based on code change frequency and business impact.

name: Steve AI
description: Steve AI converts blog posts, scripts, and text content into animated or live-action videos automatically. It matches keywords from the script with relevant stock footage, adds automated voiceovers, and produces finished videos in minutes. It is popular for explainer videos, training content, and social media posts.

name: Stitch Fix
description: Stitch Fix is an AI-powered personal styling service that sends a curated box of clothing and accessories to your door based on your style profile, size, and budget. Its combination of machine-learning algorithms and human stylists selects items tailored to each individual client, and your feedback on each box makes future selections more accurate over time. It's turned traditional fashion retail into a personalised, subscription-like experience.

name: StockImg AI
description: StockImg AI generates custom stock images, logos, book covers, posters, wallpapers, and UI designs from text prompts. Unlike standard stock photo sites, every image is unique and royalty-free. Teams use it to generate on-brand marketing visuals without paying per-image licensing fees.

name: StudySmarter
description: StudySmarter is an AI study platform used by over 15 million students globally. It converts lecture notes, PDFs, and textbooks into smart flashcards, practice tests, and study plans. Its AI tutor explains difficult concepts and identifies knowledge gaps, adapting the study schedule based on performance.

name: SubtitleBee
description: SubtitleBee is an AI auto-captioning tool that adds accurate subtitles to videos in 120+ languages with no manual synchronisation required. You upload a video and within minutes receive a captioned version ready for social media, complete with customisable font styles and burned-in captions. Content creators use it to make videos accessible and drive the higher engagement that on-screen text delivers on social platforms.

name: Suki AI
description: Suki AI is a voice-enabled AI assistant for physicians that listens to patient encounters and automatically generates structured clinical notes in the EHR. Doctors speak naturally and Suki formats the conversation into SOAP notes, reducing documentation time by over 70% and allowing physicians to focus on patients.

name: Sunsama
description: Sunsama is a daily planning tool that pulls tasks from Asana, Todoist, GitHub, Linear, and other tools into a single daily plan. Its AI suggests how to organise your day based on available time and priorities. It emphasises sustainable work rhythms with time-boxing and end-of-day shutdown rituals.

name: Supabase AI
description: Supabase has integrated AI deeply into its open-source Firebase alternative, offering pgvector support for storing and querying embeddings directly in Postgres, a built-in AI assistant in the dashboard that writes SQL and explains queries, and Edge Functions with AI capabilities. Developers building RAG applications can store embeddings alongside their application data in the same Postgres database, eliminating a separate vector database. Supabase's AI features let full-stack developers add vector search and LLM integration without adding new infrastructure.

name: Superhuman
description: Superhuman is a blazing-fast email client for Gmail and Outlook built around keyboard shortcuts, AI triage, and a philosophy of achieving inbox zero every day. Its AI writes reply drafts from short prompts, predicts which emails can be triaged quickly, and provides a split inbox that puts the highest-priority messages front and centre. Executives and operators who live in email pay the premium tier for the speed and focus it provides.

name: Supermaven
description: Supermaven is an AI code completion tool that processes up to 300,000 tokens of context — far more than most rivals — enabling it to understand entire codebases rather than just the current file. Built by the creator of Tabnine, it delivers sub-100ms suggestions and integrates with VS Code and JetBrains.

name: Supernormal
description: Supernormal joins Google Meet, Zoom, and Teams meetings to take notes automatically, producing structured summaries with action items in real time. It allows teams to create custom note templates for different meeting types — standups, 1-on-1s, and sales calls — ensuring consistent documentation.

name: Surfer SEO
description: Surfer SEO is a content optimisation platform that analyses the top-ranking pages for a keyword and gives writers a real-time content score showing how well their draft covers the topic. Its AI outline and article generation tools build a fully structured, SEO-optimised draft from scratch in seconds. Content teams at agencies and in-house SEO departments use Surfer to produce content that reliably ranks.

name: Swimm
description: Swimm is a code documentation platform with AI that keeps docs automatically synced with code changes. When code is modified, Swimm detects affected documentation and flags it for update or auto-updates it. Engineering teams use it to maintain living documentation that developers actually read because it is always current.

name: Synthesia
description: Synthesia is the leading AI video generation platform for creating professional presenter videos without cameras, studios, or actors. You type a script, choose from 160+ AI avatars in 120+ languages, and receive a polished video in minutes. Enterprise L&D teams, communications departments, and content marketers use Synthesia to produce training videos, product explainers, and multilingual corporate content at scale.

name: Tableau
description: Tableau is a leading data visualisation and business intelligence platform that lets analysts build interactive dashboards from any data source through a drag-and-drop interface. Its AI-powered features — Explain Data, Ask Data (natural-language Q&A), and Einstein Discovery — surface insights automatically and let non-technical users explore data without writing SQL. Data teams at over 85,000 organisations use Tableau to democratise analytics across the business.

name: Tabnine
description: Tabnine is an AI code completion assistant that learns from your team's codebase to suggest completions, functions, and documentation that match your project's patterns and style. Unlike GitHub Copilot, Tabnine is self-hostable, making it popular with enterprises and regulated industries that can't send code to a third-party cloud. It supports 80+ languages and integrates with all major IDEs.

name: Tactiq
description: Tactiq is a Chrome extension that transcribes meetings in real time on Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams, then uses AI to generate summaries and action items. Unlike recording-based tools, Tactiq captures captions as they appear without recording the meeting, making it useful in privacy-sensitive organisations.

name: Talkdesk
description: Talkdesk is a cloud contact centre platform with AI capabilities including virtual agents, real-time agent assistance, quality management AI, and workforce management optimisation. Its Talkdesk AI Trainer lets contact centres fine-tune NLP models for their specific industry vocabulary without machine learning expertise.

name: Tana
description: Tana is a next-generation note-taking and knowledge management tool centred on its Supertag system — a way to create rich, typed nodes that behave as structured data. Its AI features include AI command pipelines that transform notes, extract data, and generate content using custom prompts attached to node types.

name: Taskade
description: Taskade is an AI-native project management and collaboration platform where AI agents work alongside human teams. Users can create projects as task lists, mind maps, flowcharts, or documents, and deploy AI agents to automate research, writing, and task assignment. Its built-in AI can turn a goal into a full project plan, summarise meeting notes into action items, and answer questions about any project in context. Teams use it as an all-in-one workspace that combines task management, notes, chat, and AI automation.

name: Tempus AI
description: Tempus AI applies AI and machine learning to clinical and molecular data to help physicians make more informed treatment decisions. Its platform analyses genomic sequencing data, medical imaging, and clinical records to identify patterns in cancer care, cardiology, and mental health, enabling personalised treatment at scale.

name: Textio
description: Textio analyses and improves workplace writing — job postings, performance reviews, and HR communications — using AI trained on language and hiring outcome data. It flags biased language, predicts how diverse candidates will respond to job postings, and suggests neutral alternatives to help organisations build more inclusive hiring practices.

name: The Yes
description: The Yes is an AI-powered personal shopping app that learns your exact style preferences through a swipe-based onboarding and adapts its feed in real time as you engage with products. Rather than browsing a generic product catalogue, every item in your feed is pre-curated by the AI to match your taste, size, and budget. Acquired by Pinterest in 2022, its technology now powers Pinterest's shopping features.

name: ThoughtSpot
description: ThoughtSpot is an AI-driven business intelligence platform that lets anyone query data by typing questions in plain English. Its Spotter AI agent generates charts, dashboards, and insights automatically. It connects to Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, and other cloud warehouses, making self-service analytics accessible to non-technical users.

name: Tipalti
description: Tipalti is an AI-powered payables automation platform that handles the full AP workflow — onboarding suppliers, collecting tax forms, processing payments in 196 countries, and reconciling payments in the ERP. Its AI validates payment details, detects fraud patterns, and ensures regulatory compliance across global payment networks.

name: tl;dv
description: tl;dv (too long; didn't view) records, transcribes, and summarises meetings on Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. Its AI automatically identifies key moments, action items, and decisions, creating a searchable archive of everything discussed. Sales teams use it to review calls and coach reps, while product teams use it to capture customer interviews. Its clip-sharing feature lets anyone share the exact moment from a meeting that matters, eliminating the need to watch full recordings.

name: Todoist
description: Todoist is a clean, cross-platform task manager used by over 42 million people to organise personal and professional to-do lists. Its AI assistant converts vague tasks like 'write the report by Friday morning' into scheduled, prioritised items automatically. Power users appreciate Todoist's natural-language input, karma system, and integrations with calendar apps and communication tools.

name: Together AI
description: Together AI is a cloud inference platform specialising in open-source models, offering some of the fastest and cheapest API access to Llama, Mistral, Qwen, FLUX, and dozens of other models. It's designed to be an OpenAI-compatible drop-in for developers who want open models without the cost and complexity of self-hosting. Together also runs fine-tuning jobs and provides a playground for prompt experimentation. Startups building on open models frequently use Together AI to keep inference costs low while maintaining model flexibility.

name: Tome
description: Tome is an AI-native presentation and storytelling tool that generates complete, designed narratives from a prompt, including text, images, charts, and even live data embeds. Rather than a slide deck you assemble piece by piece, Tome treats a presentation as a flowing document, making it well-suited for memos, proposals, and investor updates that benefit from a narrative structure.

name: Topaz Photo AI
description: Topaz Photo AI combines Topaz's best AI models — Sharpen AI, Denoise AI, and Gigapixel AI — into one intelligent workflow. It automatically detects and corrects blur, noise, and low resolution in a single pass. Photographers and studios use it to recover technically imperfect shots and upscale images for large-format printing.

name: Topaz Video AI
description: Topaz Video AI is a professional video enhancement application that uses deep-learning models to upscale, deinterlace, stabilise, and increase the frame rate of video footage. It runs entirely locally on your GPU, making it a privacy-friendly choice for restoring archival footage, upscaling home videos to 4K, and preparing content for large-screen delivery. Professional video editors use it as a finishing step when source quality falls short.

name: Tray.io
description: Tray.io is a general automation platform for enterprises with a visual workflow builder and native AI capabilities. Its Merlin AI assistant helps users build automation workflows from natural language descriptions and recommends improvements to existing automations. It connects to 600+ apps with enterprise-grade security.

name: Turnitin
description: Turnitin is the world's leading academic integrity platform, now with an AI writing detection capability that identifies text generated by ChatGPT, Claude, and other LLMs with high accuracy. Used by over 16,000 educational institutions, it helps educators assess authentic learning while adapting to the era of generative AI.

name: Udemy
description: Udemy is an open online learning marketplace with over 220,000 courses taught by independent instructors, covering everything from Python and UX design to guitar playing and yoga. Its AI personalises course recommendations and learning paths based on your career goals and past activity. Unlike subscription platforms, most courses are purchased individually — often at steep discounts — and owned permanently.

name: UiPath
description: UiPath is a leading robotic process automation (RPA) platform that deploys software robots to automate repetitive, rule-based tasks — form filling, data extraction, system integrations — across desktop and web applications. Its Document Understanding and AI Fabric modules add AI-powered document processing and ML models to complex automation scenarios. Large enterprises use UiPath to free employees from high-volume manual work that software APIs can't yet automate.

name: Unbounce AI
description: Unbounce is a landing page builder with powerful AI features including a copy generator, Smart Traffic (which automatically routes visitors to the variant most likely to convert), and AI-powered recommendations for improving conversion rates. It integrates with HubSpot, Mailchimp, and Salesforce.

name: Undermind
description: Undermind is an AI research agent that conducts thorough academic literature searches far beyond what keyword search tools find. Given a research question, it recursively follows citation trails and semantic connections across scientific databases to surface the most relevant papers, even from unexpected disciplines.

name: Upscayl
description: Upscayl is a free, open-source AI image upscaler for Linux, macOS, and Windows that processes images entirely on your GPU without sending data to any server. It uses Real-ESRGAN models to upscale photos, illustrations, and digital art by 2x to 16x with impressive quality, making it the go-to privacy-friendly upscaler.

name: Vapi
description: Vapi is a developer platform for building voice AI agents that can make and receive phone calls. It handles the complex infrastructure of telephony, speech-to-text, LLM integration, and text-to-speech — letting developers focus on the conversation logic. Vapi supports custom voices via ElevenLabs and Cartesia, pluggable LLMs including GPT-4 and Claude, and function calling for taking actions during calls. Companies use it for AI receptionists, appointment booking, outbound sales calls, and customer support automation.

name: Vast.ai
description: Vast.ai is a decentralized GPU marketplace where users can rent idle GPU capacity from hosts around the world at prices significantly below hyperscaler rates. AI researchers, indie developers, and startups use it to run training jobs and inference workloads affordably on a wide range of NVIDIA GPU models.

name: Vectorizer.ai
description: Vectorizer.ai uses AI to convert JPEG and PNG images to high-quality SVG vector graphics with clean paths and accurate colour reproduction. It is designed for designers who need scalable versions of logos, illustrations, or icons for print and web use, producing far cleaner results than traditional threshold-based vectorisers.

name: VEED.io
description: VEED.io is a browser-based video editor with powerful AI features including auto-subtitle generation, AI avatars for spokesperson videos, background removal, and noise cancellation. It requires no software installation and supports collaboration, making it popular with content creators, educators, and marketing teams.

name: Venice AI
description: Venice is an AI platform built around radical privacy — conversations are processed on-device where possible and never stored, logged, or used for training. It offers uncensored access to open-source models like Llama and Mistral for text, as well as image generation via Flux and Stable Diffusion, without the content restrictions found on mainstream platforms. Journalists, researchers, and privacy-conscious users choose Venice for sensitive queries and creative work that other AI services decline or record.

name: Venngage
description: Venngage is an online visual communication platform for creating infographics, reports, presentations, and data visualisations with minimal design experience. Its AI generator creates complete infographics and reports from a topic or data file, applying professional design principles automatically. Marketers, HR teams, and educators use Venngage to produce polished visual content without hiring a graphic designer.

name: Vercel AI
description: Vercel is a cloud platform for frontend development with first-class AI capabilities including the Vercel AI SDK (open-source TypeScript toolkit for building AI-powered UIs), instant serverless deployment, and edge AI inference. It powers Next.js applications with AI features at the edge, used by over 1 million developers.

name: Vertex AI
description: Vertex AI is Google Cloud's fully managed machine learning platform, providing access to Gemini, PaLM, Imagen, and other Google foundation models alongside tools for fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment. Its Model Garden offers 130+ models from Google and third parties. Vertex AI Studio provides a no-code playground for prompt engineering, while the SDK enables programmatic integration into applications. Enterprises choose Vertex AI for its deep integration with BigQuery, Google's data infrastructure, and for compliance-grade AI deployment with audit logging and VPC controls.

name: Vidyo.ai
description: Vidyo.ai automatically converts long-form video content into engaging short clips optimised for LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels. Its AI identifies key moments, adds animated captions, and resizes the frame. Podcasters, educators, and marketers use it to multiply their reach with minimal effort.

name: Visily
description: Visily is an AI-powered wireframing and prototyping tool that can convert a screenshot or sketch into an editable UI design in seconds. It includes 1,500+ templates, component libraries, and an AI assistant that generates screens from text descriptions. Design and product teams use it to go from idea to prototype in minutes.

name: Visme AI
description: Visme is a visual content platform for creating presentations, infographics, reports, and social media graphics. Its AI Designer generates complete branded presentations from a prompt, while the AI Writer populates slides with relevant content. Marketing and communications teams use it as an alternative to Canva for data-heavy visuals.

name: Voicemod
description: Voicemod is a real-time AI voice changer that transforms your voice during live streams, gaming sessions, and video calls. It offers hundreds of voice effects plus an AI custom voice creator. Gamers, streamers, and content creators use it for entertainment and to maintain privacy during online interactions.

name: Vue.ai
description: Vue.ai is an AI platform for retail and fashion that automates catalogue management, powers personalised product recommendations, and enables visual search and styling. Its AI tags thousands of product attributes across a catalogue in minutes — colour, style, occasion, fabric — and uses those tags to power a hyper-personalised shopping experience. Fashion retailers integrate Vue.ai to increase conversion and average order value through tailored discovery.

name: Vyond
description: Vyond is an AI-powered animated video creation platform that lets teams produce professional cartoon and character-based explainer videos without animation expertise. Its library of characters, scenes, and actions covers business, education, and healthcare scenarios, and an AI script-to-video feature generates a complete animated video from a script. Corporate L&D teams and marketing departments use Vyond to make training and communication content more engaging.

name: W&B Weave
description: Weave is Weights & Biases' platform for tracking, evaluating, and iterating on LLM applications. It automatically logs every LLM call — inputs, outputs, latency, cost, and model version — and provides tools to build evaluation datasets, run automated evals, and compare model versions side by side. Teams building production AI applications use Weave to catch regressions when switching models, measure hallucination rates, and systematically improve prompt quality over time. It integrates with any LLM provider via a lightweight SDK wrapper.

name: Waifu2x
description: Waifu2x is an open-source neural network-based image and video upscaler originally designed for anime-style artwork. It uses convolutional neural network models to intelligently enlarge images 2× while reducing compression artefacts and preserving clean edges. Despite its specialised origin, it works well on photographic content and remains a popular free option for basic AI upscaling tasks.

name: Warp
description: Warp is a modern terminal built for the AI era, featuring a block-based command interface and a built-in AI that explains errors, suggests commands from natural language descriptions, and provides contextual documentation. Rather than a traditional scrolling terminal, Warp groups inputs and outputs into discrete blocks that can be shared, bookmarked, and edited like a document. Its AI can be queried with '# describe what you want to do' to generate the exact shell command needed. Warp has become the preferred terminal for many developers on Mac, with Linux and Windows support added in 2024.

name: Watershed
description: Watershed is an enterprise sustainability platform that helps companies measure, reduce, and report their carbon emissions under a rigorous, auditable methodology. Its AI automates the collection and categorisation of emissions data from spend, energy, and operations, and generates reports aligned with GHG Protocol and CDP requirements. Leading companies including Airbnb, Stripe, and Shopify use Watershed to meet investor and regulatory climate commitments.

name: Wave.video
description: Wave.video is a video marketing platform that combines a video editor, live streaming, screen recorder, and video hosting.
