Its AI features include automatic video resizing for different platforms, auto-subtitles, and a text-to-video creator from blog posts. Marketers use it to repurpose content across every channel.

name: Weather.ai
description: Weather.ai is an AI-powered weather forecasting service that uses machine learning to improve forecast precision beyond traditional numerical weather prediction models. It offers hyperlocal hourly and daily forecasts via a clean web interface and API. Outdoor activity planners and small businesses with weather-sensitive operations use it as a more accurate alternative to standard weather apps.

name: WeatherBug
description: WeatherBug is a weather app and service known for its dense network of personal weather stations that provide hyper-local temperature and condition readings beyond what airport sensors capture. Its AI-enhanced forecast model incorporates crowdsourced station data to produce more accurate neighbourhood-level predictions. Gardeners, sports coaches, and commuters who need precise local conditions use WeatherBug alongside mainstream weather services.

name: Webflow
description: Webflow is a visual web development platform that lets designers build production-ready, custom-coded websites through a visual editor — without writing HTML, CSS, or JavaScript directly. Its AI Diffing feature and component-based design system support enterprise-scale design ops workflows. Agencies and marketing teams choose Webflow for the creative freedom of a custom build with the speed of a no-code tool.

name: WellSaid Labs
description: WellSaid Labs provides enterprise-grade text-to-speech with AI voices that sound indistinguishable from human voice actors. It integrates into eLearning platforms, product UIs, and content pipelines. Businesses can create custom brand voices and maintain consistent audio branding across all content without recurring voice-actor costs.

name: Whimsical AI
description: Whimsical is a collaborative visual workspace for wireframes, flowcharts, mind maps, and sticky notes. Its AI features include AI-generated mind maps and flowcharts from a text description, AI wireframe generation, and a cursor chat AI assistant. Product teams and educators use it to quickly visualise ideas and processes.

name: Whisk
description: Whisk is an AI-powered recipe and meal planning app by Google that suggests personalised recipes based on ingredients you already have, dietary restrictions, and taste preferences. You can save recipes from any website, create a weekly meal plan, and generate an automated shopping list in seconds. Home cooks use it to reduce food waste and break out of meal planning ruts.

name: Wix ADI
description: Wix ADI (Artificial Design Intelligence) is Wix's AI website builder that creates a personalised website from a few questions about your business — instantly generating layout, copy, and imagery in the right structure for your industry. It then hands you a fully editable site built on Wix's platform. It's the fastest path to a credible website for small businesses that don't want to start from a blank template.

name: Wolfram Alpha AI
description: Wolfram Alpha is a computational knowledge engine that answers factual queries by computing answers from structured data rather than retrieving web pages. Its AI integration with ChatGPT and native chat interface extends it to complex problem solving in maths, science, engineering, and finance.

name: WooCommerce
description: WooCommerce is the most popular ecommerce plugin for WordPress, powering over 36% of all online stores worldwide. Its AI extensions add product description generation, personalised recommendations, and smart coupon management on top of WordPress's flexible publishing engine. Established website owners on WordPress use WooCommerce to add ecommerce without migrating to a new platform.

name: WordAI
description: WordAI is an AI article rewriter that rewrites existing content at the sentence and paragraph level to produce unique, human-quality variations. It understands meaning and rewrites with context rather than simple synonym substitution. Content agencies use it to create multiple versions of articles for different audiences or markets.

name: Wordsmith
description: Wordsmith by Automated Insights is a natural language generation platform that converts structured data into written narratives at scale. Companies use it to generate thousands of personalised reports, product descriptions, and financial summaries automatically. The Associated Press uses Wordsmith to produce automated earnings reports.

name: Workato
description: Workato is an enterprise automation platform that connects apps and automates complex business workflows without code. Its AI features include a natural language recipe builder, intelligent document processing, and AI-powered bots. Over 17,000 enterprises use Workato to automate processes across HR, finance, and IT.

name: Workday
description: Workday is a cloud-based human capital management and financial management platform used by over 10,000 organisations globally. Its AI features deliver workforce planning insights, predict employee attrition risk, and automate time-consuming HR and finance processes like headcount approvals and expense categorisation. Large enterprises in regulated industries choose Workday for its depth of HR and finance functionality in a single unified system.

name: Writerly
description: Writerly is an enterprise AI writing platform that lets brands train AI on their own voice, tone guidelines, and product information. Teams can build custom templates, maintain brand consistency, and generate on-brand content at scale. It integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, and major CMS platforms.

name: Writesonic
description: Writesonic is an AI writing platform covering blog posts, marketing copy, product descriptions, and long-form articles with a suite of content-specific templates. Its Chatsonic assistant can browse the web for real-time information and generate content grounded in current events. Content teams use Writesonic as a high-volume content engine that accelerates production without requiring a larger writing staff.

name: x.ai
description: x.ai was an AI scheduling assistant that automated meeting coordination by analysing emails and finding mutually available times without any manual back-and-forth. Users CC'd Amy or Andrew (its AI personas) on an email thread and the assistant handled all the scheduling logistics autonomously. Though x.ai shut down in 2021, it pioneered the email-native AI assistant category.

name: Yelp
description: Yelp is the leading platform for local business discovery and crowd-sourced reviews in the US, covering restaurants, contractors, salons, and services. Its AI-powered search ranks results by relevance, distance, and review sentiment, and personalises recommendations based on your past activity. For local businesses, a strong Yelp presence directly influences consumer decision-making in their neighbourhood.

name: Yodlee
description: Yodlee (part of Envestnet) is a financial data aggregation platform that connects securely to thousands of financial institutions to consolidate account, transaction, and investment data in one place. Its AI enrichment layer categorises and standardises transaction data so fintech developers can build personal finance, lending, and advisory applications without building banking connections from scratch. It powers the data layer behind many leading personal finance apps.

name: Yotpo
description: Yotpo is an e-commerce marketing platform that uses AI to collect and leverage reviews, ratings, and user-generated content. Its AI analyses review sentiment, auto-responds to reviews, and surfaces insights for product improvement. Its loyalty and SMS marketing modules help brands build direct relationships with customers.

name: You.com
description: You.com is a privacy-focused AI search engine with a conversational interface that searches the web and synthesises answers with source citations. Its YouCode assistant is specifically optimised for technical search and coding questions, and YouWrite helps draft content directly in the search interface. Users who want an ad-free, AI-native search experience without sending queries to Google use You.com as their default.

name: Yuka
description: Yuka is an AI-powered food and cosmetic scanner that analyses product barcodes and gives a clear health score based on ingredient quality and nutritional content. It flags harmful additives, explains why a score is high or low, and suggests healthier alternatives available in local stores. Over 50 million users in 15 countries use Yuka to make more informed choices at the supermarket.

name: Zapier
description: Zapier is the most widely used no-code automation platform, connecting 6,000+ apps through simple 'if this, then that' workflows called Zaps. Its AI features include natural-language workflow creation — describe what you want to automate and Zapier builds the Zap — and AI actions that connect LLMs like ChatGPT directly into your automations. Over 2 million businesses use Zapier to eliminate manual handoffs between their software tools.

name: Zed AI
description: Zed is a high-performance code editor built in Rust that includes native AI features: inline code generation, an assistant panel for chatting with LLMs, and real-time collaboration. Its tight integration between editing speed and AI makes it a favourite among developers who want both performance and intelligence.

name: Zendesk
description: Zendesk is a leading customer service platform that manages support tickets across email, chat, voice, and social media with AI-powered triage, routing, and automated responses. Its Zendesk AI uses generative AI to draft agent replies, suggest the right macro, and automatically resolve common questions without human involvement. Customer experience teams at over 100,000 companies use Zendesk to scale support quality as they grow.

name: Zeni
description: Zeni is an AI-first finance operations platform offering real-time bookkeeping, monthly financial reports, and a finance dashboard for startups. It uses AI to categorise transactions, identify anomalies, and deliver financial insights. Venture-backed startups use it as a modern alternative to traditional accounting services.

name: Zety
description: Zety is an AI-powered resume and cover letter builder with a large library of professionally designed templates and a real-time resume scorer. Its AI content analyser checks your resume against the requirements of your target role and suggests stronger action verbs, quantified achievements, and relevant skills. Job seekers use Zety to create multiple tailored application documents quickly during an active job search.

name: Zillow
description: Zillow is the most visited real estate marketplace in the US, giving buyers, sellers, and renters instant access to property listings, estimated values (Zestimates), and neighbourhood data. Its AI valuation model processes millions of data points to estimate home values within days of a change in condition or market dynamics. First-time buyers and seasoned investors both start their property search on Zillow.

name: ZipRecruiter
description: ZipRecruiter is an AI-powered job marketplace that distributes job postings to 100+ job boards simultaneously and uses machine learning to identify the most qualified candidates from applicants. Its 'Invite to Apply' feature proactively reaches passive candidates who match a role's requirements. Over 1.8 million businesses have used ZipRecruiter to fill positions faster than posting to a single job board.

name: Zoho
description: Zoho is an integrated suite of over 55 business applications — CRM, email, HR, accounting, project management, and more — that competes with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace at a significantly lower price point. Its AI assistant Zia runs across multiple Zoho apps, surfacing insights, automating workflows, and assisting with writing tasks. Businesses choose Zoho when they want one vendor to handle most of their software needs affordably.

name: Zoho CRM
description: Zoho CRM is a feature-rich sales platform with an AI assistant called Zia that scores leads, predicts deal closure probability, detects anomalies in sales activity, and suggests the best time to contact each prospect. It competes directly with Salesforce and HubSpot on features while undercutting them on price — making it popular with mid-market companies and cost-conscious SMBs. Zoho CRM integrates deeply with the rest of the 55-app Zoho suite.

name: ZoomInfo
description: ZoomInfo is the leading B2B go-to-market intelligence platform, providing verified contact and company data for over 100 million professionals and 30 million companies. Its AI-powered intent data identifies which companies are actively researching solutions in your category — so sales and marketing teams can prioritise outreach at the moment a prospect is most likely to buy. Enterprise revenue teams use ZoomInfo to eliminate cold outreach and focus on accounts showing genuine buying signals.

name: Zotero
description: Zotero is a free, open-source reference management tool that helps researchers collect, organise, cite, and share research sources. Its AI features include automatic metadata extraction from PDFs and web pages, duplicate detection, and a growing ecosystem of plugins for AI-powered literature analysis and paper discovery.

name: Zowie
description: Zowie is an AI customer service platform built specifically for e-commerce brands. It automatically resolves common customer queries about orders, returns, and shipping, and escalates complex issues to human agents. It integrates natively with Shopify, Zendesk, and Gorgias.

name: Notion
description: Notion is an all-in-one workspace where teams build wikis, manage projects, write docs, and track databases in a flexible, block-based editor. Notion AI is embedded throughout. It can draft documents, summarise pages, answer questions about your workspace, and auto-fill database properties. Over 30 million users choose Notion as the single system of record for their personal and professional knowledge.

name: 01.AI
description: 01.AI is a Chinese AI startup founded by Kai-Fu Lee that develops and releases the Yi series of large language models. The Yi models are high-performance open-weight models competitive with leading proprietary models on standard benchmarks.

name: ABBYY
description: ABBYY is a leader in intelligent document processing, offering AI-powered OCR, data capture, and document understanding solutions for enterprise automation. Its platform extracts structured data from unstructured documents such as invoices, contracts, and forms at scale.

name: ACE Studio
description: ACE Studio is an AI singing voice synthesizer that lets producers and musicians create realistic vocal performances from text lyrics and melodies. It offers a library of AI singer voices with expressive rendering for pop, classical, and other genres.

name: Aide
description: Aide is an AI-powered code editor forked from VS Code that integrates large language models directly into the development workflow. It supports multi-file edits, codebase-aware completions, and conversational code assistance without leaving the editor.

name: Aisera
description: Aisera is an enterprise AI platform that automates IT service management, HR, and customer support through conversational AI and autonomous resolution. It uses generative AI to deflect tickets, resolve issues without human intervention, and improve employee and customer experience.

name: Aleph Alpha
description: Aleph Alpha is a German AI company that develops Luminous, a family of multimodal large language models designed for European data sovereignty requirements. It focuses on explainability, data privacy, and on-premises deployment for regulated industries and public sector organizations.

name: Alexa AI
description: Alexa AI is Amazon's voice-based personal assistant, available on Echo devices, smartphones, and third-party hardware. It handles voice commands for smart home control, music playback, shopping, reminders, and general knowledge queries, with a growing set of generative AI capabilities.

name: Alpha3D
description: Alpha3D is an AI platform that transforms 2D product images into high-quality 3D digital assets in minutes. It serves e-commerce retailers, game developers, and AR/VR creators who need scalable 3D content without manual 3D modeling work.

name: Animoto
description: Animoto is a cloud-based video creation platform that turns photos, video clips, and music into polished marketing and social media videos. It provides templates, drag-and-drop editing, and AI-powered automation to help businesses and creators produce videos quickly.

name: Arize AI
description: Arize AI is a machine learning observability platform that helps teams monitor, debug, and improve AI models in production. It provides real-time performance tracking, drift detection, and a visual interface for evaluating LLM outputs and embedding quality.

name: Artisan AI
description: Artisan AI builds autonomous AI employees called Artisans that handle end-to-end business functions. Its first product, Ava, is an AI business development representative that researches prospects, drafts personalized outreach emails, and manages sales pipeline tasks automatically.

name: Ashby
description: Ashby is an all-in-one recruiting platform combining applicant tracking, scheduling, and analytics with AI-powered features. It helps talent teams move faster by automating workflows, surfacing candidate insights, and providing detailed hiring funnel metrics.

name: Attio
description: Attio is a flexible, AI-native CRM that adapts to any go-to-market motion without rigid data structures. It automatically enriches contact and company data, surfaces relationship insights, and lets teams build custom workflows and views on top of their network data.

name: Augment Code
description: Augment Code is an AI software development tool that integrates into IDEs like VS Code and JetBrains to provide context-aware code completions, chat, and edits. It indexes the entire codebase to deliver suggestions that are aware of existing patterns, APIs, and conventions.

name: Beamery
description: Beamery is a talent operating system that uses AI to attract, engage, and retain talent throughout the full recruitment lifecycle. It provides candidate relationship management, talent pooling, and workforce planning tools that help enterprises build proactive talent pipelines.

name: Beehiiv
description: Beehiiv is a newsletter and media platform built for creators and publishers to grow and monetize their audience. It offers AI writing assistance, subscriber analytics, ad network integration, and paid subscription tools in a single publishing environment.

name: Bloomreach
description: Bloomreach is a composable digital experience platform that uses AI to deliver personalized product discovery, site search, and marketing automation for e-commerce brands. Its AI engine learns shopper behavior to improve search relevance, recommendations, and merchandising rules.

name: Botpress
description: Botpress is an open-source conversational AI platform for building, deploying, and managing chatbots and virtual agents. It combines a visual flow builder with LLM integration, allowing developers and non-technical users to create sophisticated bots for customer support, sales, and internal automation.

name: Braintrust
description: Braintrust is a developer platform for evaluating, testing, and improving LLM-powered applications. It provides experiment tracking, dataset versioning, human and automated scoring, and a UI for comparing prompt iterations and model outputs.

name: Braze
description: Braze is a leading customer engagement platform that uses AI to deliver personalized messaging across email, push, SMS, in-app, and web channels. Its Sage AI layer powers predictive analytics, intelligent timing, and content personalization to boost conversion and retention.

name: Brex
description: Brex is a financial technology company offering corporate credit cards, expense management, and business banking designed for startups and growth-stage companies. Its AI features automate expense coding, enforce spend policies, and provide real-time financial insights.

name: Browserbase
description: Browserbase is a cloud platform that provides scalable, reliable headless browsers for AI agents and automation workflows. It handles browser lifecycle management, proxies, and CAPTCHA resolution so developers can focus on building agents that interact with the web.

name: Cassidy AI
description: Cassidy AI connects to company knowledge bases and tools to build AI assistants that can handle repetitive business processes. Teams use it to create workflows that draft content, research prospects, answer customer queries, and route tasks by drawing on internal data.

name: Chroma
description: Chroma is an open-source embedding database designed to make it easy to build LLM applications with long-term memory. Developers use it to store and query vector embeddings for semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and context-aware AI applications.

name: Cleanlab
description: Cleanlab is a data-centric AI platform that automatically detects and fixes label errors, outliers, and data quality issues in training datasets. It uses algorithms to identify the most impactful data problems and helps teams curate high-quality datasets for more reliable models.

name: ClearML
description: ClearML is an open-source MLOps suite that covers the full machine learning lifecycle from experiment tracking and data management to model deployment and pipeline orchestration. It integrates with popular ML frameworks and provides a self-hosted or cloud-managed control plane for AI teams.

name: CleverTap
description: CleverTap is a customer engagement and retention platform that uses AI to analyze user behavior and automate personalized campaigns across mobile, web, and messaging channels. Its TesseractDB stores years of user data at scale to power real-time segmentation and predictive analytics.

name: Close
description: Close is a sales CRM designed for inside sales teams, featuring built-in calling, email sequencing, and SMS in a single platform. Its AI features include call transcription, summarization, and lead scoring to help reps prioritize and close deals faster.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
description: Cloudflare Workers AI lets developers run AI inference workloads on Cloudflare's global edge network using serverless functions. It provides access to popular open-source models for text generation, embeddings, image classification, and translation with low latency and no GPU management.

name: Codecademy
description: Codecademy is an interactive online learning platform offering courses in programming, data science, and web development. It uses AI to provide personalized learning paths, instant feedback on code exercises, and an AI coding assistant to help learners overcome challenges.

name: Codemod
description: Codemod is a platform for automating large-scale code migrations, refactoring, and upgrades using AI and community-contributed codemods. It helps engineering teams update dependencies, move between frameworks, and apply consistent code changes across massive codebases.

name: Comet ML
description: Comet is an MLOps platform that provides experiment tracking, model registry, and production monitoring for machine learning teams. It integrates with popular ML frameworks to log metrics, hyperparameters, and artifacts, enabling reproducibility and collaboration across data science teams.

name: Constructor
description: Constructor is an AI-native product discovery platform that provides search, browse, recommendations, and quizzes optimized for e-commerce revenue. Its models learn from shopper behavior and business metrics to continuously improve conversion rates and average order value.

name: ContractPodAi
description: ContractPodAi is an AI-powered contract lifecycle management platform that automates contract creation, negotiation, storage, and analysis. It uses NLP to extract key terms, flag risks, and surface insights across a company's contract portfolio.

name: ContractSafe
description: ContractSafe is a contract management solution that uses AI-powered OCR and search to help businesses organize, find, and track their contracts. It automatically extracts key dates, parties, and terms, and sends renewal alerts to prevent missed deadlines.

name: Convai
description: Convai is an AI platform that enables developers to build intelligent, conversational non-player characters (NPCs) for games, virtual reality, and metaverse environments. It combines speech recognition, large language models, and text-to-speech to create characters that remember context and respond naturally.

name: Copper
description: Copper is a CRM designed natively for Google Workspace that automatically captures contacts, emails, and activities from Gmail. Its AI features suggest next actions, automate data entry, and help sales teams track relationships without leaving their existing Google tools.

name: Copysmith
description: Copysmith is an AI content generation platform specializing in e-commerce copy, including product descriptions, ad headlines, and email campaigns. It integrates with platforms like Shopify and Google Ads to help marketing teams produce and publish large volumes of product content efficiently.

name: Cosine
description: Cosine is an AI software engineer that builds a deep understanding of an entire codebase to answer questions, debug issues, and implement features. It goes beyond autocomplete to reason about architecture, dependencies, and patterns across thousands of files.

name: Coupa
description: Coupa is an enterprise spend management platform that uses AI to manage procurement, invoicing, expense management, and contract compliance in a unified system. Its Community.ai leverages anonymized spend data from thousands of companies to benchmark prices and identify savings.

name: CSM AI
description: CSM AI is an AI-powered platform that helps customer success teams automate health monitoring, identify churn risks, and execute playbooks at scale. It analyzes product usage, support tickets, and CRM data to surface proactive insights and recommended next actions for CSMs.

name: Darktrace
description: Darktrace is an AI-powered cybersecurity company whose platform learns the normal behavior of users and devices within an organization to detect and respond to novel threats in real time. Its Autonomous Response technology can interrupt attacks in seconds without disrupting business operations.

name: Diffbot
description: Diffbot is an AI platform that automatically extracts structured data from any web page and builds a continuously updated knowledge graph of the web. Enterprises use it for competitive intelligence, market research, and training AI models with fresh, structured web data.

name: Docsumo
description: Docsumo is an intelligent document processing platform that uses AI to extract and validate data from invoices, bank statements, and other business documents. It offers pre-trained models for common document types and lets teams train custom extractors for specific layouts.

name: Document360
description: Document360 is a SaaS knowledge base platform that helps companies create, manage, and publish product documentation, FAQs, and user manuals. Its AI features include semantic search, auto-tagging, content suggestions, and an AI chatbot that answers user questions from the knowledge base.

name: Dust
description: Dust is a platform for building and deploying custom AI assistants connected to a company's internal tools and documents. Teams configure assistants with specific knowledge sources and instructions, and employees interact with them through Slack or the Dust web app.

name: DVC
description: DVC (Data Version Control) is an open-source tool for versioning machine learning datasets, models, and experiments alongside code in Git. It provides a Git-like interface for managing large data files stored in cloud storage and enables reproducible ML pipelines.

name: edX
description: edX is an online education platform offering courses, professional certificates, and degrees from top universities and companies worldwide. It features AI and machine learning courses from institutions like MIT and Harvard, as well as AI-powered learning tools to help students progress.

name: Evidently AI
description: Evidently AI is an open-source library and platform for evaluating, testing, and monitoring machine learning models and LLM applications. It generates visual reports on data drift, model performance, and LLM output quality, supporting both batch testing and production monitoring.

name: Evisort
description: Evisort is an AI contract management platform that reads, understands, and extracts data from contracts to give legal and procurement teams visibility across their agreements. It automates contract review, tracks obligations and renewals, and surfaces risks across an entire contract portfolio.

name: Factory AI
description: Factory AI builds AI Droids—autonomous agents that handle software engineering tasks such as code review, bug fixes, and pull request generation. It integrates with GitHub and Jira to let engineering teams automate repetitive development work and accelerate delivery.

name: Fal.ai
description: fal.ai is a fast AI inference platform specializing in running image and video generation models at scale. It provides an API and serverless GPU infrastructure optimized for low-latency inference of models like Flux, Stable Diffusion, and open-source video generators.

name: Fantastical
description: Fantastical is a calendar and task manager for Mac, iPhone, and iPad that uses natural language processing to create events and reminders from typed or spoken phrases. Its AI features include meeting preparation summaries and smart scheduling suggestions.

name: Fish Audio
description: Fish Audio is an AI platform offering high-quality text-to-speech and voice cloning with support for multiple languages. Users can create clones of their own voice or choose from a library of community-shared voices, and deploy them via a simple API.

name: Flatiron Health
description: Flatiron Health is a health technology company that collects and curates real-world oncology data from cancer clinics to accelerate clinical research. Its platform provides AI-powered tools that help oncologists and biopharma companies derive insights from longitudinal patient data.

name: Folk
description: Folk is a lightweight, AI-native CRM that helps individuals and small teams manage contacts, track relationships, and run personalized email outreach. Its AI enrichment automatically fills in contact details, and AI message drafting helps craft personalized emails at scale.

name: Freshsales
description: Freshsales is an AI-powered CRM by Freshworks that helps sales teams manage leads, automate follow-ups, and close deals faster. Its Freddy AI scores leads, predicts deal outcomes, and suggests next best actions to help reps focus on the highest-value opportunities.

name: Front
description: Front is a customer operations platform that centralizes email, chat, SMS, and social messages in shared inboxes for customer-facing teams. Its AI features include automated ticket routing, summarization, and suggested replies to help support and account management teams respond faster.

name: Gem
description: Gem is a talent acquisition platform that combines AI-powered sourcing, CRM, and analytics for recruiting teams. It helps recruiters find and engage candidates across LinkedIn and other channels, track relationship history, and measure pipeline health with advanced reporting.

name: Ghost
description: Ghost is an open-source publishing platform for professional creators building newsletters, memberships, and subscription products. It includes AI writing assistance for drafting and editing content, along with built-in SEO, analytics, and payment tools.

name: Giskard
description: Giskard is an open-source AI quality testing platform that automatically scans LLMs and ML models for vulnerabilities such as hallucinations, bias, prompt injection, and data leakage. Teams integrate it into CI/CD pipelines to ensure model safety before deployment.

name: Gladia
description: Gladia is a fast audio transcription API that uses AI to convert speech to text with speaker diarization, language detection, and translation across 100+ languages. It is optimized for real-time and batch processing of audio from meetings, calls, and media files.

name: Guru
description: Guru is a knowledge management platform that captures institutional knowledge and makes it instantly accessible through AI-powered search and a browser extension. Its AI answers employee questions by drawing on verified company wikis, Slack conversations, and connected data sources.

name: Hedra
description: Hedra is an AI creative platform that generates expressive talking-head videos by combining a portrait image with audio input. It enables creators to bring characters to life for storytelling, marketing, and social media content without filming real actors.

name: Helicone
description: Helicone is an open-source LLM observability platform that acts as a proxy to log, analyze, and optimize API calls to OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. It provides usage analytics, cost tracking, prompt versioning, and caching to help teams improve LLM application performance.

name: Humanloop
description: Humanloop is a platform for building reliable LLM applications with prompt management, evaluation pipelines, and fine-tuning. Teams use it to manage and version prompts across environments, run automated and human evaluations, and improve model performance through targeted fine-tuning.

name: HyperScience
description: HyperScience is an enterprise intelligent document processing platform that automates the extraction and processing of data from structured and semi-structured documents. It combines machine learning with human-in-the-loop validation to achieve high accuracy for insurance, financial services, and government workflows.

name: HyperWrite
description: HyperWrite is an AI writing assistant that helps users research topics, draft documents, and rewrite existing content. It offers a Chrome extension, document editor, and AI agent that can browse the web and perform tasks on the user's behalf.

name: Iconosquare
description: Iconosquare is a social media management and analytics platform focused on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn. It provides detailed performance metrics, competitor analysis, content scheduling, and AI-powered captions to help brands and agencies optimize their social presence.

name: Inngest
description: Inngest is a developer platform for writing reliable background jobs, scheduled tasks, and multi-step workflows in serverless environments. It handles retries, concurrency, event fan-out, and step functions without requiring separate infrastructure like queues or cron servers.

name: Insider
description: Insider is a unified customer data and experience platform that uses AI to personalize marketing across web, mobile, email, SMS, and push channels. Its Sirius AI enables predictive segmentation, journey orchestration, and content optimization to drive conversions and customer lifetime value.

name: Instabase
description: Instabase is an AI platform for automating complex, document-centric business processes in financial services, insurance, and healthcare. It uses foundation models and computer vision to understand and extract data from diverse document types, then routes information through configurable workflows.

name: Iterable
description: Iterable is a growth marketing platform that enables personalized lifecycle messaging across email, SMS, push notifications, and in-app channels. Its AI features include send-time optimization, content affinity modeling, and dynamic segmentation to improve engagement rates.

name: Jammable
description: Jammable is an AI platform that lets users create voice cover songs using AI-cloned voices of artists and characters. Users select a voice, upload an audio track, and receive a generated cover with the chosen voice, enabling quick AI music creation for social media.

name: Jiminny
description: Jiminny is a sales intelligence platform that records, transcribes, and analyzes sales calls and video meetings with AI. It provides automated coaching feedback, deal risk alerts, and CRM auto-updates to help sales managers develop their teams and improve win rates.

name: Jina AI
description: Jina AI provides open-source and cloud-based infrastructure for building multimodal AI applications, including embedding models, rerankers, and a reader API that converts web pages to LLM-friendly text. Its tools are used to build search, RAG, and retrieval pipelines.

name: Jira
description: Jira is Atlassian's widely used project management and issue tracking platform for software development teams. Its AI features, powered by Atlassian Intelligence, help teams auto-generate ticket summaries, create subtasks, suggest sprint goals, and surface relevant work items.

name: Kaiber
description: Kaiber is an AI creative platform that transforms images, text prompts, and music tracks into stylized AI-generated videos and animations. It is popular among musicians and visual artists for creating music videos, lyric videos, and short-form creative content.

name: Kinaxis
description: Kinaxis is an enterprise supply chain management platform that uses AI and concurrent planning to give companies end-to-end visibility and rapid response capability across demand, supply, and operations. Its RapidResponse platform helps manufacturers and retailers reduce risk and improve agility.

name: Kits AI
description: Kits AI is a platform for musicians that provides AI voice cloning, voice conversion, and stem separation tools. Artists can clone their own voice, license official artist voices, and transform vocals to create unique sounds for music production.

name: Kixie
description: Kixie is a sales engagement platform with AI-powered power dialing, local presence calling, and automated SMS for outbound sales teams. Its AI features include voicemail drop, call coaching, and conversation intelligence to help reps make more calls and close more deals.

name: Klap
description: Klap is an AI tool that automatically identifies the most engaging moments in long-form videos and repurposes them into short clips optimized for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts. It adds dynamic captions and reframes the video for vertical format automatically.

name: Klevu
description: Klevu is an AI-powered search and product discovery platform for e-commerce stores. Its natural language search engine understands shopper intent, returns relevant results, and personalizes product rankings to improve conversion rates and reduce zero-result searches.

name: Lakera
description: Lakera is an AI security company that protects LLM-powered applications from prompt injection, jailbreaks, and harmful content at runtime. Its Lakera Guard API integrates into AI application pipelines to detect and block adversarial inputs and sensitive data leakage in real time.

name: LanceDB
description: LanceDB is an open-source, embedded vector database built on the Lance columnar data format for fast similarity search over large multimodal datasets. It offers zero-copy data access, disk-based storage for cost efficiency, and native integration with Python ML libraries.

name: Langfuse
description: Langfuse is an open-source LLM engineering platform that provides tracing, evaluation, prompt management, and dataset curation for AI applications. It captures detailed traces of LLM calls to help teams debug issues, measure quality, and iterate on prompts in production.

name: LangSmith
description: LangSmith is LangChain's platform for debugging, testing, and monitoring LLM applications built with LangChain or any other framework. It provides detailed run traces, a dataset management system for evaluation, and a UI for comparing prompt and model performance over time.

name: Latitude
description: Latitude is a prompt engineering and evaluation platform that helps teams build, test, and deploy reliable LLM applications. It provides a collaborative prompt editor, automated evaluation pipelines, and version control for managing prompt improvements across development and production.

name: Latte Social
description: Latte Social is an AI-powered social media tool that helps creators and brands generate, schedule, and publish content across platforms. Its AI generates captions, hashtags, and post ideas based on brand voice and trending topics to reduce content creation time.

name: Lever
description: Lever is a talent acquisition suite that combines an ATS and CRM in one platform to manage the full recruiting workflow. Its AI features include interview scheduling automation, sourcing recommendations, and candidate scoring to help hiring teams work more efficiently.

name: Lexica
description: Lexica is a search engine and art platform for AI-generated images created with Stable Diffusion. Users can search a vast library of community-generated images and their prompts, or generate their own images using the Aperture model directly on the platform.

name: LiteLLM
description: LiteLLM is an open-source Python library and proxy server that provides a single, standardized interface for calling over 100 LLM APIs including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-source models. It handles retries, load balancing, cost tracking, and fallbacks across providers.

name: Litera
description: Litera is a legal technology platform that provides AI-powered document drafting, comparison, and risk analysis tools for law firms and legal departments. It automates document review, checks for inconsistencies, and accelerates due diligence and contract negotiation workflows.

name: Loomly
description: Loomly is a social media management platform that helps marketing teams plan, create, schedule, and analyze content across major social networks. It offers AI-powered post ideas, brand asset libraries, ad management, and approval workflows for collaborative teams.

name: Lummi
description: Lummi is a stock photo platform offering high-quality, royalty-free images generated by AI. Designers and marketers can search a growing library of AI-created photos or generate custom images for commercial projects without licensing restrictions.

name: Lyra Health
description: Lyra Health is a mental health benefits platform that uses AI to match employees with the right therapists, coaches, and care options based on their needs and preferences. It partners with employers to provide evidence-based mental health support at scale.

name: Madgicx
description: Madgicx is an AI-powered advertising optimization platform for Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads. It automates ad creative testing, audience targeting, and budget allocation to maximize ROAS, and provides an all-in-one analytics dashboard for performance monitoring.

name: Marqo
description: Marqo is an open-source tensor search engine that enables semantic, multimodal search over text and images without manual embedding management. It provides an end-to-end solution for building search and recommendation features with automatic vectorization and indexing.

name: Mastra
description: Mastra is an open-source TypeScript framework for building AI agents, workflows, and RAG pipelines. It provides integrations with LLMs, tools, and memory systems, and is designed to help developers build production-ready agentic applications with type safety.

name: Matterport
description: Matterport is a spatial data company that creates immersive 3D digital twins of physical spaces using AI-powered cameras and software. Its platform is used in real estate, construction, insurance, and facilities management for virtual tours, measurements, and remote inspections.

name: Mavenoid
description: Mavenoid is an intelligent product support platform that guides users through troubleshooting and installation steps with interactive AI. It helps hardware and consumer electronics companies reduce support tickets by providing smart self-service that resolves product issues without human agents.

name: Mem0
description: Mem0 is an open-source memory framework that adds persistent, adaptive memory to LLM-powered applications and agents. It stores and retrieves user preferences, conversation history, and facts across sessions, enabling AI assistants to remember context over long time horizons.

name: Mercury
description: Mercury is an open-source framework that turns Jupyter notebooks into interactive web apps, dashboards, and reports without writing frontend code. Data scientists define input widgets using notebook cells and Mercury handles the web server, scheduling, and user authentication.

name: Metaflow
description: Metaflow is an open-source Python framework originally developed at Netflix for building and managing real-life data science and ML projects. It handles versioning, parallelism, and deployment of ML workflows from a laptop to the cloud with minimal infrastructure changes.

name: Milvus
description: Milvus is an open-source vector database built for storing, indexing, and querying billions of high-dimensional embedding vectors. It is widely used for similarity search in AI applications such as recommendation systems, image search, and retrieval-augmented generation.

name: Moises
description: Moises is an AI music app that separates audio tracks into individual stems (vocals, drums, bass, instruments) and allows musicians to adjust pitch and tempo in real time. It is used by musicians for practice, remixing, and karaoke-style backing track creation.

name: Monarch Money
description: Monarch Money is a personal finance platform that aggregates bank accounts, investments, and credit cards to give users a complete picture of their financial life. Its AI features include transaction categorization, spending analysis, and goal-based budgeting advice.

name: Morph Studio
description: Morph Studio is an AI video generation platform that creates high-quality video content from text descriptions and images. It offers cinematic-quality video output for marketing, entertainment, and creative projects without requiring traditional video production resources.

name: MultiOn
description: MultiOn is an AI agent that operates a web browser autonomously to complete complex tasks on behalf of users, such as booking reservations, filling forms, and conducting research. It offers an API and a browser extension for integrating web automation into applications.

name: Musicfy
description: Musicfy is an AI platform that lets users create original songs and voice covers using AI-generated music and cloned voices. It supports style transfer, stem separation, and text-to-music generation, catering to hobbyist musicians and social media creators.

name: Mutiny
description: Mutiny is an AI-powered website personalization platform that helps B2B companies tailor their website content to different visitor segments without engineering work. It uses AI to recommend and implement personalization experiments that convert more visitors into pipeline.

name: Nabla
description: Nabla is an AI ambient documentation platform that listens to physician-patient conversations and automatically generates clinical notes, SOAP notes, and referral letters. It reduces documentation burden for clinicians, integrates with EHR systems, and supports multiple languages.

name: Nanonets
description: Nanonets is an AI platform for automating data extraction from invoices, receipts, ID documents, and other business forms. Its pre-built and custom ML models extract structured data with high accuracy, and automated workflows route the extracted information to downstream systems.

name: Nightfall AI
description: Nightfall is a cloud-native data loss prevention (DLP) platform that uses AI to discover, classify, and protect sensitive information across SaaS applications, APIs, and data pipelines. It detects PII, credentials, and secrets in tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive.

name: Nous Research
description: Nous Research is an open-source AI research collective known for fine-tuning and releasing high-performance language models such as Hermes and Nous Capybara. It focuses on improving open-weight models through instruction tuning, RLHF, and community-driven benchmarking.

name: Octane AI
description: Octane AI is a Shopify-focused platform that uses AI-powered quizzes to collect zero-party data and provide personalized product recommendations. E-commerce brands use it to match customers with the right products, grow email and SMS lists, and increase average order value.

name: Oliv AI
description: Oliv AI is an AI sales assistant that automates pre-call research, captures meeting notes, and executes post-meeting follow-ups for sales reps. It analyzes deal progress against sales methodologies and provides managers with real-time pipeline insights and coaching recommendations.

name: Pallyy
description: Pallyy is a social media management tool designed for agencies and creators, offering scheduling, analytics, and inbox management for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other platforms. Its AI features assist with caption writing and hashtag suggestions to speed up content creation.

name: Paradox
description: Paradox is a conversational AI recruiting platform whose AI assistant, Olivia, automates candidate screening, interview scheduling, and FAQ responses via text message. It helps high-volume hiring teams in retail, hospitality, and healthcare reduce time-to-hire significantly.

name: Paragraph AI
description: Paragraph AI is a mobile-first AI writing assistant that helps users write emails, social posts, and other content directly from their smartphone. It offers tone adjustments, grammar correction, and AI-generated drafts with a keyboard integration for any app.

name: PathAI
description: PathAI is a clinical AI company that develops machine learning tools to analyze pathology images for more accurate and consistent cancer diagnosis. Its platform assists pathologists with biomarker quantification, disease detection, and trial enrollment eligibility assessment.

name: Patronus AI
description: Patronus AI is an automated LLM evaluation platform that helps teams test, red-team, and monitor AI applications for accuracy, hallucination, toxicity, and compliance. It provides pre-built and custom evaluators and integrates into CI/CD pipelines for continuous AI quality assurance.

name: PearAI
description: PearAI is an open-source AI-powered code editor built on top of VS Code and Continue that integrates multiple AI models for code completion, chat, and editing. It is community-driven and designed to give developers a transparent, customizable AI coding experience.

name: Phenom
description: Phenom is an AI-powered talent experience management platform that personalizes the talent journey for candidates, employees, recruiters, and HR managers. It provides an AI-driven career site, CRM, internal mobility tools, and manager analytics to improve talent acquisition and retention.

name: Pimsleur
description: Pimsleur is a language learning program based on the scientifically developed Pimsleur method, which uses spaced repetition audio lessons to build conversational fluency. Its app delivers 30-minute daily spoken language sessions for over 50 languages with AI-driven pronunciation feedback.

name: PixAI
description: PixAI is an AI art generation platform specialized in anime and illustration styles, offering access to a wide range of community-trained models. Users can generate, discover, and share AI artwork, and access tools for character design and fine-grained style control.

name: Plandex
description: Plandex is an open-source, terminal-based AI coding agent that uses long-running context windows to tackle large, multi-file coding projects. It plans and implements changes across many files incrementally, with sandboxed execution and version history for safe, complex development tasks.

name: Podcastle
description: Podcastle is an all-in-one podcast creation platform that offers AI-powered recording, transcription, editing, and distribution tools. Its AI features include background noise removal, voice cloning for reshoots, and automatic silence trimming, making professional podcasting accessible to anyone.

name: Poolside
description: Poolside is an AI company developing frontier-scale foundation models purpose-built for software engineering tasks. Its models are trained using reinforcement learning on code execution feedback to achieve deep understanding of software systems and developer intent.

name: Portkey
description: Portkey is an AI gateway and control plane that routes requests to 200+ LLMs with a unified API, providing load balancing, fallbacks, caching, and rate-limit management. It adds observability, guardrails, and access controls on top of any LLM provider.

name: Pory
description: Pory is a no-code platform for building web apps, client portals, and internal tools directly from Airtable, Google Sheets, or Xano databases. It offers a visual editor for creating custom interfaces with filters, search, user authentication, and member-only content.

name: Prefect
description: Prefect is an open-source workflow orchestration platform that makes it easy to build, schedule, and monitor Python data pipelines. It provides a simple decorator-based API, automatic retries, real-time observability, and a cloud-managed or self-hosted control plane.

name: Preply
description: Preply is an online tutoring marketplace connecting language learners with certified tutors for live video lessons in over 50 languages. Its AI features include speaking practice simulations, vocabulary tracking, and personalized lesson recommendations to complement live tutoring.

name: PromptLayer
description: PromptLayer is a middleware platform for managing, versioning, and monitoring LLM prompts used in production applications. It logs every API call with full request and response metadata, enabling teams to track costs, compare prompt versions, and replay requests for debugging.

name: Publer
description: Publer is a social media management tool for scheduling, publishing, and analyzing posts across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Pinterest. Its AI assistant generates captions and content ideas, while analytics help teams understand which posts drive the most engagement.

name: Qdrant
description: Qdrant is an open-source vector similarity search engine and database written in Rust for high performance and reliability. It stores dense and sparse vectors with payload filtering, supports hybrid search, and offers both cloud and self-hosted deployment for RAG and recommendation systems.

name: Quantified AI
description: Quantified AI is an AI-powered sales coaching platform that uses realistic AI avatars to simulate buyer conversations for sales rep practice and assessment. It provides detailed performance scores and coaching feedback to help sales teams improve pitch quality and objection handling.

name: Quantilope
description: Quantilope is an intelligent consumer research platform that automates the setup, fielding, and analysis of market research surveys. Its AI guides researchers through methodology selection, processes responses in real time, and generates automated insight reports to reduce research timelines.

name: Ray
description: Ray is an open-source distributed computing framework that makes it easy to scale Python and AI workloads from a laptop to a cluster. It provides high-level libraries for distributed training, hyperparameter tuning, model serving, and reinforcement learning.

name: Recraft
description: Recraft is a professional AI design tool for generating and editing high-quality images, vector illustrations, icons, and brand assets. It offers precise style controls, brand kit management, and vector export, making it popular with designers who need consistent, on-brand AI visuals.

name: Reducto
description: Reducto is an AI-powered document parsing API that accurately extracts text, tables, and structured data from complex PDFs, scanned documents, and handwritten forms. It is designed for developer teams building RAG pipelines, data extraction workflows, and document automation.

name: Refact.ai
description: Refact.ai is an open-source AI coding assistant offering code completion, chat, and automated refactoring that can be self-hosted for data privacy. It integrates with VS Code and JetBrains, supports multiple LLMs, and provides usage analytics for development teams.

name: Reka AI
description: Reka AI develops multimodal foundation models that process and reason across text, images, video, and audio. Its models, including Reka Core and Reka Flash, are competitive with top proprietary models and are designed for enterprise deployment with strong multimodal performance.

name: Relay
description: Relay.app is a workflow automation platform that combines no-code automation with AI steps and human-in-the-loop review gates. Teams use it to build automations that require AI decision-making, content generation, or approval workflows between automated steps.

name: Relevance AI
description: Relevance AI is a no-code platform for building, deploying, and managing AI agents and multi-agent teams that automate complex business workflows. Users configure agents with tools, instructions, and knowledge bases, then orchestrate them to handle sales, support, and research tasks.

name: Remesh
description: Remesh is a qualitative research platform that uses AI to facilitate and analyze conversations with large groups of participants in real time. Organizations use it to gather nuanced opinions from hundreds of people simultaneously, replacing traditional focus groups with faster, scalable research.

name: Respeecher
description: Respeecher is a professional voice cloning platform used in film, TV, and gaming to convert one person's speech into another's with authentic quality. It is trusted by studios for de-aging actors' voices, dubbing, and preserving celebrity voices for legacy productions.

name: Revenue.io
description: Revenue.io is a revenue intelligence platform that provides AI-powered real-time coaching during live sales calls and post-call analysis. It gives reps instant talk track guidance, objection responses, and battle cards in the moment, while giving managers visibility into conversation quality.

name: Riffusion
description: Riffusion is an AI music generation tool that creates unique musical clips from text prompts by applying image diffusion models to audio spectrograms. It was an early demonstration of using Stable Diffusion to generate audio and is available as an open-source model.

name: Rodin
description: Rodin is an AI platform for generating high-quality 3D models from text descriptions and images using generative AI. It targets game developers, designers, and XR creators who need rapid 3D content production and supports export to standard formats for game engines.

name: RoomGPT
description: RoomGPT is a free AI tool that transforms photos of any room into professional interior design concepts in seconds. Users upload a photo, select a design style, and the AI generates multiple redesigned versions of the space for inspiration and visualization.

name: Rossum
description: Rossum is an AI document processing platform that automates data extraction from invoices, purchase orders, and other transactional documents. Its cognitive data capture engine learns document layouts and handles exceptions, integrating with ERP and AP automation workflows.

name: Salesflare
description: Salesflare is an intelligent CRM built for small B2B businesses that automatically logs emails, meetings, and calls to keep contact records up to date. Its AI surfaces follow-up reminders and opportunities, reducing the manual data entry burden that makes many CRMs hard to maintain.

name: Sapling
description: Sapling is an AI communication assistant that helps customer-facing teams write faster and more consistently. It provides real-time grammar and spelling suggestions, autocomplete for agent responses, and AI-generated reply drafts that integrate with helpdesk and CRM platforms.

name: SeekOut
description: SeekOut is an AI-powered talent search and analytics platform that helps recruiters find and engage candidates across GitHub, LinkedIn, and other sources. It specializes in diversity recruiting and hard-to-find technical talent, with AI filters for skills, experience, and diversity attributes.

name: Shortly AI
description: Shortly AI is a long-form writing assistant powered by GPT models that helps writers overcome writer's block and expand their drafts. Users type a paragraph and use keyboard shortcuts to have the AI continue, rewrite, or expand the content in the same voice.

name: Slab
description: Slab is a knowledge management platform for teams that combines a clean wiki editor with AI-powered search across all connected tools. Its Slab AI feature answers questions by searching documents in Slab and connected sources like Slack, Google Drive, and Notion.

name: Sloyd
description: Sloyd is an AI-powered 3D model generation tool designed for game developers and interactive media creators. It generates customizable 3D assets in real time from text prompts, with parametric controls for adjusting shape, size, and materials directly in the browser.

name: SmartRecruiters
description: SmartRecruiters is an enterprise talent acquisition platform that uses AI to streamline the full recruiting process from job posting and candidate sourcing to offer management. Its SmartAssistant AI automates screening, scheduling, and communication to reduce time-to-hire.

name: Speechmatics
description: Speechmatics is a speech recognition and understanding company that provides highly accurate transcription APIs supporting 50+ languages. Its technology is known for handling diverse accents, real-world audio quality, and domain-specific vocabulary for enterprise applications.

name: Spike
description: Spike is an email platform that transforms traditional email into a real-time chat-like experience with AI collaboration features. Its AI can summarize email threads, draft replies, and serve as an AI teammate within conversations to help individuals and teams work faster.

name: Splice
description: Splice is a leading platform for music producers offering a vast royalty-free sample library, plugin subscriptions, and AI-powered creation tools. Its CoSo AI app generates unique loops and beats from sample collections, while its sample recommendation AI surfaces relevant sounds.

name: Spring Health
description: Spring Health is a mental health benefits company that uses AI to create precise care plans matched to each employee's specific mental health needs. Its platform gives employees access to therapists, psychiatry, digital exercises, and coaching through an employer-sponsored benefit.

name: Stable Audio
description: Stable Audio is Stability AI's generative AI tool for creating original music tracks and sound effects from text prompts. It generates high-quality stereo audio up to several minutes long and is designed for musicians, sound designers, and content creators seeking royalty-free audio.

name: Stablecog
description: Stablecog is a free, open-source AI image generation platform that provides access to Stable Diffusion models and community fine-tunes through a simple web interface. It supports multiple models, ControlNet, and img2img workflows for creative exploration.

name: Streak
description: Streak is a CRM that operates entirely within Gmail, turning email threads into trackable pipeline stages without switching to a separate app. It is popular with sales teams, recruiters, and project managers who want lightweight deal and relationship tracking without leaving their inbox.

name: Submagic
description: Submagic is an AI video editing tool that automatically generates animated captions, adds emojis, and creates B-roll for short-form video content. It is popular among content creators on TikTok and Instagram Reels who want to produce engaging captioned clips efficiently.

name: Sweep AI
description: Sweep AI is a GitHub-integrated AI assistant that automatically converts issues and bug reports into pull requests. Developers describe a task in a GitHub issue, and Sweep reads the codebase, plans a solution, and opens a ready-to-review PR with the necessary code changes.

name: Tailor Brands
description: Tailor Brands is an AI-driven brand identity platform that helps entrepreneurs and small businesses create logos, brand guidelines, and marketing materials. Users answer a few questions about their business and preferences, and the AI generates professional logo designs and a complete brand kit.

name: Tavily
description: Tavily is a search API designed specifically for AI agents and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines. It returns clean, relevant search results formatted for LLM consumption, with options for deep research mode and domain-filtered search to reduce hallucination in AI applications.

name: Tensor.Art
description: Tensor Art is a cloud-based AI image generation platform that offers access to thousands of community-trained Stable Diffusion models. Users can generate, remix, and share AI artwork, train custom LoRA models, and explore a marketplace of fine-tuned models for various art styles.

name: Tettra
description: Tettra is a knowledge management tool that helps teams document and share internal knowledge in a searchable wiki. Its AI assistant, Kai, answers employee questions by searching the knowledge base and connected tools, and can create new articles from Slack conversations.

name: Transkriptor
description: Transkriptor is an AI transcription service that converts audio and video files, Zoom recordings, and live speech into accurate text in 100+ languages. It offers speaker labeling, subtitle export, and AI-generated meeting summaries for business, academic, and media use cases.

name: Trieve
description: Trieve is an open-source infrastructure platform for building search, recommendation, and RAG applications with hybrid full-text and vector search capabilities. Teams self-host or use the managed cloud to build retrieval systems with filters, reranking, and analytics built in.

name: Trigger.dev
description: Trigger.dev is an open-source platform for running background jobs, scheduled tasks, and long-running AI workflows in serverless environments. It provides a TypeScript SDK with automatic retries, step functions, and real-time execution monitoring for reliable async processing.

name: Trint
description: Trint is an AI-powered transcription and content platform used by journalists, media companies, and enterprises to turn audio and video into searchable, editable text. Its collaborative editor lets teams highlight quotes, add comments, and publish stories directly from transcripts.

name: Trullion
description: Trullion is an AI accounting platform that automates lease accounting (ASC 842, IFRS 16) and revenue recognition by extracting data from contracts. It connects source documents to the general ledger, reduces manual reconciliation, and provides audit-ready financial reports.

name: Turbopuffer
description: Turbopuffer is a high-performance vector database designed for sub-millisecond similarity search over billions of vectors at low cost. It uses object storage for persistence and an in-memory index for fast queries, making it suited for large-scale RAG and search applications.

name: Unakin
description: Unakin is an AI agent platform built specifically for game developers, offering AI tools for generating game content, automating QA, and accelerating creative tasks. Its agents assist with worldbuilding, NPC dialogue, level design suggestions, and code generation for game studios.

name: Unstructured
description: Unstructured is an open-source Python library and cloud platform that extracts and pre-processes text from diverse document formats—PDFs, Word documents, HTML, images—for use in LLM and RAG pipelines. It handles complex layouts, tables, and images to make unstructured data LLM-ready.

name: Val Town
description: Val Town is a social coding environment where developers write, run, and share small JavaScript and TypeScript functions called vals directly in the browser. It handles hosting, scheduling, and HTTP endpoints, making it easy to build scripts, APIs, and automations without infrastructure setup.

name: Vectara
description: Vectara is a managed retrieval-augmented generation platform that helps enterprises build trusted AI applications with accurate, grounded answers. It handles document ingestion, neural retrieval, and generation with hallucination detection, designed for production enterprise deployments.

name: Vectra AI
description: Vectra AI is a cybersecurity company that uses AI to detect and respond to cyberattacks in real time across hybrid cloud environments. Its Attack Signal Intelligence platform analyzes network traffic, identity, and cloud signals to surface the highest-priority threats before breaches occur.

name: Vellum
description: Vellum is a platform for building, testing, and deploying LLM-powered applications with tools for prompt engineering, evaluation, and workflow orchestration. It provides a visual editor for chaining LLM calls, version-controlled prompt templates, and a test suite for validating AI outputs.

name: Verbit
description: Verbit is a professional transcription and captioning service that combines AI with human editors to deliver highly accurate results for media companies, courts, universities, and enterprises. It supports live captions, post-production subtitles, and multilingual transcription workflows.

name: Vic.ai
description: Vic.ai is an AI accounting platform that automates accounts payable processing from invoice capture to payment approval. Its deep-learning models handle GL coding, approval routing, and anomaly detection, eliminating manual data entry and reducing invoice processing costs.

name: Vidnoz
description: Vidnoz is an AI video creation platform that produces professional videos from text using realistic AI avatars and voice synthesis. Users select an avatar, input a script, and generate a polished spokesperson video for marketing, training, or corporate communications.

name: Vidu
description: Vidu is an AI video generation platform developed by Chinese AI company Shengshu Technology that creates high-quality video clips from text prompts and images. It supports high-resolution output and cinematic camera movements, and is available to global users via its web platform.

name: Vista Social
description: Vista Social is a comprehensive social media management platform for agencies and brands, offering scheduling, content libraries, and analytics across major social networks. Its AI assistant helps generate captions and post ideas, while white-label reporting tools support client management.

name: Viz.ai
description: Viz.ai is a clinical AI company whose platform uses computer vision to analyze medical imaging and instantly alert care teams to time-sensitive conditions such as stroke, pulmonary embolism, and aortic disease. Its automated detection and communication tool reduces time to treatment.

name: Vizard
description: Vizard is an AI video editing tool that automatically identifies the most engaging segments of long-form video content and transforms them into short clips for social media. It adds AI-generated captions, resizes for different platforms, and enables batch content repurposing.

name: Voiceflow
description: Voiceflow is a collaborative platform for product teams to design, build, and launch conversational AI agents and chatbots. It provides a visual workflow builder, integrations with knowledge bases and APIs, and tools for testing and deploying agents across web, mobile, and messaging channels.

name: Weaviate
description: Weaviate is an open-source vector database that enables semantic search, hybrid search, and generative AI queries over large datasets. It supports text, image, and multimodal embeddings, and provides built-in integrations with OpenAI, Cohere, and Hugging Face for vectorization.

name: Wisecut
description: Wisecut is an AI-powered video editing tool that automatically removes silences, adds jump cuts, syncs background music to the video pacing, and generates subtitles. It is designed for content creators and educators who want to produce polished videos without manual editing.

name: Wordware
description: Wordware is a platform for building AI applications and agents using a natural language programming environment. Teams create workflows that combine LLM calls, code execution, and tool integrations to automate research, content generation, and data processing tasks.

name: Workable
description: Workable is an all-in-one recruiting and HR platform that uses AI to source candidates, screen applications, and streamline the hiring process. Its AI Recruiter feature automatically suggests candidates from a database of 400 million+ profiles and helps evaluate applicants against job requirements.

name: ZenML
description: ZenML is an open-source MLOps framework that helps data science teams build standardized, portable ML pipelines that run on any cloud or infrastructure. It provides abstractions for pipeline steps, artifact tracking, and integrations with 50+ MLOps tools to avoid vendor lock-in.

name: Activepieces
description: Activepieces is an open-source workflow automation platform that connects apps and automates tasks through a visual flow builder, with the option to self-host for complete data control. It supports 200+ integrations and allows teams to mix no-code steps with custom JavaScript or Python nodes for complex logic. Teams with privacy requirements or who want to avoid per-task Zapier pricing use Activepieces as a self-hosted automation backbone.

name: Adobe Acrobat AI
description: Adobe Acrobat's AI Assistant is a generative AI feature built into Acrobat and Reader that summarises, explains, and answers questions about PDF content. It can generate formatted summaries with citations, compare documents, and draft responses based on document content — all within the Acrobat interface. Professionals who live in PDF workflows use it to work faster without switching to a separate AI tool.

name: Adobe Express
description: Adobe Express is Adobe's fast, template-driven content creation tool for social media graphics, short videos, PDFs, and web pages, with AI features including text-to-image, background removal, text effects, and one-click resize. It's designed for marketers and communicators who need branded content quickly without Photoshop expertise. Tight integration with Creative Cloud means brand assets, fonts, and colours are always one click away.

name: AI Aware
description: AI Aware is a comprehensive AI detector platform designed to help businesses, institutions, and the public identify AI-generated content across text, images, and documents with high accuracy and detailed reporting.

name: Aider
description: Aider is an open-source AI coding assistant that runs in your terminal and edits code directly in your local git repository. You describe what you want in natural language and Aider makes the changes, runs tests, and commits the result, working across multiple files simultaneously. Developers who prefer a keyboard-driven, local workflow over a cloud IDE use Aider as a powerful alternative to Cursor or Copilot.

name: Aiter.io
description: Aiter.io is an AI marketing tool that creates campaigns that sound like your brand, not generic AI. Paste your website URL and Aiter generates on-brand ad copy, social posts, and email campaigns tailored to your voice.

name: AIWriteBook
description: AIWriteBook is an all-in-one AI book creation platform used by over 15,700 authors to go from idea to published book. It handles outlines, chapter writing, editing, cover design, and publishing to Amazon KDP.

name: Akiflow
description: Akiflow is a productivity platform that pulls tasks from Asana, Jira, Gmail, Slack, Notion, and 10+ other tools into a single daily planner, then helps you time-block them into your calendar. Its Command Bar lets you capture and schedule tasks from anywhere with a keyboard shortcut in under two seconds. High-output professionals use Akiflow as the missing layer between their project management tools and their actual daily schedule.

name: Amazon Polly
description: Amazon Polly is AWS's cloud-based text-to-speech service that converts text into lifelike speech using deep learning, offering dozens of neural voices across 30+ languages. It's available via API with per-character pricing, making it cost-effective for applications that generate large volumes of audio. Developers building accessibility features, voice apps, and IVR systems use Polly as the infrastructure-grade TTS behind their products.

name: Amazon Q Developer
description: Amazon Q Developer is AWS's AI coding assistant, built into the AWS Console, VS Code, and JetBrains IDEs. It generates code, explains AWS services, writes infrastructure-as-code, and helps debug issues — with specialised training on AWS documentation and best practices. Teams building on AWS use it to accelerate development and reduce the time spent navigating complex cloud APIs.

name: Anna
description: Anna is an adaptive AI companion designed to transcend the limitations of standard assistants by acting as a true partner. She learns your preferences, communication style, and goals to provide increasingly personalized support.

name: AppDeploy
description: AppDeploy is an AI-assisted tool designed to allow users to deploy applications directly from AI platforms. It bridges the gap between AI-generated code and production deployment, handling hosting and infrastructure automatically.

name: AssemblyAI
description: AssemblyAI is a speech AI platform offering transcription, speaker diarisation, sentiment analysis, topic detection, and PII redaction through a single API. Its Universal-1 model delivers best-in-class accuracy across accents and noise conditions, and its async and real-time endpoints serve applications from video indexing to live captioning. Product and engineering teams choose AssemblyAI when they need audio intelligence beyond basic transcription.

name: Automateed
description: Automateed is an AI-powered ebook creation tool designed to expedite and simplify the book writing and publishing process. Create, format, and publish full-length ebooks in a fraction of the time.

name: Averi AI
description: Averi is the AI content engine built for startups. One workflow to run a content engine that ranks in search, converts visitors, and sounds like your brand — not generic AI output.

name: Base44
description: Base44 is an AI-powered platform for building fully-functional apps with no code and minimal setup. Describe your app idea and Base44 generates a working product — database, backend, and UI — ready to deploy.

name: BestPhotoAI
