description: BestPhotoAI is an AI-powered tool that enhances ordinary photos, transforming them into professional-quality images. It upscales resolution, improves lighting, removes blemishes, and applies intelligent retouching automatically.

name: biela.dev
description: biela.dev eliminates the barrier between having an idea and launching a product. Describe what you want to build and biela.dev generates a fully functional web application, no coding knowledge required.

name: Bing Image Creator
description: Bing Image Creator is Microsoft's free text-to-image tool, powered by DALL-E 3 and accessible directly in the Bing search interface and Microsoft Edge sidebar. It generates four high-quality images per prompt at no cost, making it the most accessible entry point to DALL-E 3-quality generation for mainstream users. With no subscription required and deep Windows integration, it's used daily by hundreds of millions of Microsoft users.

name: BlogSEO
description: BlogSEO is an artificial intelligence tool designed to increase the organic traffic of your website by generating SEO-optimized blog posts. Research keywords, generate content briefs, and publish articles that rank on Google.

name: Bolt.new
description: Bolt.new is StackBlitz's AI-powered full-stack development environment where you describe an app and the AI builds, runs, and deploys it entirely in the browser, with no local setup required. It handles both frontend and backend, installs dependencies, and fixes its own errors iteratively. Product teams and solo builders use it to go from idea to deployed app in minutes.

name: Bookbud
description: BookBud.ai is a web-based service designed to support self-published authors in creating both fiction and non-fiction books. Generate complete manuscripts, outlines, and chapters with AI assistance.

name: Capacities
description: Capacities is a personal knowledge management tool built around object types — notes, books, people, projects — rather than pages and folders, creating a richer, more structured knowledge graph. Its AI assistant writes, summarises, and generates connections between your objects. Researchers, writers, and students use Capacities to build a living knowledge base that goes beyond flat note-taking.

name: CapCut
description: CapCut is ByteDance's free video editing app with a comprehensive suite of AI features — auto-captions, background removal, AI avatars, voice cloning, and text-to-video — packaged in an intuitive mobile and desktop interface. It's the most downloaded video editing app globally, with over 500 million users creating everything from TikTok clips to YouTube videos. Creators choose CapCut for the breadth of AI tools available without a subscription.

name: Chai
description: Chai is a mobile-first platform for chatting with AI personas built by independent creators, covering everything from friendly companions to fictional characters and roleplay scenarios. Its creator economy allows anyone to build and publish AI characters, with popular bots earning revenue from user interactions. It's particularly popular among younger users seeking interactive entertainment and social connection through AI.

name: Character.ai
description: Character.ai lets users create, customise, and chat with AI personas ranging from fictional characters and historical figures to custom AI companions. It's built on a proprietary large language model optimised for engaging, in-character conversation, and boasts one of the highest user engagement rates of any AI platform. With over 20 million daily active users, it's the dominant platform for AI roleplay and character interaction.

name: ChatPDF
description: ChatPDF lets you upload any PDF and ask questions about its content in plain language — the AI reads, understands, and answers from the document without requiring you to search through pages manually. It's used for research papers, legal contracts, financial reports, and textbooks. Students and knowledge workers use it to extract insights from dense documents in minutes rather than hours.

name: ChatPlayground AI
description: ChatPlayground AI lets you compare the best AI models including GPT-5, Gemini 2.5, Claude 4, DeepSeek R1, Llama, and more — all in one interface. Run the same prompt against multiple models simultaneously to find the best response.

name: Choosaro
description: Choosaro is an AI-powered decision-making tool for comparing options and choosing the best one with structured criteria. Define what matters, list your choices, and let AI help you make objective, confident decisions.

name: Clay
description: Clay is a data enrichment and go-to-market platform that pulls contact and company data from 75+ sources, then uses AI to write personalised outreach at scale. Its AI Research Agent browses the web to find specific signals about a prospect — recent news, job changes, tech stack — and incorporates them into emails automatically. Outbound sales teams use Clay to build hyper-targeted prospect lists and personalise at a volume that was previously impossible.

name: Clearscope
description: Clearscope analyses top-ranking pages for any keyword and generates a content report showing which terms, topics, and questions must appear in your article to be competitive. Writers draft or paste content and see a real-time grade update as they add the recommended terms. Content teams at enterprise media companies and agencies use Clearscope to ensure every piece is structured for search before it publishes.

name: Cline
description: Cline is an open-source VS Code extension that gives Claude and other LLMs the ability to autonomously create and edit files, run terminal commands, and browse the web to complete multi-step coding tasks. Unlike copilots that suggest completions, Cline takes initiative — reading your project, writing code across files, installing dependencies, and verifying its work. It's one of the fastest-growing open-source AI coding tools, popular for tasks that require more than a single-file change.

name: ClipDrop
description: ClipDrop is a suite of AI-powered image tools by Stability AI covering background removal, image upscaling, relighting, uncropping, and text-to-image generation via Stable Diffusion. Its most popular standalone tool lets you photograph an object on any background and instantly extract it as a clean cutout. Designers and marketing teams use ClipDrop as a lightweight, fast alternative to running Photoshop for routine image tasks.

name: ClipFinder
description: ClipFinder is an AI-powered tool built for streamers, VTubers, and podcasters who need to turn long-form content into viral short clips. It automatically identifies the most engaging moments and exports them ready to post.

name: Cohere
description: Cohere is an enterprise AI company offering large language models — Command R+ for reasoning and generation, Embed for semantic search, and Rerank for retrieval — optimised for deployment in private cloud and on-premises environments. Unlike OpenAI and Anthropic, Cohere's business model focuses exclusively on enterprise B2B use cases with strong data privacy guarantees and SLA commitments. Fortune 500 companies use Cohere's models when they need enterprise-grade LLM capabilities without sending data to a consumer AI provider.

name: Collate
description: Collate is a free, offline PDF assistant designed for everyday learners, students, and professionals. Chat with your PDFs, extract key information, and get instant summaries — all without sending your data to the cloud.

name: Competitor Analyzer
description: Competitor Analyzer is a lightweight competitor intelligence platform that monitors competitors social media, website changes, pricing, and content strategy — delivering weekly digests so you never miss a competitive move.

name: Connected Papers
description: Connected Papers builds a visual graph of papers related to a seed paper, based on co-citation and bibliographic coupling — revealing the intellectual landscape around a topic without manually tracing references. You enter a paper and get an interactive map showing which prior works it builds on and which subsequent papers cite it. Researchers use it at the start of a literature review to quickly find the most influential work in an unfamiliar field.

name: Continue
description: Continue is an open-source AI coding extension for VS Code and JetBrains that lets developers connect any LLM — Claude, GPT-4o, Llama, local models — to their IDE for code completion, inline edits, and chat. Its fully customisable architecture means teams can use self-hosted models for security-sensitive codebases without sending code to a cloud provider. Engineering teams choose Continue for the flexibility to swap models and keep data on-premises.

name: Cora Intelligence
description: Cora Intelligence is an AI sales rep for founders and small teams who cannot afford to hire one. Cora finds prospects, personalizes outreach, and books meetings automatically so you can focus on closing deals.

name: Crayon
description: Crayon is a competitive intelligence platform that continuously monitors competitor websites, job postings, news, and social activity for changes that signal strategic moves — pricing updates, new product launches, executive hires. Its AI surfaces the most important signals from thousands of data points daily and delivers battlecard updates and alerts directly to sales and product teams. Revenue teams use Crayon to keep competitive positioning current without manually tracking dozens of sources.

name: Cresh
description: Cresh is a multi-agent business research and analysis tool that helps validate startup ideas, analyze markets, and build competitive intelligence. Run in-depth research that would take weeks in minutes.

name: DALL-E 3
description: DALL-E 3 is OpenAI's image generation model, natively integrated into ChatGPT. It interprets detailed prompts more accurately than its predecessors and produces high-quality, photorealistic or stylised images in seconds. Millions of ChatGPT users access it daily to visualise ideas, create illustrations, and generate marketing assets.

name: Deepgram
description: Deepgram is a speech recognition platform engineered for high-volume, low-latency production use cases, offering real-time and batch transcription through a simple API. Its Nova models rank among the most accurate available and its infrastructure delivers transcripts in under 300ms for live audio streams. Call centre platforms, meeting tools, and voice AI products use Deepgram as the transcription layer behind their services.

name: DeepSeek
description: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI lab that released DeepSeek-R1 and DeepSeek-V3, models that match or surpass GPT-4-class performance at a fraction of the training cost, sending shockwaves through the AI industry in early 2025. Both models are open-weight and free to use, making them the most capable freely available models at their release. Developers and researchers worldwide use DeepSeek models as cost-efficient alternatives to proprietary frontier models.

name: Denovo
description: Denovo is an AI platform that turns raw ideas into fully operational businesses from a single platform. From business planning and branding to website creation and legal setup, Denovo handles the entire startup process.

name: Devin
description: Devin is Cognition AI's autonomous software agent, marketed as the world's first AI software engineer. Given a task, Devin opens a terminal, writes and runs code, browses the web for documentation, and iterates until the problem is solved — without human hand-holding. It targets engineering teams who want to delegate complete, well-scoped tasks rather than just get code suggestions.

name: Dora
description: Dora is an AI-powered no-code website builder that specialises in visually striking sites with 3D elements, smooth animations, and interactive effects — the kind of design work that normally requires a specialist developer. Its AI generates complete page designs from a prompt, and the visual editor gives designers fine control over every interaction. Agencies and product teams use Dora when they need a marketing site that genuinely stands out from template-built competitors.

name: Doximity
description: Doximity is the professional network for US physicians, used by over 80% of doctors in the country for clinical communications, medical news, and career development. Its AI tools include an ambient clinical documentation feature that generates clinical notes from a conversation, and a telehealth platform for patient consultations. Healthcare administrators and physicians use it as the secure, HIPAA-compliant communication layer that replaces pagers and consumer messaging apps in clinical settings.

name: Drift
description: Drift is a conversational marketing platform that deploys AI chatbots on B2B websites to engage visitors, qualify leads in real time, and book meetings with sales reps — replacing static contact forms with instant, personalised conversations. Its AI understands visitor intent from behaviour and firmographic data, routing high-value prospects to a human rep immediately and nurturing lower-intent leads automatically. It merged with Salesloft in 2023 and remains the dominant brand in the conversational marketing space.

name: EchoWrite
description: EchoWrite is an AI-powered voice dictation software designed for Windows platforms, turning spoken words into accurate text anywhere on your computer. It supports multiple languages and integrates with all Windows applications.

name: Eightfold AI
description: Eightfold AI is an enterprise talent platform that uses deep learning to match candidates to roles, identify employees ready for internal mobility, and predict workforce needs — drawing on a database of over 1.5 billion career trajectories. Its AI removes keyword-matching bias by evaluating skills and potential rather than job titles and degrees. Large enterprises and government agencies use Eightfold to make faster, more equitable hiring and retention decisions.

name: Erase.bg
description: Erase.bg is an AI background removal tool that handles both static images and video frames, delivering clean cutouts in seconds. Its batch processing feature and high-resolution output make it practical for e-commerce teams processing large product catalogues. It also offers a background replacement studio where removed backgrounds can be swapped for solid colours, custom images, or gradients.

name: Evalyze
description: Evalyze accelerates startup fundraising by using AI to analyze pitch decks, match founders with relevant investors, and provide actionable feedback — compressing the fundraising process from months to weeks.

name: Fabricate
description: Fabricate turns a simple text prompt into a fully working, deployed web application — frontend, backend, and database included. Build production-ready apps without writing code.

name: FastBots
description: FastBots is a no-code platform for building AI-powered chatbots trained on your own business data. Import documents, websites, and FAQs to create a custom chatbot you can embed on any website or integrate with any tool.

name: Fliz
description: Fliz is the AI video agent that transforms any content into a publish-ready video in one click. Paste a URL, article, or script and Fliz generates a complete video with visuals, voiceover, captions, and music.

name: Floot
description: Floot is an AI-based platform designed to assist entrepreneurs in building web applications easily without technical expertise. Describe your idea in plain language and Floot generates a functional, deployable application.

name: Flux
description: Flux is a family of high-performance image generation models from Black Forest Labs, founded by the original Stable Diffusion researchers. Its Flux.1 Pro and Dev variants produce images with exceptional photorealism, accurate text, and precise prompt adherence that rivals or surpasses Midjourney. Available via API and integrated into dozens of tools, it has quickly become the open-source community's go-to generation backbone.

name: Fotor
description: Fotor is an online photo editing and graphic design platform that combines traditional editing tools with AI-powered features like background removal, face retouch, photo enhancement, and AI art generation. Its template library covers social media graphics, posters, and marketing materials. Over 600 million users have used Fotor as an accessible, browser-based alternative to Photoshop.

name: freebeat AI
description: freebeat AI is an advanced AI video generation platform featuring onbeat effects, top-tier video models, and smarter creation modes. Generate stunning music videos and creative content synchronized to audio.

name: Galileo AI
description: Galileo AI generates detailed, editable UI designs from text descriptions — producing screens complete with layout, components, imagery, and copy in seconds. Output is directly importable into Figma for refinement, letting designers use AI-generated designs as a starting point rather than building from a blank canvas. Product teams and early-stage startups use it to rapidly prototype interface concepts before committing engineering resources.

name: Ghostwall
description: Ghostwall is an AI tool designed to protect your ad budget from fraudulent activities such as click fraud, bot traffic, and invalid clicks. It monitors your campaigns in real time and automatically blocks fraudulent sources.

name: GoAI
description: GoAI is an institutional-grade AI investment analyst platform designed to upgrade retail investors. It analyzes stocks, evaluates earnings calls, tracks insider activity, and provides actionable investment insights in plain language.

name: Grok
description: Grok is the AI assistant from xAI, Elon Musk's AI company, built directly into X (Twitter) and available as a standalone app. It has real-time access to posts and trending topics on X, giving it a unique ability to answer questions about current events as they unfold. Grok 3, released in 2025, is competitive with frontier models on reasoning and coding benchmarks.

name: Hailuo AI
description: Hailuo AI is MiniMax's video generation platform, known for exceptionally smooth motion, realistic physics, and strong character consistency across frames. Its MiniMax Video-01 model became widely used after demonstrating quality competitive with Sora and Kling at accessible pricing. Content creators and motion graphics artists use Hailuo for polished, cinematic AI video with natural-feeling movement.

name: Haiper
description: Haiper is an AI video generation platform that prioritises speed and creative iteration, producing 2–4 second clips from text or image prompts in seconds. Its Choreograph feature lets users direct camera movements and transitions, and a lip-sync tool synchronises AI avatars to any audio. Social media creators and digital marketers use Haiper when fast turnaround and volume matter more than maximum cinematic quality.

name: Hedy AI
description: Hedy AI is your AI meeting coach that provides real-time suggestions, talking points, and insights during live meetings — helping you stay sharp, ask better questions, and never miss an important moment.

name: Hemingway Editor
description: Hemingway Editor highlights complex sentences, passive voice, unnecessary adverbs, and hard-to-read passages in colour, pushing writers toward clearer, more direct prose. Its AI rewrite feature can simplify flagged sentences with a click, and a readability grade tracks overall clarity as you write. Writers, journalists, and content teams use it to make their writing scannable and direct without losing their voice.

name: HireVue
description: HireVue is a video interviewing platform that allows candidates to complete structured interviews asynchronously, with AI analysing responses for job-relevant competencies and communication skills. Its game-based assessments measure cognitive ability and problem-solving without traditional aptitude tests. Enterprises with high-volume hiring — retail, financial services, healthcare — use HireVue to screen thousands of candidates efficiently and reduce time-to-hire dramatically.

name: HumanizerFree.com
description: HumanizerFree.com is a free online tool designed to humanize AI-generated text. It rewrites AI content to sound natural and human-written, bypassing AI detection tools while preserving the original meaning.

name: Humata
description: Humata is an AI document intelligence platform that allows users to upload files and have a conversation about their content — asking for summaries, comparisons, or specific facts. It handles long technical documents, legal filings, and academic papers with high comprehension accuracy. Law firms, researchers, and financial analysts use it to extract structured insights from unstructured document libraries.

name: Ideamap
description: Ideamap is an AI-first mindmapping tool designed for effective and creative brainstorming. It enables infinite canvas thinking with AI that automatically expands, connects, and organizes your ideas into structured maps.

name: Ideogram
description: Ideogram is an AI image generation platform known for its ability to accurately render readable text inside images, a persistent weakness of other generators. Beyond typography, it produces photorealistic and artistic images with strong prompt adherence. Designers and marketers use Ideogram when they need visuals that include legible logos, posters, or typographic elements.

name: Instantly
description: Instantly is a cold email platform that manages unlimited sending accounts, warms them up automatically, and uses AI to personalise sequences and optimise send timing for maximum deliverability. Its unified inbox aggregates replies across all connected accounts, and built-in analytics show reply rates, bounce rates, and campaign performance. Growth teams and agencies sending high-volume outreach use Instantly to scale email campaigns without sacrificing deliverability.

name: InstaWebAI
description: InstaWebAI is an AI-powered tool designed to create professional, multi-page, SEO-optimized websites in minutes. Describe your business and InstaWebAI generates a complete website with content, images, and structure.

name: Intuo
description: Intuo is an AI sales intelligence platform that monitors industry news, competitor updates, and customer signals — delivering a daily brief so sales reps can walk into every call with relevant talking points.

name: Iris.ai
description: Iris.ai is an enterprise AI research platform that helps R&D teams systematically explore large bodies of scientific literature — filtering, mapping, and summarising thousands of papers to find prior art, identify white spaces, and monitor competitor research. It's designed for patent analysis, systematic reviews, and technology scouting at a scale that a human team cannot match. Life sciences, energy, and deep tech companies use Iris.ai to accelerate the earliest stages of innovation.

name: Jason AI
description: Jason AI is a conversational AI tool focused on enhancing B2B sales processes. It acts as a personal sales assistant that handles outreach, personalizes messages at scale, and follows up with leads automatically.

name: JetBrains AI Assistant
description: JetBrains AI Assistant integrates AI-powered code completion, generation, explanation, and refactoring directly into the full JetBrains IDE family — IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, and more. It understands the full project context through deep IDE integration and can explain compiler errors, write test suites, and refactor code with awareness of the entire codebase. JetBrains users prefer it over standalone tools because it works inside the IDE they already live in.

name: Jobbyo
description: Jobbyo is your personal AI job hunter. It finds matching jobs, submits applications, and follows up with employers on your behalf — running 24/7 so you can land interviews while you sleep.

name: JobGPT
description: JobGPT is a fully automated AI-powered job search assistant that finds job openings, tailors your resume, writes cover letters, and submits applications on your behalf — landing you interviews while you sleep.

name: Julius AI
description: Julius AI is a conversational data analysis tool that connects to spreadsheets, databases, and CSV files and lets you ask questions in plain English — producing charts, statistical summaries, and Python-generated insights without writing code. It can run regression analyses, detect trends, and generate publication-ready visualisations from natural-language instructions. Analysts, marketers, and researchers who work with data but aren't fluent in Python or SQL use Julius to move from raw data to insight in minutes.

name: Jupid
description: Jupid connects to your bank and automatically categorizes every transaction into IRS Schedule C categories for freelancers and small business owners, making tax prep simple and accurate.

name: Khroma
description: Khroma is a free AI colour tool that learns your personal colour preferences from a short selection exercise and then generates unlimited palettes, gradients, and colour combinations tailored to your taste. You can browse results as typography, poster, or gradient formats and export swatches directly to your design tools. Designers use it to break out of default colour habits and discover combinations they wouldn't have thought to try manually.

name: KikiVoice
description: KikiVoice is a free AI voice cloning platform suitable for content creators. Clone any voice from a short audio sample and use it to generate natural-sounding speech for videos, podcasts, and audiobooks.

name: Kin Personal AI
description: Kin is a privacy-first AI advisory platform that gives you five specialized AI advisors working together — covering career, finance, health, relationships, and personal growth — all with your data staying on-device.

name: Kindroid
description: Kindroid is an AI companion app focused on building a persistent, deeply personalised relationship with an AI character you define — with long-term memory, a custom backstory, and consistent personality across conversations. It supports voice calls, image sharing, and journaling features that make interactions feel ongoing rather than session-based. Users seeking a thoughtful, relationship-oriented AI experience choose Kindroid over more entertainment-focused alternatives.

name: Kling AI
description: Kling AI is a text-to-video and image-to-video generation platform from Kuaishou, known for producing smooth, physically realistic video clips up to two minutes long. Its motion quality and ability to maintain character consistency across frames place it among the best AI video generators available. Filmmakers, advertisers, and social media creators use Kling to generate cinematic footage that would otherwise require expensive production.

name: Kokoro TTS
description: Kokoro is a lightweight open-source text-to-speech model known for producing natural, high-quality speech that punches well above its model size. At under 100M parameters it runs efficiently on consumer hardware, making it the go-to choice for developers who want local TTS without cloud API costs. It supports multiple voices and has been widely adopted in the open-source AI community.

name: Komos
description: Komos is an AI automation platform for enterprise teams. Instead of writing scripts or building brittle automations, Komos lets you describe tasks in plain language and handles browser automation, RPA, and complex workflows.

name: Krea AI
description: Krea AI is a creative platform focused on real-time AI generation: you see images update live as you type or draw, enabling an intuitive visual exploration process. Its upscaler, enhancer, and style-transfer tools let creators refine AI-generated and real photographs with exceptional quality. Designers and visual artists use Krea for its unique real-time feedback loop that makes iterating on visual ideas feel like sketching.

name: Lavender
description: Lavender is an AI email assistant that scores your cold emails in real time and explains exactly what to change to increase reply rates — flagging sentences that are too long, openers that sound generic, and missing personalisation. It pulls prospect data from LinkedIn and CRM records and suggests personalised opening lines automatically. SDRs and sales reps at B2B companies use Lavender to improve email quality and book more meetings from the same number of sends.

name: leania.ai
description: leania.ai helps organizations detect workflow bottlenecks, optimize team processes, and improve operational efficiency using AI analysis of org charts, processes, and team meeting data.

name: Leonardo AI
description: Leonardo AI is a generative AI platform focused on creative and game-development use cases, offering fine-tuned models for characters, environments, concept art, and product visuals. Its Canvas editor lets users make targeted edits, and the Model Training feature lets studios train on proprietary art styles. Game developers and concept artists use it to produce consistent, high-volume visual assets.

name: Lightfield
description: Lightfield is an AI-native CRM that automatically captures context from emails, meetings, and calls to keep your pipeline updated without manual data entry. Built by the founders of a viral AI presentation tool with 25M+ users.

name: Litmaps
description: Litmaps is a literature discovery tool that visualises a researcher's reading list as an interactive citation map, automatically finding related papers and alerting users when new relevant work is published. It integrates with reference managers like Zotero and allows teams to share and collaborate on literature maps. PhD students and researchers use Litmaps to maintain awareness of a field's development without manually monitoring dozens of journals.

name: Littlebird
description: Littlebird is an always-on, context-aware AI assistant that weaves together your activity across every tool you use — email, calendar, docs, and browser — to give you timely, relevant help throughout your day.

name: LlamaIndex
description: LlamaIndex is an open-source data framework for connecting large language models to external data sources — databases, PDFs, APIs, Notion, Slack — to build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications and AI agents that reason over private data. It handles ingestion, indexing, querying, and response synthesis, abstracting the complex engineering behind production-grade RAG. Developers building document Q&A, knowledge bases, and enterprise AI assistants use LlamaIndex as the data layer.

name: Logseq
description: Logseq is an open-source, privacy-first knowledge management tool based on a local-first outliner and graph database that links blocks and pages into a connected knowledge graph. Its AI features include smart search, auto-linking of related concepts, and integration with LLMs for in-context question answering over your notes. Researchers and developers favour Logseq for its Git-friendly plain-text storage and powerful query language that turns a personal knowledge base into a queryable database.

name: Lovable
description: Lovable is an AI-powered web app builder that turns a text description into a fully functional, deployable application, handling React frontend, Supabase backend, and authentication in one flow. You chat with the AI to iterate on features, fix bugs, and extend the app without writing code directly. It became one of the fastest-growing developer tools in 2024-25, used by non-technical founders and designers to ship real products.

name: Luma Dream Machine
description: Luma Dream Machine is Luma AI's text-to-video and image-to-video model, producing smooth, photorealistic video clips with impressive lighting and motion quality. Unlike Luma's 3D capture products, Dream Machine is a pure video generation model accessible via a simple web interface. Creatives and agencies use it to produce high-quality video concepts and b-roll footage without a camera crew.

name: Luminar Neo
description: Luminar Neo is a desktop photo editing application from Skylum that uses AI to automate complex retouching tasks — sky replacement, portrait enhancement, object removal, and relighting — that would take hours in Photoshop. Its non-destructive editing workflow and Lightroom plugin integration make it accessible to hobbyist and professional photographers alike. It's particularly valued for landscape and portrait photographers who want dramatic edits without deep manual skill.

name: MagicLight
description: MagicLight is an AI-powered platform that transforms stories, scripts, and ideas into fully animated videos. Input your narrative and MagicLight generates animation, voiceovers, and visual effects automatically.

name: MagicSlides
description: MagicSlides is a powerful AI PPT maker that instantly transforms any text, document, or topic into a polished presentation. Works as a Google Slides and PowerPoint add-on for seamless integration into your workflow.

name: MarketAlerts.ai
description: MarketAlerts.ai provides AI monitoring for your stocks 24/7, delivering real-time insights and AI-generated trade signals so you never miss a market-moving event that affects your portfolio.

name: Mem
description: Mem is an AI note-taking app that automatically organises your notes by detecting topics, people, and projects — so you never have to manually file anything. Its AI surfaces relevant notes when you're writing and answers questions from across your entire note history. Knowledge workers and executives use Mem as a 'second brain' that gets smarter the more you write into it.

name: Meshy
description: Meshy is an AI 3D generation platform that converts text descriptions or reference images into fully textured, production-ready 3D models in minutes. It supports direct export to OBJ, FBX, GLB, and USDZ for use in game engines, AR, and 3D printing, and an API enables batch generation for large-scale asset pipelines. Game developers, product designers, and XR creators use Meshy to dramatically cut the cost and time of 3D asset production.

name: Mistral AI
description: Mistral AI is a French AI company that has rapidly established itself as the leading European alternative to OpenAI, producing a family of models (Mistral 7B, Mixtral, Mistral Large) known for strong performance at smaller sizes and permissive open-weight licences. Its Le Chat assistant is available for direct use, while its API powers thousands of developer applications. Enterprises choosing European AI for compliance and data sovereignty reasons frequently standardise on Mistral.

name: Moltbook
description: Moltbook is a unique social network platform designed specifically for AI agents. It enables AI agents from different companies and developers to discover, communicate, and collaborate with each other in a structured environment.

name: MOVA Guide
description: MOVA Guide is an AI-powered city guide that helps you instantly decide what to do based on your mood, preferences, and location. Get personalized recommendations for restaurants, activities, and hidden gems.

name: Mubert
description: Mubert is a generative AI music platform that streams infinitely long, non-repetitive music tailored to a mood or activity — and offers an API for developers to integrate adaptive background music into apps and games. Its Render tool lets creators generate tracks for content with specific duration and energy requirements. Developers and content platforms embed Mubert to provide dynamic, contextual audio without licensing complex libraries.

name: Mumble AI
description: Mumble AI is a voice-first productivity app for Mac and iOS that captures meeting notes, action items, and ideas through natural voice input. Transcribes, summarizes, and organizes everything you say in real time.

name: MySpec
description: MySpec is an AI-powered platform built around Spec-Driven Development — a workflow designed to make software projects more predictable by generating detailed technical specifications before writing any code.

name: NightCafe Studio
description: NightCafe Studio is one of the longest-running AI art platforms, offering access to multiple generation models — Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, and proprietary models — through a credit-based web interface. Its built-in community allows creators to share, comment, and collaborate on AI art, and daily challenges keep the community engaged. It's a popular starting point for people exploring AI art who want variety and a supportive community without technical setup.

name: Noodle Tomato
description: NoodleTomato is an automated tool designed to generate full-length faceless YouTube videos. Users input a topic and NoodleTomato generates scripts, voiceovers, visuals, and editing for a publish-ready video.

name: Notion AI
description: Notion AI brings generative AI capabilities directly into Notion workspaces, enabling users to draft documents, summarize pages, translate content, and extract action items from meeting notes without leaving their workspace. It can autofill database properties, generate structured content from prompts, and ask questions across your entire Notion workspace using Q&A mode. Teams use it to accelerate documentation, wikis, and project planning while keeping all knowledge centralized.

name: Notis
description: Notis is the AI intern that lives in your messaging apps and works like a small, tireless team. It takes voice notes, drafts emails, manages tasks, and handles research across WhatsApp, Telegram, and Slack.

name: NovelAI
description: NovelAI is a subscription platform for AI-assisted creative writing and image generation, focused on anime-style art and interactive narrative fiction. Its language model is fine-tuned on a curated corpus of literary fiction to produce prose that's more stylistically varied than general-purpose LLMs, and its image generator specialises in consistent character art for visual novels. Writers and artists in the anime and light-novel community use it as an all-in-one creative sandbox.

name: Obviously AI
description: Obviously AI lets non-technical users build predictive machine learning models from spreadsheet data through a point-and-click interface — predicting churn, lead conversion, sales forecasts, or any other business outcome without writing code. It automatically selects the best algorithm, trains the model, and explains predictions in plain English. Operations managers and business analysts use it to add AI-driven forecasting to workflows that previously required a data scientist.

name: OpenAI o3
description: o3 is OpenAI's most capable reasoning model, designed for tasks requiring extended multi-step thinking: advanced mathematics, competitive coding, scientific research, and complex analysis. It employs a 'chain of thought' process that reasons through problems before responding, achieving state-of-the-art scores on benchmarks that stump standard LLMs. Researchers, engineers, and analysts use o3 when accuracy on hard problems matters more than response speed.

name: OpenClaw
description: OpenClaw is an AI-powered personal assistant designed to automate a range of tasks across multiple platforms including web, desktop, and mobile. It handles research, data entry, scheduling, and complex multi-step workflows.

name: Outfit.fm
description: Outfit is the AI photo studio for fashion brands. Snap a phone shot of your product and turn it into professional model photography — complete with diverse models, styled settings, and studio-quality lighting.

name: Page Pulse
description: Page Pulse is a straightforward, user-friendly website analytics tool designed to make complex web analytics accessible to all. Get clear insights on traffic, user behavior, and conversions without the data overload.

name: Photoroom
description: Photoroom is an AI-powered photo editing app specialised in product photography and portrait retouching. It removes and replaces backgrounds instantly, adjusts lighting, generates lifestyle scenes from product shots, and batch-processes hundreds of images via its API. E-commerce sellers and marketers use Photoroom to produce consistent, professional product images without a photography studio.

name: Pipedream
description: Pipedream is a developer-focused workflow automation platform where every step can be written in Node.js, Python, Go, or Bash — making it far more powerful than Zapier for technical use cases. It connects to 1,000+ APIs with pre-built auth and can be triggered by HTTP requests, schedules, events, or queues. Engineering teams use Pipedream to build production-grade integrations and internal tools without standing up dedicated microservices.

name: Pixlr
description: Pixlr is a browser-based photo editor that offers AI-powered tools including background removal, object eraser, generative fill, and automatic retouching alongside a full suite of traditional editing controls. Its two modes — Pixlr X for quick edits and Pixlr E for advanced work — cater to casual users and designers who need power without installing software. It's one of the most widely used free online photo editors globally.

name: PixVerse
description: PixVerse is an AI-powered platform for video creation that utilizes advanced generative AI technology to produce high-quality videos from text prompts and images. Generate cinematic videos, character animations, and creative content.

name: PlayHT
description: PlayHT is an AI text-to-speech platform offering over 900 voices across 142 languages with an emphasis on emotional realism and natural prosody. Its PlayDialog model produces conversational, human-sounding speech that outperforms many competitors on naturalness benchmarks. Podcast producers, audiobook creators, and app developers use PlayHT's API to generate and clone voices at scale.

name: Pounce
description: Pounce is an AI tool designed to help users optimize their social media presence by enabling real-time engagement opportunities. It identifies trending conversations and the best moments to jump in and grow your audience.

name: Predis.ai
description: Predis.ai generates complete social media posts — caption, hashtags, and matching visual — from a product description or brand URL in seconds. It supports posts for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts, and produces reels, carousels, and static images. Small business owners and content managers use it to maintain a consistent multi-platform posting schedule without a dedicated design or copywriting resource.

name: PrompTessor
description: PrompTessor is an AI prompt workspace for generating, analyzing, optimizing, refining, reverse-engineering, and testing prompts. The ultimate tool for prompt engineers and AI power users.

name: QuillBot
description: QuillBot is an AI writing assistant used by over 35 million people primarily for paraphrasing, summarising, grammar checking, and citation generation. Its paraphraser rewrites text in multiple modes (Standard, Fluency, Formal, Creative), giving writers control over how aggressively the AI changes their prose. Students, ESL writers, and content professionals use it to improve clarity, avoid repetition, and adapt tone.

name: Raccoon AI
description: Raccoon AI is the collaborative AI agent that handles real tasks across your tools. Tell Raccoon what you need and it browses the web, fills forms, sends emails, and completes complex multi-step tasks autonomously.

name: Ramp
description: Ramp is a corporate spend management platform that automates expense reporting, vendor negotiations, and budget tracking with AI that identifies savings opportunities proactively — flagging duplicate subscriptions, negotiating better SaaS contracts, and alerting finance teams to unusual spending patterns. Unlike traditional expense tools, Ramp is built to reduce company spend rather than just track it. Fast-growing companies use Ramp to maintain financial discipline as headcount scales.

name: Read AI
description: Read AI is a meeting intelligence platform that records, transcribes, and summarises meetings while uniquely scoring participant engagement — measuring talk time, sentiment, and attention signals to surface who was most and least engaged. Its pre-meeting briefs pull CRM and calendar context, and post-meeting emails are auto-drafted with action items. Sales teams and managers use the engagement data to coach reps and improve how meetings run.

name: Recall
description: Recall is an AI-powered knowledge base that automatically summarizes and connects everything you read — articles, videos, podcasts, and PDFs — into a personal second brain you can search and query.

name: Reclaim AI
description: Reclaim AI automatically schedules tasks, habits, and one-on-one meetings into your Google Calendar by finding the optimal open slots — rescheduling them in real time as your calendar changes. It defends focus time against meeting sprawl by blocking out deep-work windows and syncing across team calendars to find shared availability instantly. Knowledge workers and managers use Reclaim to reclaim several hours of productive time per week without manual calendar management.

name: Reflect
description: Reflect is a networked note-taking app that uses AI to help you think more clearly, connecting your notes with backlinks and an AI assistant that can summarise, expand, and surface related ideas as you write. It syncs across devices with end-to-end encryption and integrates with calendars so meeting notes are automatically linked to the right people and events. Writers and knowledge workers use Reflect to build a second brain that actively surfaces relevant past thinking.

name: remio
description: remio is an AI-powered personal knowledge hub designed for multi-tasking professionals. It serves as your personal ChatGPT, connecting your notes, documents, and web browsing into one searchable assistant.

name: Remove.bg
description: Remove.bg pioneered instant AI background removal, processing any image in under five seconds with clean, precise edges around hair, fur, and complex subjects. It's available as a web app, desktop app, API, and plugins for Photoshop, Figma, and Canva. E-commerce businesses, photographers, and designers use it to produce clean product shots and cutouts at high volume without manual masking.

name: Replicate
description: Replicate is a platform for running open-source AI models (image generators, LLMs, audio tools, video models) via a simple API without managing any infrastructure. Developers deploy their own models or call thousands of community-published models with a few lines of code and pay per second of compute. It's the fastest way to add any open-source AI capability to an application without standing up a GPU server.

name: Reztune
description: Reztune is an AI-powered resume optimization tool that automatically tailors your resume to each job description. It rewrites bullet points, highlights relevant experience, and optimizes keywords to pass ATS systems.

name: Robin AI
description: Robin AI is a contract intelligence platform that reviews, redlines, and negotiates commercial contracts using AI trained on legal language and market standards. It tracks clause-level changes across document versions, benchmarks terms against market norms, and integrates with DocuSign and Salesforce for end-to-end contract lifecycle management. In-house legal teams at growth companies use Robin AI to handle high contract volumes without proportionally growing their legal headcount.

name: Rocket
description: Rocket is a vibe coding platform that transforms a single prompt into a fully functional, production-ready web application. Describe your vision, and Rocket handles architecture, code generation, and deployment.

name: Rytr
description: Rytr is an AI writing tool that generates blog posts, product descriptions, social captions, email templates, and marketing copy from short prompts using 40+ content-type templates. At a lower price point than Jasper or Copy.ai, it's popular with freelancers and small businesses that need consistent content output without a large budget. Its built-in tone selector and language support across 30+ languages make it flexible for international content teams.

name: scalerX
description: scalerX lets you launch advanced AI agents directly on Telegram with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) capabilities. Create personalized, knowledge-powered chatbots for your business or community with no coding required.

name: Scite
description: Scite is an AI-powered research platform that goes beyond citation counts — it shows whether a paper has been supported, contrasted, or merely mentioned by subsequent research, giving scientists a nuanced view of the evidence base behind any claim. Its Smart Citations interface lets researchers quickly assess the credibility and controversy around key findings. Academics, pharmaceutical researchers, and science journalists use Scite to evaluate the strength of scientific claims.

name: SEOJuice
description: SEOJuice is an AI-powered tool designed to automate the process of internal SEO linking for websites. It analyzes your content and automatically builds an optimized internal link structure to boost search rankings.

name: Serno
description: Serno is an AI workspace for questions that need more than one agreeable answer. Use multiple AI models side by side for research, decision-making, and deep thinking sessions.

name: Slack AI
description: Slack AI adds native AI features to Slack workspaces — instantly summarising channels and threads you've missed, recapping unread conversations, and answering questions from your organisation's Slack history. Unlike third-party integrations, it runs within Slack's infrastructure, keeping data inside your existing security and compliance boundary. Teams on Slack Enterprise use it to reduce the time spent catching up on message backlogs.

name: Slashspace
description: Slashspace (formerly RabbitHoles AI) is a desktop application designed for deep, multi-threaded conversations with AI. Manage multiple conversation threads simultaneously, branch ideas, and build complex knowledge trees.

name: Soundraw
description: Soundraw is an AI music platform that generates royalty-free tracks tailored to video content — you set the mood, genre, length, and energy level, and Soundraw produces a customisable track you own. Its editor lets creators adjust the arrangement bar by bar to match their video's pacing. YouTubers, filmmakers, and social media creators use it to add original music without copyright concerns.

name: Spellbook
description: Spellbook is an AI contract drafting and review tool built inside Microsoft Word, powered by GPT-4 and trained on millions of legal agreements. It suggests missing clauses, flags unusual terms, and drafts new provisions from a plain-English description — all without leaving the Word document. Solo practitioners and mid-market law firms use it to handle routine contract work faster and catch issues that manual review might miss.

name: Stable Diffusion
description: Stable Diffusion is the most widely deployed open-source image generation model, allowing anyone to run high-quality text-to-image generation locally or in the cloud. Its open weights have spawned thousands of fine-tuned community models covering every artistic style imaginable. Developers, researchers, and creative professionals choose it for the flexibility and control that proprietary models don't offer.

name: Sudowrite
description: Sudowrite is an AI creative writing assistant purpose-built for novelists and screenwriters, offering tools specifically designed for fiction — including a Story Engine that builds full narrative arcs, a Describe tool that generates multi-sensory scene details, and a Brainstorm mode for developing characters and plot points. Unlike general writing AI, Sudowrite is trained with literary fiction in mind and avoids the generic marketing-copy tone of other tools. Published authors and writing teachers have become vocal advocates.

name: Suno
description: Suno is an AI music generation platform that creates complete songs (vocals, instruments, and production) from a short text description. You describe a genre, mood, and theme, and Suno produces a radio-ready track in seconds. With tens of millions of users, it's the most popular AI music tool and has introduced a new era of accessible music creation.

name: Synthesis
description: Synthesis is an AI-powered learning platform that teaches children maths and critical thinking through collaborative, game-like problem-solving challenges. Originally developed for students at SpaceX's Ad Astra school, it adapts difficulty in real time and focuses on the reasoning process rather than rote memorisation. Parents and schools use Synthesis as a supplement to traditional education for students who need more challenge or a more engaging format than standard curriculum.

name: Taplio
description: Taplio is an AI tool specifically built for LinkedIn growth, offering a post generator trained on high-performing LinkedIn content, a content calendar, engagement automation, and analytics on reach and follower growth. It also helps users build relationships by surfacing posts from target accounts to engage with strategically. B2B professionals, consultants, and founders use Taplio to build a LinkedIn audience systematically.

name: Team Pulse
description: Team Pulse is a project management tool designed for team collaboration and task organization. Its primary purpose is to centralize team workflows, making it easier to coordinate projects and track progress in real time.

name: The Influencer AI
description: The Influencer AI lets you launch scroll-stopping photo and video campaigns in minutes using one consistent AI brand character. Create virtual influencer content at scale without hiring models or photographers.

name: The SEO Agent
description: The SEO Agent is an AI-driven tool offering a comprehensive solution for content creation and optimization. It researches keywords, generates optimized content, and helps rank pages on Google with minimal manual effort.

name: Thea
description: Thea is an AI-powered study tool designed to help students learn more effectively. Instead of just providing answers, it guides learners through concepts, generates quizzes, and builds personalized study plans.

name: TheLibrarian.io
description: TheLibrarian.io is a WhatsApp AI assistant designed to help you master your inbox, manage your schedule, and stay on top of tasks — all through a familiar messaging interface without installing any new apps.

name: THEO
description: THEO is the only solution that maps positioning territories, strategic actions, and defensible direction with real competitive intelligence. It helps brands find their unique market position and build differentiation strategy.

name: ThumbnailCreator.com
description: ThumbnailCreator is an AI-powered tool designed to help YouTube content creators design high-quality, click-worthy thumbnails in minutes. Generate professional thumbnails from a description or video screenshot.

name: Tidio
description: Tidio is a customer communication platform that combines live chat, AI chatbots, and email in a single interface, designed specifically for the needs and budgets of small and medium-sized businesses. Its Lyro AI agent handles routine customer enquiries automatically — answering product questions, processing refunds, and checking order status — with a conversational quality that rivals enterprise tools. Over 300,000 businesses use Tidio to provide 24/7 support coverage without a large support team.

name: Tripo3D
description: Tripo3D generates textured 3D models from text or images in under 10 seconds, with a focus on speed and consistency suitable for real-time game assets and AR experiences. Its TripoSG model produces clean geometry and PBR textures ready for direct import into Unity, Unreal, and Blender. Studios prototyping 3D content and developers building AR features use it when turnaround time is the critical constraint.

name: Typefully
description: Typefully is a distraction-free writing and scheduling tool for X (Twitter) and LinkedIn, with AI features that rewrite threads, suggest continuations, and analyse which posts drive the most followers and engagement. Its clean editor is optimised for long-form threads, and the analytics dashboard identifies your best-performing content formats. Creators and thought leaders building audiences on X use Typefully to write more consistently and with better results.

name: Udio
description: Udio is an AI music generation platform that produces high-fidelity, studio-quality songs from text prompts, with strong handling of lyrics, structure, and genre specificity. It allows users to extend, remix, and refine generated tracks with fine-grained control over individual sections. Musicians and content creators use Udio when audio quality and musical accuracy are the priority.

name: Uizard
description: Uizard transforms hand-drawn wireframe sketches, screenshots, or text descriptions into interactive app prototypes in minutes. Its AI can generate a multi-screen app mockup from a plain-language brief, which designers then refine and share with stakeholders for feedback. Product managers and non-designers use Uizard to communicate product ideas visually before any engineering work begins.

name: v0 by Vercel
description: v0 is Vercel's generative UI tool that turns a text description into production-ready React components styled with Tailwind and shadcn/ui. You describe a UI ('a pricing table with three tiers') and v0 produces clean, copy-paste-ready code in seconds. Frontend developers and designers use it to prototype and scaffold UI components far faster than building from scratch.

name: Vertech Academy
description: Vertech Academy gives you engineered AI prompt workflows — not generic study help. Each course provides a structured system for using AI tools effectively to master subjects faster and more deeply.

name: VidFlux
description: VidFlux is an AI photo-to-video generator designed to bring static photos to life. Upload any image and VidFlux animates it with realistic motion, creating stunning video content for social media and marketing.

name: Voicetype AI
description: Voicetype AI is a voice dictation tool that turns your speech into text anywhere on your device with high accuracy and speed. The first step towards replacing your keyboard with natural voice input.

name: Wan Video
description: Wan Video (Wan 2.2), developed by Alibaba, is an AI-driven video generation model for creating high-quality videos from text prompts and images. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video generation with cinematic quality.

name: Watermelon
description: Watermelon is a conversational AI platform that enables businesses to improve their customer service with AI agents that handle inquiries 24/7. Build, train, and deploy customer service chatbots without writing code.

name: Weights & Biases
description: Weights & Biases (W&B) is the leading machine learning operations platform, used by AI researchers and engineers to track experiments, visualise training runs, manage datasets, and deploy models. Every hyperparameter, metric, and artifact from a training run is automatically logged and versioned, making it trivial to reproduce any past result or compare hundreds of experiments side by side. From OpenAI to individual researchers, W&B is the default experiment tracking tool for serious ML work.

name: Whacka
description: Whacka is a tool that facilitates the transformation of inventive concepts into usable applications. Describe your idea and Whacka builds a working prototype, handling design, logic, and deployment automatically.

name: Whisper
description: Whisper is OpenAI's open-source automatic speech recognition system, trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual audio from the web. It transcribes and translates speech in 99 languages with near-human accuracy, even handling accents, background noise, and technical vocabulary robustly. Developers embed Whisper in everything from voice assistants to interview transcription tools, and it underpins many commercial transcription services.

name: Windsurf
description: Windsurf is Codeium's AI-first code editor built around an agentic AI called Cascade that can autonomously read, write, and execute code across an entire project. Unlike assistants that respond to individual prompts, Cascade maintains awareness of what it has done and what remains to complete a task end-to-end. It's a direct competitor to Cursor, favoured by developers who want deeper autonomous coding capabilities.

name: Wispr Flow
description: Wispr Flow is a voice dictation tool designed for quick and clear writing. Dictate text anywhere on your Mac with high accuracy, smart formatting, and the ability to speak naturally without having to think about punctuation.

name: Wordrific
description: Wordrific is a content creation tool that leverages AI to help B2B content teams produce SEO-optimized articles at scale. It combines keyword research, content briefs, and AI writing into a single streamlined workflow.

name: Wordtune
description: Wordtune is an AI writing tool that rewrites sentences and paragraphs to be clearer, more concise, or more engaging, offering multiple alternative phrasings for any selected text. Its Spices feature adds supporting facts, examples, and counterarguments to help writers develop thin arguments. Over 10 million users use Wordtune daily to improve email drafts, reports, and academic writing without losing their own voice.

name: WriteABookAI
description: WriteABookAI is an intelligent tool designed to enhance the book writing process for authors. Generate complete chapters, develop characters, build plot structures, and write full manuscripts with AI assistance.

name: X-Pilot AI
description: X-Pilot AI revolutionizes course creation by turning your documents, PDFs, and presentations into professional educational videos in minutes. Generate narrated video lessons with AI avatars and animated slides automatically.

name: Younet
description: Younet is a platform for building the next generation of businesses powered by AI agents. Train custom AI models on your business data and deploy them across customer-facing and internal workflows.

name: ZeroTwo
description: ZeroTwo gives you access to the complete capabilities of Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and more without switching between apps. One unified workspace for all leading AI models.

name: Zoom AI Companion
description: Zoom AI Companion is Zoom's native AI assistant, available at no additional cost to paid subscribers, that provides real-time meeting transcription, post-meeting summaries, and action-item lists directly in the Zoom interface. It can draft chat replies, compose emails based on meeting context, and summarise long Zoom Chat threads. With hundreds of millions of Zoom users globally, it's the most widely accessible AI meeting assistant by sheer install base.
